title: Backend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Engineering · Amsterdam (hybrid)

Inner Circle is a dating app for people who are done wasting time. Every member is screened thoroughly, so the profiles you see are people worth dating.

Every AI-powered feature starts with the data and infrastructure behind it. From building scalable backend systems to powering smarter matching and personalisation, our engineers turn data into meaningful connections - and shape how AI transforms the future of dating.

Goal of the Role

You power the engine that brings more members together every second. We’re moving our backend from a PHP monolith to Kotlin services, and changing how we build software at the same time: AI and agentic engineering are part of how our team works every day. You’ll join the team building the new part of our system, and occasionally work in our legacy PHP codebase.

You don’t need prior PHP or Kotlin experience. We care more about how you think and approach problems than about which language you have used so far.

Tech stack: Kotlin, Spring Boot, GraphQL, PHP 8 (legacy), MySQL (Aurora), Redis, OpenSearch, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), AWS (S3, SNS/SQS, SES, Rekognition, and more), DataDog

Result Areas:

Build and ship features that matter to members

Deliver backend features that improve matchmaking, engagement and retention. You work from outcome-based stories: the team agrees on the result, and you own how to get there.

Help move our platform to Kotlin services

Build new Kotlin services and help extract functionality from the PHP monolith step by step, without disrupting the members who use the app every day.

Work with AI, and with judgement

Use AI and agentic tools such as Claude Code in your daily work. Give them clear specs and context, and review what they produce as critically as you would review a colleague’s code.

Own the quality of what you build

Write clean, testable code with automated tests, keep pull requests small, follow secure coding practices, and stay responsible for your code once it runs in production.

Make pragmatic trade-offs

Reason through problems and ship solutions that are good enough. Recognise when something needs more care or optimisation, and ask for input when a decision is bigger than your part of the system.


What you bring:

  • 3+ years of experience in backend engineering

  • Proficiency in at least one typed backend language, such as Kotlin, Java, C#, Go, TypeScript or PHP

  • Solid experience with APIs and relational databases, including query performance

  • Understanding of systems design and software architecture, and the ability to reason about trade-offs

  • You know why clean code matters and you apply it, with or without AI

  • Experience writing automated tests and working with CI/CD

  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools, or a strong drive to learn agentic engineering practices

  • Clear communication in English, both spoken and written (design docs, decision records, pull request descriptions)

Nice to have:

  • Experience with AWS

  • Experience with event-driven systems or microservice architectures

  • Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design or clean architecture

  • Experience with Kotlin or the JVM

  • Experience working in, and gradually migrating, a legacy codebase

You:

  • Curious, and keen to try new tools and ways of working

  • Focused on outcomes rather than output

  • Pragmatic: you know when good enough is good enough

  • Comfortable asking questions and explaining your reasoning

  • An authentic team player

What we offer:

  • A fulltime job that makes a positive impact on people's lives

  • A competitive salary matched with your experience and ambition

  • An amazing work environment in our office at Prins Hendrikkade, at the heart of Amsterdam

  • A Macbook or other hardware of your choice to be able to do your job

  • Stay healthy and bring your own device allowance

  • Training and development budget

  • Frequent team get-togethers and team activities

  • Free Inner Circle VIP membership for you and your single friends

About Inner Circle

Inner Circle is a dating app built on the contrarian belief: opposites don't attract. The best connections happen between people who already live life the same way. So we don't sell more options, or better odds. We sell relevance, people worth dating. Every member is screened, so effort and intention are in place before anyone gets in. And where every other app is built to keep you swiping, ours is built to get you off it, and onto a date with someone worth your time.

At Inner Circle, we embrace our diverse community and team. We celebrate differences and know that they are key for helping us grow. Our team consists of 40 team members, with 16 nationalities and a female: male ratio of 60 : 40. Whatever your race, religion, colour, gender, national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or age, we make sure everyone has the space to be themselves.

title: Bereichsleiter / Division Director (m/w/d) – Bezahlte Studie in Deutschland
descriptionHtml:
Bereichsleiter / Division Director (m/w/d) – Bezahlte Studie in Deutschland

About Prolific

Prolific connects researchers and organisations with people from a wide range of professional backgrounds. More than 35,000 researchers and organisations use Prolific to collect high-quality human insights for research and product development.

The opportunity

We are recruiting professionals currently working as a Bereichsleiter / Division Director in Germany to participate in a paid online leadership research study.

The study explores how managers at large organisations approach leadership, decision-making, organisational change, career development, and the growing use of AI in the workplace. Your professional experience will help researchers understand how these developments affect leaders and their teams.

What you'll be doing

  • Completing a short online survey in English
  • Sharing your views on leadership, management, and workplace change
  • Answering questions about your responsibilities and professional experience
  • Providing information about the size and type of organisation where you work
  • Giving honest, considered responses based on your own experience

Who we're looking for

You may be eligible if you:

  • Currently live and work in Germany
  • Currently work as a Bereichsleiter / Division Director or in a closely comparable senior role
  • Lead a business division or major organisational area above department level
  • Work for an organisation with at least 1,000 employees
  • Are comfortable completing an online survey in English
  • Meet the requirements in the study's short pre-screening questionnaire

Participants may be asked to verify their identity, location, professional background, or other eligibility information.

Why participate?

Your experience will contribute to research into how large organisations can better support managers and employees as leadership expectations and workplace technologies change.

This is a paid research opportunity, not an application for permanent employment.

If you already have a Prolific account, you do not need to register again. Please ensure your participant profile is complete and up to date.

title: BI Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij als BI Consultant écht impact maken met data?

Als onderdeel van Tenzinger helpt 6Gorilla’s organisaties op weg in hun transformatie naar datagedreven werken, met de missie grote maatschappelijke uitdagingen op te lossen met data & AI. Bij 6Gorilla’s zorg jij er dan ook voor dat data begrijpelijk, bruikbaar en toegankelijk wordt voor professionals in het maatschappelijk domein. Met jouw slimme dashboards, analyses en advies help je onze klanten op weg in hun datagedreven transformatie. En dat is hard nodig voor een betere toekomst in het maatschappelijk domein én daarbuiten

Taken

Wat ga je doen?

Als BI Consultant ben jij de schakel tussen data en de eindgebruiker. Je:

  • Ontwerpt en ontwikkelt dashboards en rapportages in Power BI.
  • Analyseert databehoeften en vertaalt deze naar slimme en schaalbare dataproducten.
  • Verzorgt implementaties bij klanten en haalt zelfstandig requirements op.
  • Begeleidt klanten in het gebruik van rapportages en geeft trainingen waar nodig.
  • Werkt nauw samen met data engineers en analisten, zowel intern als bij de klant.
  • Draagt actief verbeterkansen aan en blijft op de hoogte van BI-trends.
  • Speelt een actieve rol in de adoptie van datagedreven werken: je betrekt stakeholders, creëert draagvlak en vergroot betrokkenheid.

Vereisten

Wat vragen wij van je?

Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en proactief. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen klanten en collega’s, werkt zelfstandig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor je werk. Je denkt mee met de klant, kijkt verder dan techniek en voelt feilloos aan wat een organisatie nodig heeft om datagedreven te kunnen werken. Je helpt klanten niet alleen aan dashboards, maar vooral aan inzichten én het vermogen om daarmee te sturen.

  • HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met Power BI (dashboarding, DAX, datavisualisatie en modellering)
  • Ervaring met datamodellering en datavisualisatie
  • Bekendheid met datawarehouses (zoals Snowflake)
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en klantgerichtheid
  • Vloeiend Nederlands in woord en geschrift

Benefits

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een bruto salaris: tussen € 4.000,- en € 5.300,- op basis van 40 uur (afhankelijk van ervaring)

  • Gemakkelijk reizen: een reiskostenvergoeding (25 cent per kilometer), een NS Business Card en een aantrekkelijk fietsplan.
  • Zekerheid: een solide pensioenregeling.
  • Sfeer: gezellige en professionele collega’s die werkplezier hoog in het vaandel hebben.
  • Extra’s: een heerlijke lunch in ons eigen restaurant.

Andere Arbeidsvoorwaarden

Mogelijkheid om hybride te werken

  • Veilige werkomgeving
  • Laptop en mobiel van de zaak
  • Een thuiswerkvergoeding en €500,- om je thuiswerkplek in te richten

title: Brand Marketing Intern, France
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The community you will join:

Airbnb is seeking a Brand Marketing Intern to join the French & BENELUX Marketing team for a six month internship starting March 15, 2027.

Join Airbnb’s Marketing team to help deliver inspiring, high-impact brand campaigns and partnerships sparking travel on Airbnb and supporting host community growth in France and the Netherlands. We have exciting projects coming up in 2027, including the third year of our partnership with the Tour de France & Tour de France Femmes, seasonal campaigns and the ongoing promotion of Airbnb Experiences and Services, which now complement our historical business of homes.

To help make these a success, we’re looking for a motivated intern who is eager to dive into real-world marketing, media, and partnership projects.

Internship dates: March 15 - September 15, 2027.

The difference you will make:

Supporting the operational execution of Local Programs & Partnerships

  • Act as a day-to-day point of contact for the media agency on campaign execution.
  • Help execute the creative strategy : 
    • Be the liaison with the internal creative teams and creative agency on the execution of high-quality, premium content
    • Ensure creative outputs are aligned with the overall campaign objectives and media plan requirements
    • Coordinate with the Community team to identify, source, and onboard hosts and listings participating in the campaign
    • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of the plan, including collecting internal clearances of selected listings through Legal and other relevant teams
    • Help with contracts and administrative follow-ups
    • Supervise production, attend shooting, manage schedules, timelines and logistics
    • Organise creative reviews and approvals by coordinating feedback loops while ensuring deadlines are met

Helping on the day-to-day execution of always-on campaigns for guests & hosts 

  • Participate in the creative & localization efforts for France:
    • Supporting on the localization of the assets in French jointly with the localization and copy writing teams, ensuring consumer and market relevance
    • Attend the recording sessions of spots 
    • Partnering with the media team to determine weekly TV/OTT media rotations in line with the approved strategy for the French market
    • Analyze creative and media performances, formulating future recommendations
  • Help execute the Audio strategy (Podcasts, Radio) for France 

Acting as a strategic partner to the Marketing team helping us go beyond our usual scope by bringing a fresh perspective to the table:

  • Market & Competitor Insights
    • Monitor competitors and market best practices in France, Belgium, and the Netherlands.
    • Identify emerging trends, new and up‑and‑coming platforms, and opportunities to differentiate Airbnb from the competition.
  • Process & Ways of Working
    • Support the team in streamlining existing processes to improve collaboration, clarity, and efficiency.
    • Help build or refine simple tools (trackers, templates, checklists) that make day-to-day execution smoother.
  • Measurement, Reporting & Learnings
    • Collect campaign results and key metrics from agencies and internal teams.
    • Consolidate data and insights into clear, structured post‑campaign reports.
    • Highlight key learnings and formulate actionable recommendations for future campaigns.

The intern experience:

As an intern, you’ll be integrated into a team where you’ll contribute to challenging projects. Your manager, team, and our incredible employee community will strive to be superhosts to you during the summer. We provide the support, mentorship, fun, and real world experience needed to accelerate your learning and make a real impact on our product, as Airbnb revolutionizes connection, belonging, and travel. You can expect to:

  • Collaborate with multiple team members to achieve project milestones
  • Communicate with stakeholders across different teams to provide project updates
  • Seek and provide feedback throughout the internship
  • Actively participate in and contribute to the Marketing team and broader Airbnb community

Your expertise:

  • Preferred: End-of-studies internship
  • Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • French native & professional proficiency in English
  • Proven record of creative skills and attention to detail.
  • Prior experience in marketing, communications and/or PR (internship or student projects).
  • Sensitivity to creative, brand, and media environments.
  • Solid project management & communication skills: ability to manage multiple stakeholders and tasks, respect deadlines, and prioritize.
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Versatile, proactive, and “can-do” attitude.
  • Comfortable with the Google Suite (Sheets, Slides, Docs, Gmail).

Our commitment to inclusion & belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future.  This role may also be eligible for benefits and Employee Travel Credits. 

France Annual Pay Range€25.000—€25.000 EUR

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Business Line Manager - Money Flows
descriptionHtml:
About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The team:

With over 8 million signers sold worldwide, Ledger Wallet is where Ledger users manage and grow their assets. Transactional Services (buy, sell, swap, trading and stablecoin products) is its main source of service revenue.

Money Flows connects users' crypto to the fiat world in both directions: on/off-ramp, cash-to-stablecoin, Card, and the growing P2P and Payments use cases. Users buy crypto with fiat or sell it back to their bank, move cash into stablecoins, and spend crypto with a card, all through specialist partners. It is the entry and exit door of the Ledger Wallet economy and a key lever to diversify Transactional Services revenue. The role reports to the Senior Director, Transactional Services.

What you’ll be doing:

You own and grow Money Flows end to end - revenue, economics, partner ecosystem and the quality of every fiat journey in Ledger Wallet - with a General Manager mindset over a business run mostly through external partners and cross-functional teams. The ambition is to grow revenue 10x in two to three years, through a strategy and roadmap you define and turn into quantified milestones.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Business Line Ownership & Revenue Delivery: Being ultimately accountable for Money Flows revenue, volume and take rate across buy, sell, cash-to-stablecoin, Card, P2P and Payments. Building and defending the forecast, querying the data yourself, and separating market effects from the levers the team controls.

  • Monetization & Pricing: Owning take rate by line, partner and payment method. Turning volume into direct or indirect revenue (zero-fee partners, cash-to-stablecoin flows), and keeping pricing/product competitive against exchanges, neobanks and other wallets.

  • Partner Management & Business Development: Identifying, signing, managing and negotiating with the ramp, payment, stablecoin and card-issuing partner bench - on pricing, geographic and payment-method coverage, conversion, KYC friction and operational quality. Managing concentration risk, onboarding new providers to close gaps, and running a monthly review with each partner.

  • Card Programme Ownership: Running the card programme: economics, activation and dormancy, issuer and processor performance, card-scheme negotiations (including geo expansion), and the go-to-market with Marketing.

  • Ledger Wallet Experience: Working with the Product Line Manager to improve the Buy, Sell, Card and Pay journeys, and making sure every release ships with a coordinated go-to-market.

  • Stablecoin & Payments Roadmap: Shaping how Ledger captures stablecoin and payment use cases - cash-to-stablecoin, Pay and peer-to-peer flows - together with Product, within local regulatory frameworks (MiCA,...) with Legal and Compliance, informed by close tracking of the ramp, stablecoin and card landscape.

  • Operational Excellence & Observability: Partner SLAs, incident management and fast action to protect users, Ledger and revenue; conversion, failed-payment and KYC-drop monitoring; and closing measurement gaps so every line can be steered on data.

  • Cross-Functional Delivery: Driving execution across Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Pricing, Marketing/CRM and other business lines - all of it outside your reporting lines - to ship improvements, drive growth and resolve issues.

What we’re looking for:

  • Ownership mindset: A demonstrated ability to own a business line or revenue stream end to end and make data-driven decisions. You are energized by being accountable for a P&L line and delivering the budget, including in a soft market.

  • Exceptional quantitative skills: A strong track record of using data to drive decisions and manage execution. You enjoy digging into the numbers yourself and separating market effect from execution.

  • Commercial & business development experience: Proven results negotiating and managing external partners on pricing, terms and performance. You like using data and leverage to improve terms, coverage and quality, and building relationships that compound over time. Sales / business development experience is highly valued.

  • Payments industry experience (required): Experience in payments (for example at Visa, Adyen, Stripe or dLocal), with hands-on knowledge of payments and acquiring - conversion funnels, KYC, fraud and chargeback dynamics.

  • Card ecosystem: Experience in the card ecosystem - issuing, processing, card schemes or programme management, including interchange and programme economics - is a strong plus.

  • Operational excellence: Evidence of running something with rigor - managing operational risk, reducing errors and optimizing conversion or engagement. You are comfortable running live lines while shaping new ones, such as stablecoins, payments and card programs.

  • Influence in a matrixed organization: The proven ability to align Product, Tech, Finance, Legal, Compliance and Marketing behind your priorities and drive cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.

  • Consumer fintech / service-revenue background: Experience in a high-volume transactional or service-revenue business is highly desirable; a B2C background is a strong plus. Fintech or equivalent service experience is a must.

  • Digital assets: Interest in stablecoins and crypto is desirable, as the crypto knowledge needed can be learned faster than payments expertise. Familiarity with MiCA and European payments regulation is a plus.

  • AI: Strong appetite for what AI can bring to analysis and operations is a must.

  • Total English fluency. The role is based in Paris; French is not a prerequisite for social or work life in our office.

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

title: Business Operations & Data Specialist (Production & Quality)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Behind every well-run plant is a shared understanding of how it is performing — and that understanding has to be built. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Production & Quality at Destinus, you are the bridge between the people who run our plants and the data that describes them. Plant managers, production leads, and quality engineers own the processes; our lakehouse holds the data those processes create. Your job is to connect the two, so that every production and quality figure, from the shopfloor to the leadership team, is defined by the business, built on the lakehouse, and trusted by both.

This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what the business needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the production and quality data in the lakehouse and turning it into the reporting used across three European plants, including our Digital Shopfloor Management Solution, relied on by more than 300 people. You will also go to where the data is created and make it better there — improving how it is captured, automating what is still manual, and helping three plants work to one standard.

At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our operations span multiple plants and teams, and your work will directly support the reliability, efficiency, and excellence required for mission-critical production. Join us in shaping the next era of aerospace operations.

What You'll do

  • Be the go-to contact between the business owners of production and quality data — plant managers, production leads, and quality engineers — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on.
  • Own the production and quality portfolio end to end: define the KPI, improve the process behind it, build the dashboard, and stand behind the number.
  • Own the production and quality domain in our lakehouse: know which tables and fields hold what, where each comes from, and who owns it at source — and keep that knowledge documented rather than in your head.
  • Partner with our Data Engineers on the curated (gold) layer for production and quality: specify the tables, fields, and business rules the business needs, and validate the result against what actually happens on the shopfloor before anyone relies on it.
  • Set and monitor data quality checks for your domain, and route each issue to the right owner — the person entering the data, the system configuration, or the pipeline — until it is fixed.
  • Maintain and continuously improve Power BI dashboards tracking production and quality performance across all three plants, built on certified lakehouse data rather than side spreadsheets.
  • Describe production and quality data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first.
  • Automate what is manual today: recurring reports, data collection, and the preparation behind daily and weekly performance routines.
  • Support the standardisation of ways of working across the three plants, partnering with our Lean Operations Specialist so that measurement and improvement pull in the same direction.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Quality Management, or a related field.
  • Experience in a production or quality environment; aerospace or another regulated industry is highly preferred.
  • Solid understanding of manufacturing and quality metrics — throughput, cycle time, OEE, scrap and rework, first-pass yield — and of quality processes such as non-conformance handling, customer complaints and field returns, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Strong expertise in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, troubleshooting), complemented by advanced Excel skills.
  • Comfortable querying data with SQL and working in a lakehouse or data warehouse environment; experience with Microsoft Fabric or a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture is a plus. You will not build the pipelines — you need to know what to ask for and how to check what comes back.
  • Able to explain data to non-technical colleagues and business needs to technical ones — and to get both sides to agree on one definition.
  • Knowledge of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, and familiarity with shopfloor or MES systems.
  • A track record of improving or automating a process, not only reporting on it. Exposure to continuous improvement methods is a plus.
  • Comfortable working across multiple sites and collaborating with production teams, quality engineers, and leadership alike.
  • Fluent in English; Spanish, German or Dutch is a strong plus given our plant locations.
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred.

Who You Are

You are equally comfortable on a shopfloor and in a data model, and you speak both languages — the plant's and the lakehouse's. You know that the fastest way to fix a reporting problem is often to walk to the place where the data is created and ask how it gets entered — and then change it.

You are structured and persistent, because aligning three plants on one way of working takes more than a good spreadsheet; it takes patience and conversations. You enjoy the detail of a root cause but stay focused on whether performance actually improved, and when something is manual or repetitive you would rather automate it than live with it.

You turn numbers into stories, stories into priorities, and priorities into measurable change. Above all, you take ownership, challenge assumptions, and stay committed to operational excellence.

title: CDI - Senior AI Builder - Paris
descriptionHtml:
L’IA ne transforme pas une entreprise parce qu’elle est disponible, mais parce que les collaborateurs s’en emparent pour travailler autrement. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers : “We Make AI Work”. Notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, au cœur des métiers et à grande échelle.

Et tout commence par vous.

Mission

En tant que Senior AI Builder, vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients. **Vous transmettez et construisez : vous pilotez des initiatives de montée en compétences, concevez avec les métiers des agents et solutions IA qui répondent à leurs besoins, et accompagnez leur adoption. Vous coachez les consultants juniors et êtes responsable de la qualité et des résultats de vos travaux.

Vous partez des défis des utilisateurs métiers, de leurs processus et de leurs irritants pour transformer les possibilités de l’IA en résultats tangibles. **Vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide** : vous concevez et animez des expériences d’apprentissage qui donnent envie de passer à l’action, construisez des agents et des solutions fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et les faites évoluer au contact de leurs utilisateurs pour ancrer de nouveaux usages.

Au plus près des métiers, vous identifiez les opportunités de repenser les tâches, faire évoluer les rôles et responsabilités, et réinventer les façons de travailler avec l’IA. Vous faites le lien entre les initiatives de terrain (bottom-up) et les programmes de transformation à grande échelle (top-down), aux côtés de nos équipes AI Strategy et Engineering. Votre réussite se mesure à l’adoption réelle des solutions, à l’autonomie des équipes et aux changements concrets dans leur quotidien.

Activités & Responsabilités

I. Analyse & Cadrage

Animer des ateliers avec les métiers et le L&D pour analyser les besoins, segmenter les publics et cartographier un workflow.Proposer la solution cible, le rôle de l’humain et de l’agent, les contrôles nécessaires et les critères d’acceptation.Concevoir le séquencement d’un module ou d’un parcours, avec cas d’usage, temps de pratique et modalités d’évaluation.

II. Développement & Déploiement des Solutions

Créer des ateliers et playbooks contextualisés, prototyper des assistants ou agents simples en amont et en direct avec les participants, à l'aide de plateformes approuvées et de patterns réutilisables.Définir et exécuter jeux d'essai, tests utilisateurs et critères qualité; documenter les limites et faire valider les points sensibles.Animer de manière autonome, adapter la séance au niveau du public et coacher un Junior sur ses premières animations.Traduire une question business en KPIs, en définitions et en dashboards complets livrés en autonomie, et transformer les analyses en storyline avec un « so what » clair.

III. Adoption & Animation de Communauté

Organiser office hours, challenges d'application et train-the-trainer, outiller des champions et des managers de proximité.Accompagner la mise en usage, former les référents makers et préparer les supports de transfert.Exploiter les retours des utilisateurs pendant le périmètre convenu et proposer des améliorations priorisées.

IV. Structuration et Pilotage de la démarche Change

Suivre l'adoption et la valeur du use case, les compétences acquises, la capacité à répliquer et les premiers usages; proposer des ajustements concrets pour améliorer l'activation.Contribuer à l’analyse des freins et au plan de change du programme, sous la responsabilité du chef de mission.Identifier les dépendances SI, les risques sécurité et le besoin d'escalade vers la DSI ou AI Engineering.

Profil recherché

Vous vous reconnaissez si… vous aimez avoir la main sur un périmètre, structurer des problèmes complexes et voir vos recommandations se concrétiser, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre les mains du client plutôt que lui décrire une vision.

  • Une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master, issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence.
  • Une bonne maîtrise de l’IA générative et agentique, et un état d’esprit de maker : capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer des agents et solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding).

  • Une capacité à comprendre les enjeux et processus métier, à embarquer les parties prenantes et à accompagner la transformation des tâches, des rôles et des pratiques de travail.
  • Une maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais (oral et écrit).

À propos d’Artefact

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. À la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Notre accompagnement s'étend sur l'intégralité de la chaîne de valeur : Strategize AI (cadrage stratégique, opportunités à fort impact, trajectoires, modèles opérationnels), Deploy AI (ingénierie, industrialisation, architectures agentiques, produits data) et Adopt AI (conduite du changement, acculturation, usage quotidien de l'IA).

Envie d'en savoir plus ? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Pourquoi nous rejoindre?

De la stratégie à la réalisation
Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers.Une collaboration entre expertises
Occuper un rôle à la croisée de l'humain (AI Adoption), de la stratégie (AI Strategy), de la technologie (AI Engineering).Un rôle avec de l’autonomie et des perspectives
Piloter des streams, développer une expertise, faire grandir une équipe et contribuer au développement de l’activité.Un parcours clair de progression

Un accompagnement concret : counsellor, parcours de formation et programme de leadership.

  1. Un entretien de fit RH (30 / 45’) avec les RH / Talent Acquisition
  2. Un entretien de fit expert (60’) avec un AI Builder Senior ou Manager
  3. Une présentation d’un cas réel (60’) sur lequel le candidat a travaillé par le passé avec un Manager
  4. Un role play AI Adoption Senior (45 / 60’) avec Directeur
  5. Un entretien de fit final (30’) avec un AI Builder Partner

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 63 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 5 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
department: INL - Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon
descriptionHtml:
The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability.

Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain.

This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing.

The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains.

A major aspect of the PhD will be the development of system-level evaluation and benchmarking methodologies within a design-technology co-optimization (DTCO/SDTCO) framework. The objective is to provide quantitative and objective metrics for decision-making, including scalability analysis, computational throughput, and energy efficiency for target AI workloads. These evaluations will support both intermediate design exploration and the potential experimental validation of fabricated demonstrators within the broader program.

In addition, the PhD will address electronic circuit design challenges associated with photonic accelerators, including interface circuits for control, programming of PCM elements, optical-to-electrical readout, and signal conversion. These aspects are critical for ensuring the practical integration of photonic computing units within heterogeneous AI hardware systems.

The expected outcome is a set of novel architectures, models, and evaluation tools that will clarify the potential and limitations of silicon photonics for next-generation AI accelerators, and provide guidelines for scalable and energy-efficient implementations.


Background: The candidate should hold or be about to obtain an MSc in Electronics Engineering, Photonics, or Computer Engineering. A strong background in computer architecture, integrated circuits, or photonic systems is expected. Knowledge of AI hardware accelerators, in-memory computing, or silicon photonics will be appreciated.

Environment: The PhD will be carried out at the INL laboratory, within the CAMELIA program, as part of the LEAF project, in collaboration between leading academic and institutional partners in AI hardware and photonics.

Starting dates: Fall 2026

title: CFD Workflow Automation Intern
descriptionHtml:
About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse.

We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team.

The role will focus on developing robust, reusable workflows for meshing, simulation setup and launching, data extraction, post-processing, and standardized reporting, with particular emphasis on Cadence and Ansys Fluent environments. The internship is intended to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and shorten analysis turnaround time across the Fluidics Department.

The intern will work with engineers from both teams to identify high-value automation opportunities, translate existing engineering practices into scripts and workflows, and validate the resulting tools on representative analysis cases. Prior expertise in Cadence or Ansys Fluent is not required; strong programming ability and a willingness to learn the relevant engineering applications are more important.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop scripts and utilities to automate CFD meshing, simulation setup, job launching, monitoring, and post-processing activities.

• Automate recurring workflows in Cadence and Ansys Fluent, using the scripting and interface capabilities available within those environments.

• Create reusable tools for data extraction, visualization, comparison, and standardized reporting of CFD results. • Work with the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team to streamline the design-analysis iteration loop, including comparison of CFD results with design intent.

• Work with the Fluidic Analysis Team to identify repetitive analysis tasks and convert them into reliable, maintainable automated processes.

• Define input requirements, verification checks, error handling, and user documentation so that the developed tools can be adopted by different engineers.

• Validate automated workflows against existing manual processes and document accuracy, repeatability, limitations, and expected time savings.

• Present progress and results to the participating teams and incorporate user feedback into successive tool improvements.

What you need to be successful:

• Final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Strong programming skills, preferably in Python; experience with additional scripting languages is an advantage.

• Understanding of software development fundamentals, including modular code, version control, testing, debugging, and documentation.

• Ability to analyse an existing manual workflow, identify repetitive steps, and translate the process into a structured automation solution.

• Interest in CFD, numerical simulation, engineering data processing, or scientific computing. Previous application-specific experience is not mandatory.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Soft Skills:

• Analytical and methodical approach to problem solving.

• Proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of a defined work package.

• Clear communication and ability to gather requirements from engineers in different teams.

• Attention to detail, with a focus on reliability, traceability, and usability.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multicultural, multidisciplinary environment.

Other useful skills:

• Experience with engineering or scientific Python and Matlab libraries for data processing and visualization.

• Familiarity with Linux, command-line tools, batch processing, high-performance computing, or job schedulers.

• Exposure to APIs, graphical user interfaces, dashboards, or automated report generation.

• Familiarity with Git or another version-control system.

• Previous exposure to Cadence, Ansys Fluent, CFD meshing, or simulation postprocessing is beneficial but not required.

• Basic knowledge of fluid dynamics or numerical methods is an advantage.

Supervision and collaboration:

The intern will be supervised by a designated engineer and will collaborate with representatives of both the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The assignment will be managed as a shared departmental initiative, with priorities defined according to the automation needs and potential impact identified by the participating teams.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization. Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions. Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values. Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!

title: Chief Investment Officer (CIO)
descriptionHtml:
As one of the leading companies in Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), SkyNRG is developing and advancing projects, partnerships and commercial opportunities that will play a critical role in the decarbonization of aviation.

As our portfolio grows in scale and complexity, we are looking to further strengthen our investment capabilities, combining strategic thinking, commercial insight and disciplined decision-making to accelerate value creation across the business. To support this next stage of growth, we are seeking a Chief Investment Officer.

Reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with the Executive Committee, Board and shareholders, the CIO will play a central role in shaping the future direction of SkyNRG. This executive will bring an institutional investor mindset to the organization, strengthening how opportunities are evaluated, prioritized and executed while ensuring that capital is deployed toward initiatives that create sustainable strategic and financial value.

The Opportunity

The Chief Investment Officer will be responsible for leading SkyNRG's Investment Management capability and driving value creation across the business.

Working closely with the Executive Committee, Board and shareholders, the CIO will help shape the strategic direction of SkyNRG by ensuring investment decisions, capital allocation and growth initiatives are aligned with long-term value creation.

This role combines the analytical rigor of an investment professional with the strategic perspective of a business leader. It offers the opportunity to influence some of the most significant decisions facing the company while contributing directly to the development of projects and partnerships that support the future of sustainable aviation.

Your Role

As Chief Investment Officer, you will be responsible for strengthening investment decision-making and value creation across SkyNRG.

You will:

  • Lead SkyNRG's Investment Management capability and establish the frameworks, governance and standards that support disciplined decision-making.

  • Further improve SkyNRG’s investment strategy, building on 17 years of SAF experience, network and track record, and the company’s overall strategic plans

  • Drive the evaluation and prioritization of major investments, strategic partnerships and growth opportunities across the portfolio.

  • Bring an institutional investor mindset into the organization, fostering collaboration across teams and ensuring opportunities are assessed through the lens of strategic fit, risk-adjusted returns and long-term value creation.

  • Provide leadership to Corporate Development and Project Commercial activities, building high-performing teams and fostering a collaborative, results-driven culture that aligns strategic ambitions, commercial execution and investment outcomes.

  • Support the development of bankable, financeable and commercially attractive SAF projects.

  • Lead selected M&A, partnership and corporate development opportunities that contribute to SkyNRG's long-term growth strategy.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Executive Committee, Board and shareholders on investment strategy, capital allocation and portfolio prioritization.

Key Areas of Impact

Investment Strategy

You will provide leadership on how capital is allocated across SkyNRG's portfolio, ensuring resources are directed toward opportunities with the greatest strategic and commercial potential.

You will oversee investment evaluations, valuation methodologies, business case development and portfolio prioritization to support informed decision-making at Executive Committee and Board level.

Portfolio Development

You will help maximize value across SkyNRG's portfolio by strengthening investment discipline throughout the project lifecycle.

From opportunity identification through commercial structuring and execution, you will ensure investment decisions are supported by robust analysis, clear governance and a strong understanding of risk and value drivers.

Partnerships

Growth opportunities are expected to come from a combination of project development, strategic partnerships and selective corporate development initiatives.

You will play a leading role in identifying, assessing and executing opportunities that enhance SkyNRG's position within the sustainable aviation ecosystem and support the company's long-term ambitions.

Organizational Leadership

You will collaborate closely with teams across Projects, Commercial, Finance, Legal and Strategy to strengthen how investment opportunities are evaluated and executed.

By embedding a common investment framework across the business, you will increase transparency, improve decision quality and support a culture focused on value creation and accountability.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a strategic and collaborative leader with a strong track record in investment, infrastructure, energy or related capital-intensive industries. You are able to build trust across diverse stakeholder groups and bring people together around complex decisions.

You combine strategic thinking with strong commercial judgment and have experience evaluating complex investment opportunities in capital-intensive environments.

You are comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, engaging with boards and shareholders and navigating situations where commercial, financial and strategic considerations intersect.

You bring:

  • 15+ years of relevant experience in infrastructure, energy transition, project finance, private equity, corporate development or investment management.

  • A proven track record of evaluating and executing complex investment opportunities.

  • Deep expertise in valuation, financial analysis, capital allocation and investment decision-making.

  • Experience working with executive teams, Boards and institutional investors.

  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • The ability to balance strategic vision with pragmatic execution.

  • A genuine interest in accelerating the transition toward more sustainable aviation.

We recognize that exceptional candidates may not meet every listed requirement. If you are excited about the opportunity to shape the future of sustainable aviation and believe your experience can contribute to our ambitions, we encourage you to apply.

Location & International Exposure

Based at SkyNRG's Amsterdam headquarters, this role offers the opportunity to work across an international network of partners, investors and project stakeholders that are helping shape the future of sustainable aviation.

We offer a flexible hybrid working model, recognizing that impactful leadership can be delivered through a combination of in-person collaboration, stakeholder engagement and remote working.

Why join SkyNRG

This is an opportunity to play a defining role in one of the most dynamic and ambitious companies operating within the sustainable aviation sector.

As Chief Investment Officer, you will influence investment decisions that shape the future of the company, contribute to the development of large-scale SAF projects and help create long-term value for shareholders, partners and the aviation industry as a whole.

You will join an entrepreneurial and mission-driven organization where commercial success and sustainable impact go hand in hand, and where your decisions will directly influence the growth trajectory of both the business and the broader SAF ecosystem.

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com.

📌 Please note: We do not accept sales inquiries or intermediary services.

At SkyNRG, we deeply value inclusion and diversity. As an equal opportunity employer, we are dedicated to ensuring every applicant has a fair chance, irrespective of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Chief of Staff, People & AI Transformation
descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for an exceptional AI-native operator to join Smartly as Chief of Staff, People & AI Transformation, working directly with our Chief People Officer.

Smartly is a global technology company at the intersection of AI, advertising, and creativity. As AI transforms how businesses operate, we're rethinking how we organize work, build capabilities, and unlock productivity across our global organization.This is an opportunity to be at the center of that transformation.

You'll help drive some of our most important strategic initiatives—from launching new R&D centers globally to building an entirely new approach to workforce planning. You'll create the operating rhythm that keeps our People leadership team aligned, accountable, and moving forward. And you'll build AI-powered tools, agents, and workflows that connect information, automate processes, and help us make better decisions.

We're looking for a builder, not just a coordinator.

You're the kind of person who sees a messy problem, builds a plan, gets the right people moving, and then asks how AI could make the whole process 10x better.

What You'll Do

Drive high-impact transformation projects

  • Own the execution of strategic, cross-functional initiatives, including global expansion, workforce planning, organizational transformation, and AI-enabled ways of working.
  • Translate ambitious priorities into clear project plans, milestones, deliverables, and accountability.
  • Bring senior stakeholders together, unblock decisions, and ensure important initiatives move forward with urgency and discipline.

Build AI-powered tools and operating systems

  • Design and build AI agents, automations, and workflows that make our People organization more effective.
  • Develop tools that connect People data with Finance, Operations, and business performance metrics to improve visibility into organizational effectiveness and transformation outcomes.
  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies, prototype new solutions, and turn successful experiments into scalable workflows.
  • Partner with technical and analytics teams to ensure solutions are reliable, secure, and useful.

Be the operational engine of our People leadership team

  • Establish a consistent cadence of planning, reporting, project reviews, and accountability across our global People organization.
  • Create dashboards and reporting mechanisms that provide visibility into strategic priorities, progress, risks, and decisions.
  • Own the preparation of quarterly People business reviews for our CEO, turning complex information into sharp insights and compelling executive presentations.
  • Help our Chief People Officer and leadership team stay focused on the work that matters most.

Who You Are

  • An AI-native builder. You don't just use AI tools—you've built agents, automations, or workflows that solve real problems. You're constantly experimenting with what's new.
  • An exceptional operator. You're highly organized, detail-oriented, and relentless about follow-through. Nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Entrepreneurial and resourceful. You thrive in fast-moving environments, figure things out independently, and love building from scratch.
  • Confident and people-oriented. You enjoy meeting people, asking questions, and engaging senior leaders. You're comfortable pushing for clarity and accountability.
  • Analytical and articulate. You can turn messy information into clear thinking, compelling presentations, and actionable recommendations.
  • Intellectually curious. You learn quickly, challenge conventional thinking, and get energized by unfamiliar problems.

You likely have 2–5 years of experience in a high-growth startup, founder's office, strategy and operations, consulting, product operations, or a similarly demanding environment.You don't need an HR background or a traditional Chief of Staff title. We're far more interested in what you've built, how you think, and what you're capable of becoming.

Why This Role?

  • You'll work directly with the Chief People Officer on initiatives that shape how a global technology company operates.
  • You'll gain exposure to executive decision-making, international expansion, organizational strategy, AI transformation, and the future of work—while taking real ownership from day one.
  • You'll have the freedom to experiment, build new tools, challenge existing processes, and make a visible impact.

If you're ambitious, love solving hard problems, and want to help build the operating model of an AI-native company, we'd love to hear from you.

About Smartly

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Comand AI is building a global technology leader focused on defense & security. The company was co-founded in 2023 by Loïc Mougeolle, Marie Inuzuka and Quentin Le Pape, drawing from their unique experience at defense industry leaders and world-class tech companies.

The world of defense & security are being entirely renewed by AI and robotisation: new classes of threats, new levels of autonomy and speed demands radically new solutions to protect our societies. Comand AI is at the forefront of the rebuilding of these verticals to serve our countries resilience.

Comand AI core product is a next generation command and control software platform, which allows militaries to operate at machine speed in a communication and GNSS denied context. A few facts to anchor you:

  • €45M raised from seed to Series A, Blossom Capital leading the series A and Saab as a strategic investor

  • Software platform combat proven and deployed in Ukraine

  • A lean team of operators with backgrounds from Palantir, OpenAI and world-class tech experience, alongside unique expertise from the defense sector

  • Live business with governments and defense industry leaders across Europe

  • Paris (HQ), London, Munich and Kyiv subsidiaries

The Role

You'd join as Chief of Staff to Loïc, our CEO. Your job is to create leverage for him across everything in his perimeter: external meetings, strategy, his public voice and investor relations. To do that well, you need to be "in his head": you know what he would say, what he needs next, and what can wait.

You support the CEO's decisions; you don't make them for him. Investor relationships stay with the CEO and the leadership team.

What this looks like in practice:

  • Let Loïc take on 3x more external meetings with military, political and industry stakeholders: prepare the materials, send pre-reads ahead, run the follow-up, coordinate with points of contact, and help define what each meeting needs to achieve

  • Support the leadership team's strategy work: bring the right inputs, pace the process so decisions actually get taken, and make sure they're communicated

  • Build the CEO's external voice: draft LinkedIn posts, articles, thought pieces and panel or interview prep to a v0.5 he can iterate on (v0.9 once you're fully in his head), own the communications calendar, and make sure what's planned ships

  • Run investor reporting: act as board secretary, prepare monthlies and board meetings (decks, Notion docs and other materials), keep the data room ready, and support preparation for our next fundraise

  • Track priorities across the company, catch what's falling through the cracks, and make sure the right people are moving on the right things

  • Build genuine trust with a small, fast-moving leadership team

 

Who We're Looking For

We filter hardest on autonomy, humility and grit. We want sharp, hard-working people with real team spirit, who drive things to completion without being told exactly how.

Must-have

  • Around 4 years of experience, including time at a seed-stage startup

  • Real experience operating close to a CEO or senior executive in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment, not a project management background alone

  • Strong writing and structuring skills: you can turn a messy conversation into a clear deck, memo or post

  • Strong generalist judgment: comfortable moving between external meetings, strategy, communications and investor work in the same week

  • Genuine discretion with sensitive and confidential information

  • Comfortable driving alignment and pushing back on stakeholders without formal authority

  • EU citizenship

  • Based in Paris, working in person with the CEO

  • Fluency in both French and English

Nice to have

  • Experience in a large organisation as well as a startup

  • Experience in defense, government, or another highly regulated, security-conscious sector

  • Some exposure to fundraising, board reporting, or investor relations

 

What's In It For You

  • Competitive package (top 0.1% of compensation in Europe: base + equity)

  • Working day to day alongside the CEO

The Process

1. Talent screening (optional): 30 min, online. Background and motivation.

2. CEO fit: 30 min, with Loïc.

3. Investor fit: 30 min, with one of our investors.

4. Onsite in Paris: full day.

title: Communications Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Peec AI

AI search is changing how brands are discovered and chosen. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions.

Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000 paying customers. We’re a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, with 100+ people across our Berlin HQ and our New York office.

About the role

We publish a lot of original evidence about AI search: a quarterly industry report, a public Index, and findings from our own research team. Right now each piece reaches the market on its own, and nobody owns the story that connects them.

We're hiring a Communications Lead to own that story. You'll decide the few ideas Peec should be known for, write and edit the work that carries them, and keep them consistent across research, founder comms, press, events, social and campaigns.

This is a senior individual contributor role based in Berlin. You report to the VP of Growth and work directly with our founders, our product marketer, and our research and content team.

What you'll do

  • Decide what Peec is known for. Pick the two or three ideas we want to own, the evidence behind each, and how the story develops quarter to quarter. Write it down so the rest of the company can repeat it.

  • Turn research into stories. Work with the research team to find what in the data our audience will care about most, then carry it out: the report intro, the founder post, the journalist brief, the stage premise. Same evidence, told differently for each audience.

  • Shape our social strategy. You set what Peec and our founders talk about on social and how each story runs across LinkedIn and our other channels. The social and content team runs the channels day to day. Work with product marketing so launches and the brand story say the same thing.

  • Write and edit the highest-stakes work yourself. Founder and expert pieces, press materials, campaign copy and research comms. Brief writers and producers on the rest, and hold every contributor to the same bar.

  • Run founder and expert communications. Talking points, interview prep, opinion pieces, stage remarks and founder posts on LinkedIn, with honest feedback afterwards. Make our founders and experts consistently good on the record.

  • Lead press and publisher strategy. Bring the news judgment, angles and briefing materials, and pitch journalists yourself. Treat independent coverage and sponsored placements differently.

  • Make Peec citable in AI search. We help marketing teams see and improve how AI search talks about them. Our own story should be the best-cited example in the category, and you own how ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini describe Peec.

What we're looking for

  • You've led an integrated launch at a B2B tech company, taking original research or a complex product to a clear story shipped across channels. You can walk us from raw evidence to final assets: what you wrote, what you commissioned, where the story changed and what you refused to claim.

  • You write fast, in many formats, and in someone else's voice when needed. We'll ask for recent work where your part is clear.

  • You are comfortable with data. Given a set of metrics, you can say which story holds up to a sceptical reader and which one doesn't.

  • You've pitched journalists yourself and landed coverage.

  • You've built the function rather than only contributed. Early or growth stage, first or second in seat.

  • You build your own tools. AI is part of how you draft, monitor and research, and you can show us your setup and where you stop letting it write for you.

  • You work directly with founders, make decisions and ship.

Bonus points

  • You were a journalist or editor before you moved in-house.

  • You've worked in search, SEO, analytics, martech or a data platform. You already know why AI search is a real shift.

  • You have warm relationships with the US marketing and tech trade press, and with the newsletter writers who now matter more than most of it.

  • You've taken a European company's story into the US market.

  • You've directed a PR agency well. Mostly that means knowing what to stop paying for.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity: everyone at Peec owns a piece of the upside

  • Comprehensive benefits package

  • Collaborative, high-energy in-office work environment

  • Opportunity to make a significant impact and define a new market category

Compensation: €85K – €105K • Offers Equity
