title: Consumer Insight & Strategy Director
descriptionHtml:
Consumer Insights & Strategy Director
London - Hybrid (3 days per week in the office)

About Gen

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We're always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate - leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.

When you're part of Gen, you'll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career - from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs.

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You'll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.

If this sounds like you, we'd love you to be part of Gen.

How We Work

Our hybrid work style (3 days in the London office) gives us the face-to-face time to have creative conversations, meaningful meetings, make quick decisions and build relationships. And it's flexible enough to give you the space to do your best work.

Consumer Insights & Strategy Director

The team

The Insights & Strategy team creates deep organizational understanding of our customers, markets and competitors so we can develop customer-centric products, services and communications that drive business growth.

We bring together different research disciplines and synthesize insights from across data sources, to tell coherent customer stories and ground decisions in evidence across Marketing, Product and Commercial teams. (Norton, Avast, MoneyLion & LifeLock)

Role summary

The Consumer Insights & Strategy Director is a senior individual contributor who acts as a strategic advisor to segment and brand leadership for either Cyber Safety (Norton & Avast) and Trust-based Solutions (LifeLock & MoneyLion).

Their primary responsibility is not to generate research, but to help the business make better decisions. They connect customer understanding, market dynamics, competitive context and commercial performance to shape growth strategy, portfolio choices, proposition development and customer experience priorities.

The role sits at the intersection of strategy, customer insight and stakeholder leadership. You will:

  • Sit as a virtual member of the segment/brand leadership team, bringing the voice of the customer into key decisions.

  • Frame and scope the critical questions the business needs to answer.

  • Synthesize diverse inputs into clear, actionable narratives that influence direction.

  • Shape and prioritise the learning agenda for your segment in partnership with the wider Insight team.

Success is measured by the quality of business decisions influenced, not the volume of research delivered.

Key responsibilities

  1. Strategic business partnering

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the Segment Lead / Brand Lead and their virtual leadership team on segment strategy, performance, customer base and competitive context for your business segment.

  • Frame and refine critical business questions (e.g., portfolio choices, proposition direction, target audiences, pricing/packaging, experience priorities).

  • Bring a customer- and evidence-centred perspective into business planning, roadmap discussions and major investment or trade-off decisions.

  • Represent the voice of the customer in key forums - challenging constructively, highlighting risks and opportunities, and helping leaders see decisions through a customer lens.

  1. Business strategy & decision support

  • Synthesize evidence from multiple sources - including customer insight, analytics, CX, market intelligence, commercial performance and external trends - into clear strategic recommendations for the business.

  • Develop compelling "so what / now what" narratives, presentations and workshops that help leaders and teams move from evidence to decision, creating clarity and alignment around key priorities.

  • Support stakeholders in evaluating strategic options and trade-offs relating to growth, customer experience, proposition development, portfolio choices and go-to-market decisions.

  • Ensure major insight programmes and strategic initiatives result in tangible business action, helping teams translate customer understanding into priorities, plans and measurable outcomes.

  1. Learning agenda and insight activation

  • Work closely with stakeholders and Insight team colleagues to ensure projects are framed against the right strategic questions for your segment.

  • Define and maintain a prioritised learning roadmap for your business area, aligned to the biggest opportunities, risks and decisions.

  • Spot knowledge gaps and emerging questions and translate them into clear briefs and programmes of work.

  • Act as a connector across functions and disciplines - joining up signals across teams and sources into a unified view of customer needs and market dynamics.

  • Play a leading role in developing the quarterly State of Play (integrated customer narrative) in collaboration with Insight team colleagues.

Skills & experience

Essential experience

  • Significant experience in customer insight, strategy, consulting or a closely related field, ideally in consumer technology, subscription, financial services or adjacent categories.

  • Proven track record of partnering with senior stakeholders on major strategic or commercial decisions (e.g., portfolio strategy, brand positioning, proposition development, experience design, go-to-market).

  • Experience synthesising multiple data and insight sources (qual, quant, analytics, CX, market intel) into concise, decision-ready outputs.

  • Demonstrated impact in turning insight into action - influencing real changes in products, experiences, communications or commercial strategy.

Skills & capabilities

  • Strategic, structured thinker - able to frame problems, prioritise questions, and connect customer insight to business outcomes.

  • Strong storytelling and communication - comfortable simplifying complexity, building clear narratives and presenting confidently to senior audiences.

  • Commercially astute - understands how brands grow, how P&Ls work, and how customer behaviour shows up in performance metrics.

  • Collaborative and credible - able to work effectively across teams, building trust and alignment in a matrix environment.

  • Influential without authority - willing and able to challenge thinking, propose alternatives and guide teams towards more customer-centric choices.

Mindset

  • Customer-obsessed - motivated by building a truthful, nuanced view of our customers and using it to drive better decisions.

  • Insight-to-action oriented - focused on impact, not just analysis; always asking "so what?" and "now what?".

  • Low-ego, high ownership - comfortable operating autonomously, rolling up their sleeves, and taking responsibility for outcomes in their segment.

What's Next

Your CV will be reviewed together by the recruiter and hiring manager to assess the scope of your role, the impact you've delivered, and how your experience aligns with the position. If shortlisted, the recruiter will invite you to an initial Zoom conversation to discuss your background, what's compelling you to Gen, and walk you through the interview process.

Gen is an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to fair, inclusive practices at every stage of the candidate and employee journey. Employment decisions are based on merit, experience and business needs.

Benefits


At Gen Digital, we are committed to supporting our employees’ well-being and professional growth. Our comprehensive benefits package for UK team members includes:

  • Health & Wellbeing – Company-paid private medical insurance, dental and vision benefits, plus access to mental health and wellbeing support through our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP).

  • Financial Security – A Group Personal Pension Plan with auto-enrolment for eligible employees, together with the opportunity to purchase Gen stock through our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off – available once statutory annual leave has been used, plus company holidays and a range of leave options to support personal and family needs.

  • Tuition Reimbursement – Up to £5,150 per calendar year for job-related accredited courses that support career development within Gen.

  • Wellness Reimbursement – Up to $450 per year to cover fitness-related expenses.

  • Sustainability Allowance – A $500 annual sustainable home improvement allowance.

  • Additional Perks – Access to adoption assistance, family support services, legal assistance plans, and exclusive employee discounts.

title: Creative Director (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Jobbeschreibung

Über Teaching Socials

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 25 High-Performern hat innerhalb von 2 Jahren ein konstantes Monatswachstum von über 750.000 € aufgebaut. Wir verbinden Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum in einem System – und du sorgst mit deinen Videos dafür, dass aus Ideen Reichweite, aus Zuschauern qualifizierte Leads und aus unserer eigenen Marke messbare Ergebnisse werden.

Deine Aufgaben

Content-Strategie: Du entwickelst für uns einen Content-Plan für die nächsten Wochen und leitest daraus einen klaren Produktionsplan für die Cutter ab.

  • Ideen und Skripte: Du findest die Themen, Hooks und Titel für alle Hauptvideos auf YouTube und schreibst die Skripte selbst.
  • Dreh: Du begleitest Drehs, verstehst Kamera, Licht und Ton und greifst selbst zur Kamera, wenn es nötig ist.
  • Schnitt und Qualität: Du gibst jedes Video frei, bevor es online geht. Was nicht gut genug ist, geht zurück.
  • Cutter-Führung: Du führst das Cutter-Team, gibst regelmäßig konkretes Feedback und machst jeden Editor messbar besser.
  • Shortform und Ads: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus jedem Longform-Video verwertbare Clips und Ad-Creatives entstehen.
  • Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung: Du führst die Weeklys, erklärst, was produziert wird und warum, und vertrittst deine Entscheidungen auch dann, wenn jemand anders denkt.

Was für dich drin ist

  • Reichweite ab Tag eins: Du arbeitest mit einer der größten Educational-Creator-Marken im DACH-Raum
  • Starkes Team: Familiäres Umfeld, gemeinsame Erfolge und Geburtstage
  • Schnelle Wege: Deine Ideen werden intern umgesetzt, statt in endlosen Entscheidungsschleifen zu versanden
  • Direkter Impact: Deine Videos beeinflussen unmittelbar Reichweite, Leads und Umsätze
  • Führung: Du führst ein eigenes Cutter-Team und prägst, wie bei uns Content entsteht

Das bringst du mit

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung als Content Creator, Video Producer oder Head of Content, idealerweise mit Fokus auf YouTube-Longform, Shortform und Video-Ads
  • Ein Portfolio mit Videos, die du verantwortet hast, idealerweise mit messbaren Ergebnissen wie Views, Klickrate und Zuschauerbindung
  • Fundiertes Verständnis dafür, was ein Video viral macht: Hook, Titel, Thumbnail, Storytelling und Retention
  • Starkes Gespür für Ideen und Skripte: Du schreibst YouTube-Skripte selbst, die Zuschauer bis zum Ende halten
  • Editing auf hohem Niveau: Longform, Shortform und cinematic – idealerweise bist du selbst Creator
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kamera, Licht und Ton: Du kannst selbst drehen
  • Verständnis für Video-Ads und ihre Rolle im Funnel und in der Customer Journey
  • Sicherer Umgang mit relevanten Kennzahlen wie CTR, Zuschauerbindung, Views und CPL
  • Führungserfahrung: Du steuerst mehrere Cutter gleichzeitig, planst Produktion und gibst Feedback, das dein Team besser macht
  • Souveräne Kommunikation: Du führst Weeklys und vertrittst deine Content-Entscheidungen auch gegenüber den Foundern
  • Hohe Standards: Kein Video verlässt dein Team, hinter dem du nicht selbst stehst
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen, sondern bringst eigene Ideen und Trends ein
  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau
  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Podcast- und Event-Drehs sowie tiefes Technik-Verständnis (Kamera-Setups, Equipment, Workflows)

Du passt eher nicht zu uns, wenn …

  • du lieber schöne Bilder produzierst, statt Videos, die Reichweite und Nachfrage erzeugen
  • du nur schneiden willst und Ideen, Skripte und Strategie anderen überlässt
  • du dich auf Bauchgefühl verlässt und Klickrate, Retention und Views ignorierst
  • du Videos rausgibst, hinter denen du selbst nicht stehst
  • du Trends anderer kopierst, statt eigene Ideen und Formate zu entwickeln
  • du Feedback persönlich nimmst oder deinem Team kein klares Feedback geben willst
  • du lange an einem einzelnen Video feilst, aber Schwierigkeiten hast, im Volumen zu liefern
  • du Deadlines eher als Empfehlung siehst
  • du nicht klar sagen magst, wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, auch gegenüber der Geschäftsführung
  • dich klare Ziele, Zahlen und ein performanceorientiertes Umfeld eher abschrecken
  • du einfach nur einen Job suchst und nicht bereit bist, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln

Stellenanforderungen

title: Customer Delivery Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wanna join the adventure? Customer Delivery Engineers (CDEs) own the end-to-end deployment and execution of customer satellite missions at Loft. We serve as the primary technical interface to our customers and translate mission objectives into operational reality, from early requirements and ConOps development through commissioning, on-orbit operations, and continuous improvement. CDEs operate real spacecraft and work directly with customers to build mission applications on top of Loft’s API and operational infrastructure. You will translate mission objectives into executable workflows, configurations, and tooling that ensure reliable, scalable on-orbit execution. You will sit at the intersection of satellite operations, customer engineering, software development, systems engineering, and program execution, delivering meaningful outcomes for every mission you support.
About this role:
  • Serve as the primary technical interface for customer missions, aligning on objectives, managing expectations, and ensuring mission success
  • Own the full mission lifecycle, from requirements definition and ConOps design through launch, commissioning, on-orbit execution, anomaly triage, and long-term optimization
  • Operate Loft spacecraft and payloads on orbit, driving mission execution, anomaly resolution, and performance optimization across the fleet
  • Work directly with customers to design and implement mission applications on Loft’s API and operational framework, enabling effective and scalable on-orbit operations
  • Develop mission tooling and automation in Python to improve reliability, adoption, and operational scale
  • Translate operational experience and customer feedback into concrete product improvements and roadmap input

    • Must haves:
  • 3+ years of experience in an operational engineering environment, such as satellite operations, forward deployed engineering, production infrastructure, backend or platform engineering for live products, or other mission-critical systems
  • Experience with satellite operations, spacecraft commissioning, or AIT
  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to production systems operating in real-world, mission-critical environments
  • Experience diagnosing and resolving issues in complex, multi-layered systems by tracing failures across interfaces and dependencies
  • Strong Python scripting skills and comfort building automation for operational systems
  • Experience working across software systems, APIs, and infrastructure such as Docker or similar DevOps environments
  • Ability to operate effectively in dynamic, high-pressure environments where requirements evolve and real-time decisions matter
  • Strong communication skills and experience working directly with customers or cross-functional stakeholders

    • Nice to haves:
  • Experience with spacecraft subsystems such as guidance and control, power systems, or communications systems
  • Experience integrating external systems into larger operational architectures
  • Experience with configuration languages such as CUE
  • Experience operating within a full product lifecycle, translating real-world usage and feedback into system or tooling improvements
  • Experience working with international or cross-cultural teams

    • Some of our awesome benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    • *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.
    Who We Are
    Loft: Space Made Simple.
    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.
    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.
    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

title: Customer & Product Manager (CPM) (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About BMZ Battery Solutions GmbH

The BMZ Group specialises in innovative, bespoke battery systems and energy storage solutions. Drawing on our technological expertise, international collaboration and a clear focus on our customers, we develop high-performance, cost-effective and sustainable solutions for the energy supply of tomorrow.

What sets us apart? We take responsibility, think entrepreneurially and are constantly evolving.

As Customer & Product Manager (CPM) (m/f/d), you will be the key internal liaison between Sales, Engineering, Procurement, Quality and Production. You will coordinate our products and projects throughout the entire product life cycle, reconcile technical and commercial requirements, and ensure that customer requirements are translated into successful solutions through collaborative effort.

Your responsibilities

  • Centralised internal coordination of bespoke products and projects throughout the entire product life cycle – from requirements definition through development and industrialisation to series production support

  • Coordination and management of internal interfaces between Sales, Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Production and other relevant departments

  • Ensuring the cross-departmental implementation of customer requirements, taking into account technical feasibility, cost-effectiveness, quality and adherence to deadlines

  • Supporting development processes, product changes, industrialisation and the start of series production, as well as tracking agreed measures

  • Early identification and assessment of technical, economic and organisational risks, and coordination of appropriate countermeasures

  • Transparent presentation of project and product status, decision-making requirements and relevant information for Sales, segment management and the relevant specialist departments

Your Profile

Education & Qualifications

  • A degree in engineering or industrial engineering, or a comparable qualification

  • Several years’ experience in technical project management, product management or a comparable cross-functional coordination role

  • A broad technical understanding of industrial products, ideally battery systems, including development, electronics, quality and manufacturing processes

Personality & Methodological Skills

  • Customer Focus: The ability to understand customer requirements conveyed by the sales team and to consistently align their internal implementation with the best possible customer solution

  • Ownership & Responsibility: A strong sense of responsibility, an entrepreneurial mindset and consistent follow-up on cross-functional tasks and results

  • Trust & Teamwork: Strong communication, facilitation and coordination skills to bring different specialist departments together constructively

Your benefits

You will have access to career training, mentoring sessions, and flexible working hours. We provide a company pension plan, private pension options, a company car, a company cellphone, and a company laptop. Additional perks include employee discounts, free parking, and the option to bring pets to the workplace, along with 28 vacation days per year.

Your first months at BMZ Battery Solutions GmbH

From day one, you will coordinate internal teams to turn customer requirements into successful battery solutions. Working closely with Sales, Engineering, Quality and Production, you will ensure smooth collaboration throughout the product lifecycle. If you combine technical understanding, ownership and a strong customer focus, we encourage you to apply.

title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unsere Kunden sind Hausverwaltungen, die über Getmomo Kautions-, Miet- und Rücklagenkonten führen. Als Customer Success Manager begleitest du unsere Kunden dabei, Getmomo erfolgreich in ihren Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren und ihre Prozesse rund um Kautionen, Mieten und Rücklagen einfacher zu gestalten. Du bringst neue Kunden in unserer Software an den Start, bist für Fragen da, findest heraus, wo im Bestand Potenzial liegt, und entscheidest selbst, wie wir unsere Kunden informieren.

Auf einen Blick:

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit

  • Hybrid: 4 Tage pro Woche im Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg, 1 Tag remote

  • Start: ab sofort

Das machst du bei uns:

  • Neue Kunden zum Laufen bringen: Sobald ein neuer Kunde startklar ist, lädst du zum Onboarding ein, hältst die Termine und begleitest die ersten Wochen, bis der Kunde sicher mit unserer Software arbeitet.

  • Potenziale im Bestand finden: Du wertest mit unseren internen Tools aus, welche Kunden bisher nur einen Teil unserer Produkte nutzen, wo das größte Potenzial liegt, und wer jetzt angesprochen werden sollte. Daraus entwickelst du Kampagnen, führst die Gespräche und machst deinen Erfolg messbar. Du arbeitest dabei mit denselben Systemen wie unser Kontoeröffnungsteam: Salesforce, unser eigenes AI-natives ERP und KI-Assistenten.

  • Du entscheidest, wie unsere Kunden informiert werden: Du entwickelst Formate, mit denen wir neue Produkte und Funktionen verständlich vermitteln. Dazu gehören Webinare, Mailings, Anleitungen und Hilfeartikel. Was gut funktioniert, testest du, misst die Ergebnisse und entwickelst es weiter.

  • Fragen klären und Probleme lösen: Am Telefon und per E-Mail hilfst du Kunden bei Fragen zu unserer Software, zu Zahlungen und Zugängen. Dazu gehören auch laufende Anliegen im Bestand wie Online-Banking-Zugänge oder Kontoschließungen. Was du nicht selbst lösen kannst, gibst du an die richtige Stelle im Team und bleibst dran, bis der Kunde eine Antwort hat.

  • Zuhören und weitergeben: Du holst Feedback ein, etwa über unsere Kundenumfrage, erkennst Muster und bringst sie ins Team. Mit dem Feedback unserer Kunden gestaltest du unser Produkt aktiv mit und kannst ihre Wünsche direkt in die Weiterentwicklung einbringen. So wirst du zum Wunscherfüller für unsere Kunden.

  • Abläufe smarter gestalten: Du erkennst, wo wir Abläufe vereinfachen, automatisieren oder mit KI besser lösen können, und setzt diese Ideen gemeinsam mit dem Team um. So machst du unsere Arbeit effizienter und schaffst mehr Zeit für unsere Kunden.

Woran du deinen Erfolg merkst:

  • Neue Kunden arbeiten schnell und sicher mit unserer Software.

At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilizing the the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform in your customers. You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability to our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage on Databricks workloads that they have already selected, helping them maximise the value they get of our platform and the return on investment.

This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestration of other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon. This is in parallel to being technical, with expectations being that you become the post-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate at all levels with an organisation. You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization. 

The impact you will have:

  • Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritised customers
  • Lead the post-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
  • Be the accountable technical leader assigned to specific use cases and customer(s) across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, success, go-live and healthy consumption of the workloads where the customer has made the decision to consume Databricks
  • Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
  • Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services and Support resources, along with escalating to expert level technical experts to build the right tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise
  • Create, own and execute a point-of-view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
  • Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews and upgrade needs
  • Develop an execution plan that covers all activities of all customer-facing technical roles and teams to cover the below work streams:
    • Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production
    • Enablement / user growth plan
    • Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)
    • Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning & optimization)
    • Executive and operational governance
  • Provide internal and external updates - KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, covering investment status, important risks, product adoption and use case progression - to your Technical GM

What we look for:

  • 5+ years of experience where you have been accountable for technical project / program delivery within the domain of Data and AI and where you can contribute to technical debate and design choices with customers
  • Programming experience in Python or Spark
  • Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role
  • Understanding of solution architecture related distributed data systems
  • Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables
  • Technical program, or project management including account, stakeholder and resource management accountability
  • Experience resolving complex and important escalation with senior customer executives
  • Experience conducting open-ended discovery workshops,  creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis and managing delivery of complex programmes/projects
  • Track record of overachievement against quota, Goals or similar objective targets
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience
  • Can travel up to 30% when needed

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
SpAItial is pioneering Physically-grounded World Models, a new AI paradigm designed to generate and reason about the appearance and physics of real and imagined environments. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the geometry of our world, redefining how industries from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema create and interact with 3D environments.

We are looking for our first Design Engineer to own the design system and product experience across SpAItial's web and mobile surfaces. You will translate the company brand into reusable product patterns, clear interaction models, and production-quality front-end experiences that you can help design and ship.

You will work closely with product engineers to design how people create, explore, and edit 3D worlds across web and mobile. You own product design, interaction models, reusable components, prototypes, and production front-end implementation. This is a hands-on role for someone equally comfortable maintaining a design system, resolving the details of a complex product flow, and shipping high-quality interfaces.

We care far more about the quality and range of your work than where you have worked. Show us design systems you have built, web and mobile products you have shipped, and examples of how your designs held together from concept through implementation.

Responsibilities

  • Brand and design system. Translate SpAItial's brand into practical rules for typography, colour, iconography, layout, components, and interaction across product and company surfaces.

  • Design infrastructure. Own shared Figma libraries, components, variables, templates, and documentation so teams can build consistent experiences without redesigning common patterns.

  • Web product design. Design responsive experiences for world creation, the 3D viewer, editing, onboarding, accounts, and pricing or upgrade surfaces. Work with product engineers from early concepts through polished implementation.

  • Mobile product design. Design clear capture, upload, generation, and viewing journeys for mobile devices, accounting for camera workflows, permissions, progress states, failure recovery, and platform conventions.

  • Spatial interaction. Define how people move through and manipulate generated 3D worlds, including camera behaviour, navigation, selection, editing, and transitions. These interaction patterns are not established yet.

  • Website and company surfaces. Design the marketing site, careers pages, technical documentation, and reusable presentation templates as extensions of the same system used in the product.

  • Front-end implementation. Turn designs and prototypes into production-quality interfaces. Build reusable components, implement responsive behaviour and interaction states, and collaborate with product engineers through review and release.

Key qualifications

  • 4+ years of professional experience in product design, design engineering, digital product design, or a similar role.

  • A strong portfolio that includes a scalable design system and shipped web and mobile product work.

  • Strong systems thinking across typography, layout, colour, components, interaction states, and responsive behaviour.

  • Strong interaction and product-design fundamentals across responsive web and native mobile experiences, including accessibility and platform conventions.

  • Fluency in Figma, including components, variables, prototyping, and design systems that other people can use.

  • Able to write and ship production front-end code using React and TypeScript, or a comparable modern web stack, with strong attention to accessibility, responsiveness, performance, and maintainability.

  • Comfortable working directly with engineers, understanding implementation constraints, reviewing builds, and refining details through release.

  • High ownership and comfort with ambiguity. You will be the first person in this role and will define the design function.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing products involving 3D, spatial computing, cameras, creative tools, or technically complex workflows.

  • Familiarity with Gaussian splats, WebGL, Three.js, React Three Fiber, PlayCanvas, Blender, Unreal, AR, XR, or VR.

  • Experience with 3D web development using Three.js, React Three Fiber, PlayCanvas, WebGL, or similar tools.

  • Experience with native mobile design tooling or production mobile application stacks.

  • Experience building or extending a design system across both product and marketing surfaces.

At SpAItial, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure all candidates are treated fairly throughout the recruitment process.

title: DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer - Internship
descriptionHtml:
About Bitstack

It all started with an idea in 2021. Initially built to democratize Bitcoin in France, Bitstack has gone from a simple product that invests spare change in bitcoin, to a crypto-native bank bringing a better way to save, spend, and grow money to our 300K+ users. We want to rebuild finance from the ground up to empower people to achieve financial freedom by participating in a more open and inclusive financial system. We’re a small, ambitious team of operators. We believe in moving fast, sweating the details, and creating products people truly love. At Bitstack, you’ll have the opportunity to shape not just our products, but the culture and practices of our entire organization. Bitstack is backed by YC, leading VCs like 13books Capital, Stillmark, Serena, and many more. We are building a product our users love and we are just getting started!

The Role

Bitstack runs dozens of interconnected backend services on Google Cloud. As the engineering team grows, we want every engineer to be able to test their changes end to end, quickly and independently, before they reach our shared environments.

As part of the Infrastructure team, you will build a local test environment for our backend engineers and QA. The goal is simple: anyone can start our backend services and their dependencies on their own machine with a single command, reproduce real business scenarios and test asynchronous flows end to end. You will own the project from the initial assessment through to company-wide adoption.

What You'll Be Doing

1. Assessment & Recommendation

  • Learn our stack (Go and Python services, Bazel, Docker, Kubernetes, GCP) and map how our services depend on each other.

  • Evaluate the test tooling and emulators already in our codebase, as well as the tools available on the market.

  • Recommend an approach, and record your tooling choices and trade-offs in a decision log.

2. Building the Local Environment

  • Start with a pilot cluster of interconnected services and get it running locally with a single command.

  • Solve the real problems as they come up: configuration and secrets, service-to-service authentication, cloud dependencies (Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, databases, caches) and async workers.

  • Extend coverage cluster by cluster until every backend service is included.

3. Scenarios, Data & Adoption

  • Build seed data and scripts so that any user state, limit or time-based event can be reproduced and reset on demand.

  • Work with backend engineers and QA as your first users, gather their feedback and fix what breaks.

  • Write documentation clear enough for a new engineer to get set up on their own, and support the team through the switchover.

By the end of the internship, you will turn your decision log into a recommendation report and hand over a tool the team will keep maintaining.

You will gain hands-on experience with a production-grade microservices architecture on Google Cloud, and see how a platform tool is designed, built and adopted by an engineering team. You will learn how infrastructure decisions are made and documented, and work closely with backend, QA and infrastructure engineers, with mentoring from a DevOps engineer throughout.

What We're Looking For

  • Currently in the final year of an engineering school or Master’s degree (Bac+5) in Computer Science or a related field, and looking for a 6-month end-of-studies internship starting in early 2027.

  • Hands-on experience with Docker and a working knowledge of Kubernetes.

  • Comfortable with Linux and scripting (shell, Python or similar).

  • Previous experience with a cloud provider, through an internship, a project or coursework. GCP is a plus.

  • Experience with Go, Bazel or Docker Compose is a plus, but not required.

  • Curious and autonomous: you like to understand how a system fits together before changing it.

  • Able to explain technical trade-offs clearly, in writing and to the engineers who will use what you build.

  • Fluent in English. French is a plus.

  • Based in Paris or happy to relocate for the internship. Exceptional candidates elsewhere in France who’d prefer to work remotely are welcome to apply too.

Perks & Benefits

💻 3 days in the office in Paris (Bourse) and 2 days working remotely

🕑 Flexible working hours

🏄Team activities and annual offsites

🍉 Swile meal vouchers

Diversity & Inclusion

We hire talented and passionate people from all kinds of backgrounds, we don’t care about your age or where you studied. If you’re excited about the role but your past experience doesn’t match every bullet point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. What matters most is that you’re a builder at heart, you share our values, and you’re enthusiastic about our mission.

title: Director, Employee Relations & Compliance, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

This is our first Director of Employee Relations & Compliance for EMEA: a senior, hands-on role owning ER casework, employment law compliance and jurisdictional risk across Germany, the UK, Sweden, Italy, Spain and France.

Based in London, you'll be the standing authority on ER practice in the region. You'll own complex casework end to end, build dedicated ER capability where none exists today, and extend the strength we already have in Stockholm. You'll report to the EMEA People Director, with a path to running an independent function reporting to the CHRO as it scales.

What You'll Do

ER leadership and casework

  • Own complex casework end to end across every market: investigations, grievances, disciplinaries, PIPs and terminations for cause, to a consistently high, legally sound standard.

  • Be the escalation point when a matter turns complex, contested or legally weighted, for Local People Advisory and the wider People org.

  • Hold the bar on case handling: written scoping, contemporaneous documentation, balance-of-probabilities findings, and independent second review of any outcome that could end employment.

Compliance and jurisdictional risk

  • Own employment and ER compliance across all six markets: statutory notice and consultation, works council and union engagement, mandatory filings and register-keeping, and local implementation of the EU Whistleblowing Directive (disclosures run through a separate channel).

  • Maintain the EMEA jurisdiction playbook and horizon-scan for legal changes, flagging implications to leadership early.

  • Engage Employment Counsel at the right moment with a clear written scope, not as a late rescue.

  • Note: comp-related compliance (pay equity, gender pay gap, benefits) sits with Rewards.

Team and capability building

  • Build dedicated ER capability across EMEA, prioritised by risk and case volume, on the foundation of the Stockholm team.

  • Certify and calibrate anyone running a formal ER process, keeping casework consistent as the team grows.

Stakeholder partnership and consistency

  • Act as the quality check for Local People Advisory across EMEA (who sit in People Operations), signing off local ER and compliance work without managing those roles day to day.

  • Partner with People Partners, People Operations, People Tech and Rewards so policy and tooling reflect what EMEA markets need.

  • Turn case patterns into a regular, actionable view for People leadership.

  • Work with your NORAM and APAC counterparts on one shared case taxonomy, system and calibration forum, representing EMEA's regulatory and cultural nuance in global standards.

What You'll Bring

  • Significant experience leading ER, HR compliance or similar at a fast-scaling company, ideally across multiple EMEA jurisdictions.

  • Deep, practical knowledge of employment law and ER practice across several of these markets, and comfort working outside your home jurisdiction.

  • A track record of investigations, disciplinaries and terminations that hold up to scrutiny: calm, neutral and thorough under pressure.

  • Experience building an ER or compliance function from the ground up: process, hiring, and getting a distributed team to one standard.

  • Confidence as a senior, independent voice, comfortable escalating to and influencing leadership.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to London, able to travel across EMEA.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every formal ER matter across the region handled fairly, consistently and to a legally sound standard.

  • A resourced, capable EMEA ER team, built out from London to the markets that need it.

  • The wider People org treats this function as the standing authority on ER and compliance, not a bottleneck.

  • A function ready to stand on its own, with a credible case for direct CHRO reporting.

title: Director, Enterprise, France
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

We're expanding our senior commercial leadership footprint across France to accelerate growth across Airwallex's enterprise solutions. You'll lead the enterprise commercial organisation in France, combining strategic direction with operational sales execution across a complex, multi-product platform.

  • Lead and scale an enterprise commercial organisation of 30+ people, including three Enterprise Sales Directors, to drive performance, accountability and operational excellence across France.

  • Own France's enterprise KPI and total regional revenue performance, introducing the sales discipline, forecasting rigour and ways of working needed to support sustained growth.

  • Define and execute the enterprise commercial strategy across core target verticals, expanding market share across Airwallex's full platform, including global business accounts, FX and treasury, spend management, global payments and embedded finance.

  • Sponsor and help close strategic, high-value enterprise opportunities worth $2M+ in contract value, building trusted relationships with French C-suite stakeholders and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes.

  • Partner with regional and global leadership, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Solutions Engineering and Product to turn market insight into stronger GTM execution, product alignment and seamless enterprise client onboarding.

You'll work from our Paris, France office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 12+ years of experience in B2B enterprise sales within high-growth fintech, payments or enterprise software/SaaS environments.

  • 5+ years of direct people management experience, including experience managing managers and Director-level sales leaders.

  • A track record of leading a sizable enterprise sales organisation of 30+ people.

  • A personal track record of closing or sponsoring complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals valued at $2M+ ACV.

  • Experience leading sales turnarounds, implementing new ways of working and establishing high-performing sales cultures in scaling organisations.

  • Deep experience in complex, multi-product platform selling, such as cross-border payments, global banking infrastructure, FX and treasury or developer platform SaaS.

  • A pure commercial leadership background focused on revenue execution, pipeline growth and deal closing, rather than general operations or general management.

  • Professional fluency in French and English, and based in or willing to relocate to France.

title: Embedded Electrical Engineer - SoM
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

As an Embedded Electrical Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to design the compute modules and associated boards used across our platforms. You will own these designs end-to-end, from system architecture and schematic through layout guidance, fabrication, bring-up, and qualification. This is a high-impact role that combines demanding high-speed design work with hands-on bench work, taking hardware from a first prototype through to boards that fly.

Responsibilities

  • Board Design: Design SoMs, baseboards, and test boards for our compute platforms.

  • High-Speed Digital Design: Design around high-end application processors, covering PCIe, 10 Gb Ethernet, USB 3.x, and MIPI, managing layout constraints and signal integrity.

  • Power Design: Design power trees, sequencing, and conversion topologies, and verify power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Design Reviews: Prepare and lead design reviews at each milestone, from block diagram to release for fabrication.

  • Manufacture: Work with PCB and EMS partners on stack-up, via technology, layout guidance, and cost trade-offs.

  • Bring Up and Qualification: Define verification test plans, troubleshoot and characterise boards, and run thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the embedded software team through board bring-up, the mechanical team on form factor and thermal constraints, and validation for flight qualification.

Candidate requirements

  • Educational Background: MSc in electrical, computer, or a related engineering field. A PhD is a plus. A hands-on design and bring-up record matters more than the specific degree.

  • Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded hardware design, with boards taken from specification through bring-up and qualification into production.

  • Technical Expertise: High-speed design including layout constraints, signal integrity, and validation. Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. Power trees with deliberate conversion topologies and verified power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Tools: In-depth knowledge of electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium).

  • Testing Proficiency: Proficiency with electronic test equipment and experience planning thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Manufacturing: Experience working with fabrication and assembly partners on stack-up, via technology, and cost trade-offs.

  • Problem Solving: Rigorous, structured, and analytical; able to work autonomously and see a board from concept through to production.

  • Communication and Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to present design and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Additional Skills: FPGA or MPSoC design, prior work deploying AI inference on embedded targets, and UAS, drone, or defence hardware experience are strong advantages.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Embedded Software Engineer - N3XT (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
The Embedded Engineer brings N3XT’s hardware to life. You write firmware for sensor front-ends, payload controllers, power systems and communication modules, bring up new boards with the hardware engineers, and build the low-level interfaces the application software depends on.

Prototypes in N3XT move fast. A board designed a few weeks ago lands on your bench, runs your firmware the same day and is on the test field by the end of the week. You sit between hardware and software and keep both sides honest about timing, power and interfaces.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Develop firmware in C and C++ for microcontrollers and SoCs (e.g. STM32, NXP i.MX, Xilinx Zynq), bare-metal or on an RTOS.

  • Bring up new boards together with the hardware engineers: drivers, peripherals, debugging with JTAG, oscilloscope and logic analyser.

  • Implement communication interfaces and protocols: CAN, UART, SPI, I²C, Ethernet, USB and radio links.

  • Integrate embedded Linux on compute modules: bootloader, kernel configuration, device tree and drivers.

  • Write real-time firmware for sensor acquisition and control, with attention to timing, power and reliability.

  • Define and document the interfaces to the application software and to the autopilot.

  • Support field tests and diagnose problems directly on the hardware.

  • Document firmware and interfaces for handover to line engineering.


What you bring to the team:

  • Degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, mechatronics or a related field.

descriptionHtml:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll join Pigment’s Reporting & Collaboration community, working as a senior hands-on Frontend Engineer on some of the most complex parts of the product.

This community is responsible for how users access, configure and interact with their data. That creates significant frontend challenges around large-scale datasets, filtering, visualisation, complex configuration and increasingly AI-powered experiences.


On the engineering part:
  • Spend approximately 80% of your time as a hands-on engineer, designing, building and shipping production features.
  • Work on complex, data-heavy frontend problems where performance, usability and scale all matter.
  • Build sophisticated interfaces for displaying, filtering and interacting with large datasets.
  • Work with React, TypeScript and JavaScript, while contributing to the wider technical decisions behind the product.
  • Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Designers and Engineers to take features from problem definition through to production.
  • Make pragmatic engineering decisions based on the needs of the product and its users, rather than pursuing technical complexity for its own sake.
  • Contribute to areas across Reporting & Collaboration depending on business needs and your interests, including data extraction and filtering, visualisation, complex configuration and emerging AI experiences.
  • Use modern engineering tooling, with Pigment teams working across GCP, CircleCI and AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

    • This is not a traditional Engineering Manager role where you step away from the code. You will remain a senior individual contributor and be expected to ship.


    On the people management part, here is what it entails:

    At Pigment, people management and technical leadership are deliberately separated.

    Tech Leads lead the technical direction of individual teams. Engineering Managers focus on developing engineers as people while remaining hands-on engineers themselves.

  • Spend approximately 20% of your time on people management.
  • Gradually take on direct reports after establishing yourself as an IC during your probation period.
  • Coach engineers across different teams within the Reporting & Collaboration community.
  • Support engineers with career progression, development, feedback and performance.
  • Run regular 1:1s and help engineers understand what they need to do to progress.
  • Set clear expectations and provide actionable feedback.
  • Handle difficult performance conversations when necessary and follow through with clear development plans.
  • Partner with Tech Leads to understand how your reports are performing technically without taking ownership of the Tech Lead's responsibilities.
  • Help create an environment where strong engineers can continue to develop while doing their best work.

    • Engineering Managers typically support engineers across multiple teams within their community rather than "owning" a single engineering team.


    Who you are

    We’re looking for someone who is both a strong senior Frontend Engineer and an experienced people manager.

  • Significant professional software-engineering experience, with the technical depth expected of a senior engineer.
  • Strong recent hands-on frontend engineering experience.
  • Production experience with React, TypeScript and/or JavaScript.
  • Previous formal people-management experience. Ideally, you have already managed engineers rather than looking for your first management opportunity.
  • Experience owning areas such as coaching, career development, feedback and performance management, not simply mentoring engineers or leading projects.
  • Experience building complex product interfaces, ideally within B2B SaaS, enterprise software, analytics, data platforms or another sophisticated data-heavy product.
  • Experience solving frontend problems involving areas such as large datasets, visualisation, filtering, configuration, performance or complex workflows.
  • A strong product mindset. You care about what you're building, who is using it and whether it genuinely solves their problem.
  • Strong collaboration skills across Engineering, Product and Design.
  • The ability and desire to remain deeply hands-on in the code while managing people.
  • The autonomy expected of a senior IC: once you understand the problem, you can work with the team to move it forward without needing constant direction.
  • Fluent English. French is not required.

  • Competitive salary
  • Equity
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue is entirely free for you and your family 💙
  • Trust and flexible working hours
  • Brand new offices in the heart of Paris, London, New York, and, Toronto

title: Enterprise Customer Success
descriptionHtml:
About 2501

2501 builds autonomous AI agents that operate directly in the shell to complete real production tasks - not just synthetic evals. We treat LLMs as pluggable brains, mixing open‑source and flagship models to get the best result. By fusing their output with observability data we surface root causes fast and automate the dull parts of incident response for corporate engineering teams who can’t afford downtime.

We’re a tight‑knit team of DevOps, Platform, and Infra engineers who ship fast, learn constantly, and elevate each other every day.

Why 2501 ?

We use AI to solve real problems in the underlying layers of every IT stack. We build what is the future of IT, ensuring every brick of our clients’ infrastructure is up and running.

We discovered an amazing opportunity to make IT more reliable and modern and we’re building the best way to make it a reality. Our customers and investors are backing this with strong commitment and foresee in our mission the future of IT.

We’re backed by three leading European VC funds, giving us the resources to aim high and take risks. And we’re just getting started!

What you’ll do

  • Own post-sale relationships with our largest enterprise accounts - banking, telco, and large IT organizations.

  • Drive adoption and expansion of 2501 agents inside complex infrastructure environments.

  • Be the bridge between the business and the technical teams, translating goals into outcomes.

  • Reduce churn by making customers wildly successful and spotting risk before it grows.

  • Partner with product and engineering to feed real customer signal back into the roadmap.

Who you are

  • Enterprise CS or TAM background in infrastructure, DevOps, or observability.

  • Technical enough to talk shop with SRE and platform teams.

  • Calm and credible under enterprise pressure, with a track record of growing accounts.

  • Bilingual French & English speaker and based in or near Paris. (Please don’t apply if you don’t have the right to work in France, we are not offering visa sponsorship for this role and language requirements are mandatory)

  • Startup or tech scaleup experience would be a plus, you need a high degree of autonomy and ownership

Not for you if

  • You want a purely reactive support-desk role.

  • You’d rather not get hands-on with technical infrastructure conversations.

Why you’ll enjoy working here

  • Fully remote – work from anywhere in the EU; we have a soft preference for the Paris region or somewhere easily reachable, and keep core hours in CET for smooth collaboration.

  • Competitive pay & meaningful equity – you own a piece of what you build.

  • Small global team, big impact – your work ships to users the same day. We’re still small enough that every new hire changes the company; this isn’t a seat maintaining a corner of a big machine. People joining now will help shape the product, the engineering culture, and the way we build agents for enterprise infrastructure.

  • Learn from the best – Built by people who’ve done it before. CTO Alex Zhuk ran the Shop Infrastructure Group at Shopify and spent years in platform and infra roles at Klarna and Omio; CEO Alexandre Pereira is on his third company. We only hire exceptional people, people who have built difficult things.

Hiring process

  • 30min Intro with recruiter

  • 30min Hiring Manager interview

  • 60min Live Scenario interview

  • 30min Coffee chat with CTO (Co-founder of 2501.ai)

How to apply

Send us something you’ve built or a few lines on why this role interests you.

We hire for skill, drive, and curiosity – not credentials.

title: (Enterprise) Platform Architect (76081)
descriptionHtml:
Wir suchen für einen unserer Kunden (Enterprise) Platform Architekten für ein ganzes Managed Capacity Team. Das Ziel ist es eine übergreifende Architektur (weiter-)zu entwickeln. Dabei ist zu klären, welche Themen / Fähigkeiten übergreifend, welche spezifisch für gewisse AI-Einsatzgebiete sind und welche lokal (je Projekt / Anwendung) gelöst werden.

Starke Faktoren für die Gestaltung der Architektur sind

• Sicherheit (Bedrohungen von aussen, von innen): Identität und Berechtigungen, Datenschutz und Datenklassifizierung.

• Regulatorik und Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Audit

• Enabling (AI Technologien einfach nutzbar machen, Self-Service, automatisierte Compliance)

• Kosten und Wirtschaftlichkeit

• Qualität und Verlässlichkeit, Betrieb und Resilienz

• Passung in die bestehende IT-Landschaft, Migrationsfähigkeit

• Integration und Interoperabilität

Das Team arbeitet eng mit den verantwortlichen Stellen und Fachpersonen des Endkunden zusammen.

Gesucht werden Personen mit ausgewiesener Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung komplexer Enterprise- und Plattformarchitekturen. Erwartet wird insbesondere die Fähigkeit, strategische Zielbilder in konkrete Architekturentscheidungen, Standards, Plattformfähigkeiten und umsetzbare Roadmaps zu überführen.

  • Ausgewiesene Erfahrung mit AI-/GenAI-Architekturen in grossen Organisationen.
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von LLMs, RAG, agentischen Systemen und Protokollen wie MCP oder A2A sowie ihren Risiken (Prompt Injection, Datenabfluss, Halluzinationen)
  • Erfahrung mit Security-by-Design: Identity & Access Management (auch für nicht-menschliche Identitäten und Agenten), Datenklassifizierung, Zero Trust
  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Architektur für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen verständlich darzustellen, vom Management bis zum Entwicklungsteam
  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch gut
  • Mindestens 2 Referenzen in der Konzeption oder Umsetzung von AI-Plattformen oder Shared Services, z.B. AI Gateway, Model Hub, Agent Runtime, Vector Stores, Knowledge Management
  • Vertiefte Kenntnisse in Cloud und Container (Azure, AWS und/oder Kubernetes) sowie in API-Management
  • Erfahrung mit Observability für AI: Tracing, Evaluation und Quality Monitoring, Kostenerfassung, Audit Trail (z.B. OpenTelemetry, Langfuse oder Ähnliches)
  • Erfahrung in der Spezifikation von Services und in der Evaluation von Produkten anhand strukturierter Kriterien
  • Erfahrung in einer grossen, regulierten Organisation (öffentlicher Verkehr, Energie, Finanz, Verwaltung)
  • Kenntnis von Frameworks und Standards wie TOGAF, ArchiMate, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM
  • Erfahrung mit MLOps/LLMOps sowie Testing und Freigabe von Modellen und Agenten (Evals, Red Teaming,Guardrails)
  • Erfahrung mit Self-Service- und Platform-Engineering-Ansätzen (Developer Portal, Golden Paths)
  • Erfahrung mit Citizen Development und Low-Code-Plattformen (z.B. Power Platform)

descriptionHtml:
Über ELMI:

ELMI ist ein Technologieunternehmen
für batteriegestützte Ultra-Schnellladestationen. Unsere Mission ist
es, weit mehr als klassische Ladesäulen zu entwickeln: Wir schaffen intelligente Energielösungen, die flexibel mit den Anforderungen von morgen mitwachsen, Ressourcen schonen und Netze entlasten – und so die Energiewende Schritt für Schritt in die Praxis bringen.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle
Als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Business Development & Expansion bist du eine zentrale Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung unseres Markteintritts in den europäischen Raum. Dein Fokus liegt auf der fundierten Analyse und Bewertung neuer europäischer Märkte sowie der Erstellung von Business Cases, die als Entscheidungsgrundlage für die geplante Expansion dienen. Du begleitest den Aufbau der Europa-Expansion von den ersten Marktanalysen und Business Cases bis hin zur Entwicklung konkreter Umsetzungsschritte, erhältst dabei tiefe Einblicke in strategische Entscheidungsprozesse und hast die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich wie persönlich stark weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Business Cases zur Bewertung neuer Märkte und Expansionsmöglichkeiten in Europa
  • Durchführung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen zur Identifikation vielversprechender europäischer Zielmärkte
  • Erstellung von Präsentationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen für das Management
  • Mitarbeit bei der Automatisierung und Optimierung von Prozessen
  • Recherche zu regulatorischen, wirtschaftlichen und kulturellen Rahmenbedingungen einzelner europäischer Länder
  • Unterstützung bei der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Fachabteilungen und externen Partnern
  • Pflege und Weiterentwicklung interner Tools/Datenbanken (z. B. in Odoo) zur Unterstützung der Expansionsplanung
  • Eigenständige Bearbeitung kleinerer Projekte oder Teilaufgaben im Rahmen der Europa-Strategie

Qualifikation

  • Eingeschriebene:r Student:in der Betriebswirtschaftslehre (BWL), Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
  • Erste Erfahrung oder ausgeprägtes Interesse an Business-Case-Analysen und wirtschaftlichen Bewertungen neuer Marktchancen
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Excel und PowerPoint, insbesondere für Finanzmodelle und Präsentationen
  • Analytisches und strukturiertes Denkvermögen sowie eine zahlenaffine Arbeitsweise
  • Grundkenntnisse oder Interesse an Coding/Vibe-Coding
  • Interesse an internationalen Märkten und der Weiterentwicklung von Geschäftsstrategien für den europäischen Raum
  • Selbstständige, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Erfahrung mit ERP-, CRM- oder BI-Software (z. B. Odoo, Power BI, Tableau) von Vorteil
  • Von Vorteil: Programmiererfahrung, auch mit Unterstützung von KI

Benefits

  • Entspannte Arbeitsatmosphäre: Bei uns geht es professionell, aber unkompliziert zu – wir pflegen einen offenen und lockeren Umgang miteinander.
  • Kurze Wege & flache Hierarchien: Egal, ob Kolleg:in oder Geschäftsführung – bei uns zählt die Idee, nicht die Position.
  • Eigenverantwortung & Vertrauen: Du bekommst den Freiraum, deine Themen selbstständig voranzutreiben und eigene Ideen einzubringen.
  • Gemeinsam statt nebeneinander: Wir arbeiten eng zusammen, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und lösen Herausforderungen als Team.
  • Direkter Austausch: Fragen, Feedback und neue Ideen werden offen angesprochen – ohne unnötige Abstimmungswege.
  • Start-up-Mentalität: Wir geben Raum für neue Ideen, mutige Entscheidungen und eigene Lösungen. Nicht alles muss auf Anhieb perfekt sein – wir lernen aus unseren Erfahrungen und entwickeln uns gemeinsam weiter.
  • Technologie mit Sinn: Du arbeitest an innovativen, batteriegestützten Ladelösungen und gestaltest aktiv die Zukunft der Elektromobilität mit.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das die Zukunft der Elektromobilität gestaltet.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und vielleicht schon bald als Teil unseres Teams begrüßen zu dürfen!

Bewirb dich jetzt – und bring deine Energie dorthin, wo sie wirklich etwas bewegt!
