title: Expert Support Technique et Comptable (Télétravail complet possible - Grand Est)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 million de TPE/PME et plus de 7 000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Tu as une solide expérience en comptabilité et tu aimes comprendre comment fonctionnent les outils SaaS ?
Tu souhaites intervenir sur des problématiques complexes, à la frontière entre métier, produit et technologie ?
Rejoins Pennylane en tant qu’Expert·e Support Technique et Comptable.

Ton rôle
Tu prends en charge les sujets les plus complexes remontés par nos utilisateurs et nos équipes Support.
Ton objectif : comprendre l’origine des problèmes, qu’ils soient comptables, fonctionnels ou techniques, puis coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes Produit et Tech.
Tu joueras un rôle clé entre les utilisateurs, le Support, les développeurs et les équipes Produit.

Tes missions

  • Investiguer des bugs, anomalies et problématiques comptables ou fonctionnelles.

  • Reproduire les problèmes rencontrés et en identifier la cause.

  • Qualifier les incidents et coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes concernées.

  • Échanger avec les développeurs et le Produit pour transmettre des analyses claires et exploitables.

  • Utiliser les outils d’investigation disponibles : logs et SQL simple.

  • Documenter les solutions et contribuer à l’amélioration continue du produit et des process.

  • Partager ton expertise avec les équipes Support.


Le profil recherché

Tu peux venir de différents environnements : cabinet d’expertise comptable ou éditeur de logiciel comptable.

Nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • dispose d’une solide expérience en comptabilité et comprend les problématiques des cabinets et entreprises ;

  • a déjà travaillé sur des sujets complexes nécessitant analyse et coordination ;

  • est à l’aise avec les outils et problématiques techniques ;

  • sait communiquer clairement avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques ;

  • parle anglais dans un contexte professionnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral ;

  • fait preuve de rigueur, d’autonomie et de curiosité.

La connaissance de SQL est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable. Ce qui compte surtout, c’est ton envie de comprendre les systèmes et de monter en compétence sur les sujets techniques.

Pourquoi rejoindre Pennylane ?

Tu rejoindras une équipe au cœur de la qualité produit, en lien direct avec les utilisateurs, les développeurs et les équipes Produit. Tu travailleras dans un environnement international, en forte croissance, où ton expertise comptable aura un impact concret

Process de recrutement :

  • Premier échange un/e recruteur - 30 min

  • Étude de cas et debriefing avec deux membres de l’équipe - 60 min

  • Entretien avec le Manager direct - Thibault et Viviane (Associate Team Lead Technical Support) - 60 min

  • Entretien avec Thomas (Team Lead Technical Support) - 45 min

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou @pennylane-partners.com .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

title: Facilities Manager
descriptionHtml:
Facilities Manager

This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens.

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

title: Field Marketing Manager, Firefox Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We’re building a new B2B business for Firefox— bringing a privacy-first, data-safe browser and productivity bundle to European organizations. As we grow our EU-based demand generation team ahead of our Q1 2027 bundle launch, we’re looking for an experienced Field Marketing Manager for France based in France. You will independently own the regional field plan, budget and senior Sales partnership for the France region and broader EU enterprise market. You will turn named-account priorities into a focused portfolio of high-value executive and technical experiences, with particular attention to French-language delivery, local enterprise buying dynamics, and the needs of complex, multi-stakeholder organizations. You’ll work closely with Sales, Channel, Product Marketing, and Content teams to bring our go-to-market strategy to life on the ground, and you’ll help build the processes and playbooks this team relies on as it scales from a small pilot into a full regional function. This is a hands-on senior role for a marketer who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: selecting the few moments that matter, orchestrating cross-functional and agency support, and ensuring each program creates a clear next step for a priority account

What you'll do:
  • Co-create the quarterly France and EU market field plan with Sales, translating selected accounts, account stage and stakeholder priorities into a sequenced engagement plan.
  • Design and run a small portfolio of high-touch programs, including executive roundtables, private briefings, technical workshops, pilot-readiness sessions and a deliberately selected set of industry events.
  • Define the intended account outcome for every program: the target stakeholders, the desired meeting or next step, the pre-event engagement plan, the seller handoff and the follow-up assets required.
  • Own the France and EU market field budget, agency and vendor relationships, timelines, risk and execution quality; use shared Mozilla teams and the European agency for production, localization, PR, web and media operations.
  • Create and localize program narratives and assets into French in partnership with Product Marketing and Content, ensuring relevance for enterprise IT, security, privacy, procurement and business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing, Analyst Relations, Content/Creative, and Demand Gen colleagues to keep messaging consistent across the channel mix.
  • Develop locally relevant programs and assets with Product, Security and Solutions partners, who retain ownership of technical accuracy and validation.
  • Bring the voice of the French and EU market back to the team, including buyer concerns, competitor signals, account feedback and regional ecosystem insight; convert learning into better messaging, field playbooks and return-on-event decisions.
  • Build repeatable field operating rhythms and reporting, contribute to the 2027 launch and customer-proof plan, and create learning that supports 2028 European expansion.
  • Track and report on program performance, using pipeline and engagement data to refine regional tactics.
How Success will be measured:
  • Priority accounts progress to an agreed commercial, executive or technical next step.
  • The right stakeholders attend and engage; success is based on account quality and coverage, not attendee volume.
  • Sales accepts the handoff, completes follow-up and can see how each program contributed to account movement.
  • Executive meetings, technical workshops, pilot activity and procurement support increase in the selected account set.
  • Reusable French-language proof, playbooks and market insight are created on time and used by the team.
  • Programs meet quality, budget and operational commitments.
 What you’ll bring:
  • 5+ years of experience in field marketing, account-based marketing, enterprise events or regional go-to-market for B2B software, security or IT-managed products.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own a country or regional plan, budget, vendors and senior Sales relationships.
  • French native, fluent in English; German language skills preferred. Experience across the French market.
  • Strong understanding of complex enterprise buying groups, including IT, security, privacy, procurement and works council stakeholders.
  • Experience designing high-touch programs for named accounts and translating event activity into specific seller next steps.
  • Excellent project, agency and vendor management skills, with strong judgment about where to invest and what not to do.
  • A data-informed approach that combines program signals with account-level feedback and commercial context.
  • Comfort operating in an early-stage environment with ambiguity, high ownership and regular regional travel.
  • Excellent collaboration skills across marketing, sales, and cross-functional partners.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

👀 The Role

Number of Positions: 2

As Finance Manager, you’ll report to Reshma Nangpal and work closely with the broader finance team, including other Finance Managers, to deliver accurate, timely month-end accounting and financial control. This is a hands-on role covering bank and PSP reconciliations, sportsbook and casino revenue accounting, gaming duties and revenue-share payments. You’ll partner with Data, Compliance and Commercial teams, strengthen scalable processes and support Midnite’s growth across entities and markets. We’re hiring two people, with flexibility for mid-level and more senior accountants.

 

You will:

  • Deliver key aspects of the monthly close accurately and on time, including accounts payable, supplier invoices, staff expenses and company credit card reconciliations.

  • Perform and review bank reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, post bank fees and update month-end FX rates.

  • Own PSP reconciliations and monthly journals, matching settlement and transactional data to accounting records.

  • Maintain reconciliations for deferred revenue, player balances, prepayments and fixed assets, and accrue key supplier costs.

  • Prepare sportsbook and casino revenue journals and reconcile revenue and cost of sales to source data, including promotional deductions and adjustments.

  • Verify and accrue contractual revenue-share payments, share monthly data with casino suppliers and reconcile it to internal records; manage international partner revenue-share receivables and invoicing.

  • Calculate and accrue General Betting Duty, Remote Gaming Duty, the Horse Racing Levy, Statutory Levy and Economic Crime Levy.

title: Founding AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The problem

The construction industry loses $1.6 trillion a year to inefficiency, and most of it is avoidable. The knowledge that would prevent it already exists. It's just trapped in PDFs, meeting protocols, and email threads nobody can search. Every new project relearns what the last one already knew.

We're building the opposite of that: software for the people who run large, complex construction projects. It reads the documents, tracks the decisions, and catches the mistakes early. The model isn't the moat. The project memory is, and it compounds: every project makes the system better, and a competitor starting today is already years of projects behind.

Our software runs today on a live autobahn construction program and an S-Bahn transit program: multi-year timelines, hundreds of thousands of pages of specs, protocols, and site communications, and real consequences when we get an answer wrong.

We're pre-seed, led by Realyze Ventures, whose LPs include Zech and other large European construction groups. Co-investors: D11Z, the family office behind Aleph Alpha, and the CDTM Venture Fund, backed by 300+ CDTM alumni including the founders of Personio and Alasco and DeepMind's Technical Director. 25+ live customers.

Tasks

What you'd work on

Two problems, both of which need state-of-the-art answers.

Agent harness engineering for construction documents. One summary doesn't fit all. "Structural risk" means something different in an RFI, a cost review, and a schedule reconciliation. We build multi-agent harnesses (specialized extraction, reasoning, and evaluation stages) that route a 400-page tender document or a protocol archive into the right pipeline with the right context.
Part of that is context compression: what the system should remember, forget, and surface, and at which decision point, when a project runs five years and touches 50 stakeholders. There's no clean top-k answer, so this gets solved in production, not in a library. If you've read what Anthropic and Vercel have written about agent harnesses and thought "yes, that's the hard part of shipping production agents," this is the job.

Project memory as a compounding moat. We started with meeting transcripts. Now we're building a decision graph that grows with every project: not just what was decided, but why, by whom, against which alternatives, and how it played out. That graph feeds the next project. The hard part is reconstructing the "why" when it's buried in a messy German protocol. We want the person who finds that problem interesting.

Stack. TypeScript, Next.js, Vercel, Supabase (Postgres + pgvector), LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, LangFuse, shadcn/ui. Every engineer gets €500/month for AI tooling: Claude Code, Cursor background agents, and whatever frontier model you want to test. No legacy. Greenfield.

How we work

  • We ship at 80% and improve in the next iteration. Our users are on live infrastructure projects, so we learn from production.
  • We'd rather you read the paper than reach for the nearest library. Most of what we build doesn't have a library yet.
  • Feedback is direct and it's about the work. We move too fast to be precious about it.
  • High ownership. If you spot the problem, it's yours to fix.

Requirements

Who we're looking for

You reason from user pain to solution to measurable outcome, and you can sit across from a non-technical customer and understand how they actually work.

Since you own things end to end, that includes the frontend. That means being comfortable not only with the AI engineering side, but with TypeScript and React too.

You prototype fast and measure everything. You also care about reliability, because on a live construction project, wrong has consequences.

You're comfortable without a map. Most of these problems don't have answers yet, so you read papers, build prototypes, and compare approaches instead of waiting for a best practice to show up.

Level is open. If you're exceptional, we'll build the scope around you.

Nice to have, not required: serious open-source work, an earlier stint as an early employee at a startup, real depth in document understanding or agent systems, or something you shipped that replaced hours of human labor.

We work in English. German helps for customer calls but isn't required. We have native speakers for that.

Benefits

The offer

You'll be one of our first engineers, which means you own critical parts of the product end to end and work directly with the founders. It's early enough that you help decide how the company works, and the path from here goes to either top individual contributor or VP Engineering, depending on where you're strongest.

Equity: 0.5% to 1.5%, four-year vest, 1.5-year cliff.

Hybrid: three days a week in our central Munich office. If that's a dealbreaker for you, let's talk.

How hiring works

Three stages, no endless loops.

  1. A 30-minute call with one of our engineers.
  2. A 30-minute call with Vinzenz, our technical co-founder.
  3. An onsite case study in Munich. We send the materials ahead (plan on about 4 hours of prep), then we work through it together in the office. This is where we see how you think, debug, and ship under real conditions.

Offer decided within 24 hours of the case study, out within 48.

We started by giving lawyers and accountants a faster way to model client structures, and became the category leader doing it. You’ll help define a new software category with the backing of a loyal, global customer base. We hire people with high ownership and a bias for action, then trust them to do their best work.

You'll be Jigsaw's embedded data privacy advisor: the person product development and customer-facing teams turn to when a data or privacy question needs a real answer. This is a fractional role (starting at roughly 1-2 days a week in-office), working closely alongside our existing Legal team.

The focus for this role will be translating legal and technical complexity into commercially-focused, actionable responses to help free up teams to move quickly. In practice, this could be advising the product team on what compliance actions we need to take ahead of a new product release, making case-by-case decisions for customers with unique compliance requirements, or conducting analysis on customer DPAs ahead of a change to data processing locations, right through to how to answer a client's questions about our AI features.

This isn't a standardise-everything-and-leave role. We work with customers around the world in regulated industries (legal, financial institutions, accountancy and enterprises) with varying compliance needs, where one-size-fits-all templates aren't always an option and we need to adopt a flexible approach. The work here is genuinely ongoing, nuanced, and advisory rather than a project with an end date.


You'll get to...

  • Act as the go-to person for data and privacy questions across the business - in product meetings, customer rollout calls, and migration conversations

  • Turn specific customer contract terms into practical, commercial recommendations, weighing real risk instead of defaulting to "no"

  • Advise on cross-border and international data transfer questions, which come up constantly given our global customer base

  • Join customer calls to speak credibly with clients' own data privacy counsel, many of whom are lawyers or privacy specialists themselves

You'll need...

  • Genuine on-the-ground experience inside a tech company building product - this isn't a fit for a purely private-practice legal background

  • To be genuinely comfortable with cross-border and international data transfer questions

  • Excellent communication skills on two levels: credible and precise with legally sophisticated clients, and clear and accessible for non-legal internal teams

  • High ownership balanced with genuine collaboration, and able to build consensus

Nice-to-haves

Who should apply?

title: Full-stack Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Full Stack Engineer to join our Platform Team. In this role you build and own the internal software our engineers and production teams rely on every day: the applications that track what runs on every system we build, support our manufacturing and test processes, and turn operational data into better products. This is not a customer-facing web role: your users sit in the same building, and the tools you build directly determine how fast we can build, test and deliver.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • Design, build and own internal web applications end to end, covering frontend, backend, data model and deployment

  • Develop tooling that supports our manufacturing, where clarity and correctness in the user interface directly affect hardware outcomes

  • Build and maintain the configuration and traceability applications that connect our engineering, production and business systems into one coherent chain

  • Extend our ML and data tooling so that operational data flows reliably from the field into datasets, models and back into our systems

  • Integrate heterogeneous systems (PLM, ERP, version control, device fleet, data platform) through robust APIs and clean interfaces

  • Work directly with the engineers, operators and test teams who use your software, and translate their day-to-day problems into simple, durable solutions

  • Take ownership of the reliability of what you build, as these applications are part of our production and development critical path


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field

  • 4+ years of professional experience building and operating production web applications, with clear depth in at least one half of the stack and solid competence in the other

  • Strong backend engineering in a modern language such as Python, Java, Kotlin, C#, Go, TypeScript/Node or comparable. We care more about engineering strength than about prior exposure to a specific language, and expect strong engineers to pick up an unfamiliar stack quickly

  • Practical frontend experience with a component-based framework (React, Angular, Vue or similar) and the judgement to design an interface that people can use under time pressure

  • Sound relational data modelling and practical experience with relational databases

  • Confident with containerisation, version control workflows and CI/CD; able to deploy, monitor and debug your own services

  • Proven ownership of an internal tool or platform: gathering requirements from colleagues, scoping them realistically, and maintaining the result over time

  • A pragmatic engineer who builds robustly where correctness matters and deliberately simply everywhere else

  • Structured problem solver with a hands-on mindset and a bias toward shipping

  • Eager to work closely with a multidisciplinary team of software, hardware, production and flight test engineers

  • Fluent in English, German is beneficial

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with manufacturing, MES, PLM or ERP systems, or with software used on a production floor

  • Background in robotics, automotive, aerospace or other hardware-related engineering environments

  • Experience with data pipelines, data versioning or MLOps tooling

  • Working knowledge of container orchestration and infrastructure-as-code

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

descriptionHtml:
Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines (H/F)

Poste en CDD de 4,5 mois, basé à Brest, sur le port de commerce.

Depuis plus de 75 ans, Maritime Kuhn est un acteur incontournable du monde portuaire Français.

Grâce à ses agences locales et à l’expertise de près de 800 collaborateurs, Maritime Kuhn propose une gamme complète de services aux navires et aux activités portuaires.

Dans le cadre d’un remplacement pour congé paternité, la société Maritime Kuhn Services recherche un(e) Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines, en CDD, à partir du lundi 14 décembre 2026 jusqu’au vendredi 30 avril 2027. Le service ressources humaines du pôle de Brest (près de 150 collaborateurs) assure la gestion opérationnelle RH des sociétés implantées à Concarneau, Saint-Brieuc, Saint-Malo, Cherbourg et Brest.

Vos missions

Rattaché(e) à la Responsable des Ressources Humaines, vous participez au déploiement de la politique ressources humaines dans un environnement multisite. Véritable relais opérationnel, vous assurez la gestion quotidienne des activités ressources humaines et le suivi autonome des dossiers confiés, après validation de votre responsable.

À ce titre, vos principales missions sont :

· Administration du personnel et paie : préparer les éléments variables de paie en lien avec le cabinet comptable, gérer les dossiers des collaborateurs de leur embauche à leur départ et élaborer les tableaux de bord sociaux.

· Formation et compétences : assurer le suivi des formations, des relations avec les organismes et des demandes de financement auprès des OPCO.

· Droit social et protection sociale : veiller au respect de la réglementation, gérer le suivi des visites médicales, des absences et des dossiers de mutuelle, prévoyance et retraite.

· Recrutement : participer à l'identification des besoins, à la diffusion des offres et à la sélection des candidats.

· Relations sociales et communication RH : contribuer à la préparation des réunions avec les représentants du personnel, au suivi des obligations sociales et au développement de la marque employeur.

Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec l'équipe ressources humaines des autres pôles, les directions et les managers des différentes agences, ainsi qu'avec les partenaires externes.

Profil recherché

Issu(e) d’une licence ou d’un master ressources humaines, vous justifiez d’une première expérience réussie sur un poste généraliste, vous ayant permis d’acquérir une bonne maîtrise des fondamentaux de la gestion des ressources humaines.

À ce titre, vous disposez notamment :

· De solides connaissances en droit social et en réglementation du travail.

· D’une bonne compréhension des enjeux économiques et financiers de l’entreprise.

· D’une bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques et des logiciels de gestion des ressources humaines.

· D’une connaissance des processus d’administration du personnel, de gestion de la paie et du suivi des obligations sociales.

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous vous distinguez par vos qualités relationnelles et vos aptitudes professionnelles. Vous faites preuve :

· D’aisance relationnelle et d’un bon sens de l’écoute.

· De discrétion et de respect de la confidentialité.

· D’organisation et de rigueur dans la réalisation de vos missions.

· D’une capacité à gérer les priorités et à faire face aux imprévus.

· D’autonomie et de prise d’initiative.

· D’une aptitude à travailler en transversalité et à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés.

L’ensemble de ces compétences et qualités constituera un véritable atout pour réussir dans vos fonctions et contribuer efficacement aux missions du service ressources humaines.

title: Global Capability Centre UK Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Radiant

Radiant builds and operates AI-native cloud platforms for high-performance GPU workloads. Our infrastructure brings together data centres, compute, networking, storage and software to serve customers with demanding AI requirements.

As we grow internationally, we are establishing Global Capability Centres (GCCs) in several regions. These centres will provide specialist capability and operational support to teams across Radiant. We need a clear model for how each centre is launched, managed and connected to the wider business.

About the role

The Global Capability Centre UK Lead will help design, launch and scale Radiant’s GCCs. You will work closely with local GCC leaders and UK teams across People, Legal, Finance, IT, Security and Operations.

Your job is to make sure each centre has a defined purpose, an effective team structure, practical ways of working and the support it needs to deliver. You will also act as a point of contact and advocate for GCC leaders in the UK, helping resolve issues that span multiple teams or locations.

This is a hands-on, cross-functional role. You will help shape the overall model while also dealing with the details that determine whether a new centre works well from day one.

What you’ll do:

Plan and launch GCCs

  • Help assess potential locations based on talent availability, cost, time zones, regulation and operational needs.

  • Define the remit of each centre with local and UK leaders. Clarify which work belongs in the GCC, which stays with existing teams and how responsibilities may change as the centre grows.

  • Support launch plans, including the order in which centres and functions are established, key decisions, dependencies and transition milestones.

  • Coordinate with Legal, Finance, People and Security on entity setup, employment arrangements, data residency and other local requirements.

Build teams and operating models

  • Work with GCC leaders to design team structures, reporting lines and management layers that suit each stage of growth.

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition on headcount plans, hiring priorities and the skills needed to deliver each centre’s remit.

  • Align roles and career paths with Radiant’s global framework. Help local leaders plan for retention, succession and leadership development.

  • Define ownership, handoffs and escalation routes between GCCs and UK functions so work moves smoothly across teams and time zones.

  • Establish consistent core processes while adapting them where local law, customer requirements or operating conditions call for it.

  • Make sure onboarding, equipment, systems access and operational support are ready as teams join. Track time to productivity and address recurring blockers.

Connect GCCs with the wider business

  • Serve as the UK point of contact for GCC leaders, holding regular check-ins to surface risks, resolve issues and share good practice.

  • Bring together the right support from People, Legal, Finance, IT, Security and Operations when a centre needs a decision or intervention.

  • Help build effective communication and one Radiant culture across locations, while recognising the needs of local teams.

Manage governance and performance

  • Establish steering meetings and operating reviews with clear decisions, owners and follow-up actions.

  • Maintain a risk register for each centre covering people, delivery, security, compliance and commercial risks. Work with specialist teams on data protection, information security, export controls and local regulatory obligations.

  • Define useful measures for cost, hiring, productivity, retention, service quality and delivery. Report progress against each centre’s business case to Radiant leadership.

  • Identify when a GCC is ready to take on more complex or higher-value work, and help plan that expansion.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience building, launching, scaling or operating GCCs, shared service centres, delivery centres or similar international teams.

  • Strong experience in operating model design, organisation design and workforce planning. You can turn a broad plan into clear roles, processes and decisions.

  • Experience coordinating complex work across countries, cultures and functions, with the judgement to balance global consistency and local needs.

  • Commercial awareness and experience tracking budgets, business cases or operational performance.

title: GM, Sales (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Opportunity

Deepgram is expanding into EMEA, and we're seeking a GM, Sales to own the region — building and leading the Enterprise and commercial segments of our Account Executive team, establishing Deepgram's European home in London, and driving growth across the region.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You'll work with sales leadership to continue optimizing the systems, playbooks, and culture that scale ARR growth, while developing a high-performing team that converts opportunities into long-lasting customers. A core part of your mission is building Deepgram's next generation of sales talent through world-class training, coaching, and structured career development.

You'll also be more than a revenue leader. As our senior-most voice in EMEA, you'll bring what you learn in the field back into the company and shape what we build — regional product-market fit, roadmap priorities, and the technical requirements European enterprises hold us to.

You'll partner closely with Marketing, Sales Leadership, RevOps, Customer Success, and Product to align pipeline strategy and leverage modern AI tools to boost productivity, personalization, and team efficiency. Equal parts operator, coach, and builder, you'll combine data-driven rigor with creativity to shape how Deepgram grows its customer base and its sales talent.

What You'll Do

  • Scale the Region: Own the EMEA number. Build and execute a strategic roadmap to drive hyper-growth in ARR, from initial land to enterprise-wide expansion.

  • Open London: Stand up Deepgram's London office as our EMEA hub — and treat it as a commercial asset, not just real estate. It will host customer and developer events, executive briefings, partner sessions, and the team you build.

  • "Challenge & Lead": Recruit and mentor a high-performance team of Account Executives. Manage Customer Success, Marketing, and Forward Deployed Engineers in a dotted-line structure. You will instill a culture of "Challenger" selling — teaching AEs how to disrupt legacy incumbents and lead with technical ROI.

  • Shape the Product: Act as the voice of EMEA inside Deepgram. Translate field signal — deal losses, evaluation criteria, data residency and compliance requirements, language and accent coverage — into specific, prioritized input that changes what we build and when.

  • Build the Ecosystem: Identify and sign strategic regional partners, GSIs, and local resellers to act as a force multiplier for Deepgram's direct sales efforts.

  • Operational Excellence: Implement rigorous forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and territory management across multiple countries, languages, and buying cultures. You will bridge the gap between London and our US HQ.

  • C-Suite Influence: Act as the primary executive sponsor for major regional accounts, navigating complex procurement cycles and technical AI evaluations.

You'll Love This Role If You

  • Thrive on building and scaling high-performing teams that consistently beat targets.

  • Want to build something from the ground up — including the office, the team, and the regional playbook.

  • Value working with tenured, high-caliber leaders who prioritize clarity, accountability, collaboration, and execution.

  • Enjoy blending data-driven sales operations with creative, human-centered leadership.

  • Are energized by developing AEs and building a culture of growth and continuous learning.

  • Believe in the power of AI to transform productivity, and are eager to harness cutting-edge tools to optimize performance.

  • Are passionate about Deepgram's mission to redefine what's possible with speech technology.

It's Important to Us That You Have

  • Experience: 12+ years in B2B SaaS sales, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role (Director/VP) covering EMEA — including the UK and at least one of DACH, the Nordics, France, or Southern Europe.

  • The "Deepgram DNA": A deep fascination with AI, LLMs, and API-first products. You should be comfortable discussing technical architecture as easily as you discuss revenue targets.

  • Product Influence: You've done more than sell — you've changed what your company built. You can point to specific roadmap decisions, features, or product bets that happened because of how you brought the market back to Product and Engineering.

  • Proven Growth: A track record of scaling a regional business from early traction to high-scale maturity ($10M+ ARR growth experience preferred).

  • Partnership Prowess: Demonstrable experience building channel programs that significantly contribute to the total revenue mix.

  • High ASP Focus: Expertise in value-based selling to increase Average Selling Price and win rates in a competitive technical landscape.

  • Operational Rigor: Deep familiarity with modern sales stacks (Salesforce, Gong, Clari, etc.) and a commitment to data-driven decision-making.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree required; MBA or technical degree is a plus.

It Would Be Great If You Had

  • Experience opening a new office or first in-region presence for a US-headquartered company.

  • Experience leading AE organizations at a high-growth, Series B+ startup or scaling tech company.

We want to get more out of every channel and every market, and we never want to become boring while doing it.

New-customer acquisition is the heart of this role: with Meta and Paid Social at the core, the role steers all channels, decides where our goals sit and where the next euro is best spent, and builds complete funnels and advertorials across several countries. We are looking for a clear track record of growing a channel largely alone, paired with fresh ideas and the joy of working with colleagues who know Glow25 well.

This is an established business with a lot of data and strong foundations. Questioning how we do things today and improving it together with the teams is not just welcome, it is encouraged.

  • Paid Social Ownership: Deep hands-on expertise in Meta and Paid Social as the engine for new-customer acquisition and brand building, with real budget responsibility.

You have the following experience:

title: Growth Intern (m/w/d)

title: Growth Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Rund 74 % aller CO₂-Emissionen in Deutschland entstehen im Zusammenhang mit der Energieproduktion, das sind über 543 Millionen Tonnen pro Jahr.

Um die europäischen Klimaziele zu erreichen, müssen wir dieses Problem dringend und entschlossen angehen, und genau hier setzen wir bei Sunpeak Capital an.

Wir machen den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien investierbar und verwandeln Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und Ladeinfrastruktur in renditestarke Investments. Unser Ansatz verbindet Klimaschutz mit finanzieller Intelligenz: ein echtes Win-Win für Umwelt und Investoren.

Mit unserer Kombination aus spezialisierten Beratungsprozessen, innovativen Investmentstrukturen und einem breiten Netzwerk aus Projektentwicklern ermöglichen wir privaten und unternehmerischen Investoren, den Energiewandel aktiv mitzugestalten, profitabel und nachhaltig.

Wir skalieren unser Modell konsequent innerhalb Deutschlands, dort, wo die Energiewende entschieden wird. Werde Teil unseres Teams und trage dazu bei, dass Kapitalströme dorthin fließen, wo sie größten Klimanutzen und echte Rendite erzeugen.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du übernimmst unser Marketing von den Gründern und baust es weiter aus. Einiges läuft bereits, vieles existiert noch nicht. Dein Job ist es, daraus eine Growth-Maschine zu machen: Du verantwortest Lead-Volumen, Lead-Qualität und Akquisitionskosten, testest den Funnel konsequent durch und entscheidest, welche Kanäle wie viel Budget bekommen. Wir suchen keine Person, die Briefings abarbeitet und auch keinen reinen Creative, sondern jemanden mit Performance-Mindset, der Kanäle versteht, Tests selbst aufsetzt und das Thema Growth bei Sunpeak Capital zu 100 % eigenverantwortlich ownt.

  • Growth-Strategie und Budget: Du entwickelst mit den Gründern den Marketing-Plan, definierst Zielgruppen, Kanäle, Budgets und KPIs und steuerst Soll gegen Ist.

  • Performance-Marketing: Unsere bezahlten Kampagnen liegen komplett bei dir. Du skalierst, was funktioniert, testest laufend neue Kampagnen und Zielgruppen und optimierst auf Lead-Qualität, nicht nur auf Volumen. Neue Kanäle testest du an, wenn die Zahlen es hergeben.

  • Funnel und Conversion: Du baust und testest Landingpages und Funnels, optimierst Qualifizierung, Formulare und On-Page Conversion und sorgst dafür, dass Anzeige, Botschaft und Landingpage zusammenpassen.

  • SEO und Content: Du steuerst Agentur, Freelancer und Gastautoren, planst Themen und Ratgeberartikel und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Inhalte technisch und inhaltlich sauber ranken. Longform-Content denkst du von Anfang an so, dass daraus Shorts, Reels und Ads entstehen.

  • Creatives: Du konzipierst Ads, Hooks und Skripte und drehst einfache Formate mit unseren Gründern. Schnitt und Postproduktion laufen AI-gestützt oder über Freelancer. Du musst kein Videoprofi sein, aber ein gutes Auge für das haben, was in Ads performt.

  • Newsletter und Lead Nurturing: Unser E-Mail-Marketing läuft bereits. Du entwickelst Segmentierung, Automationen und Inhalte entlang der gesamten Investor Journey weiter, inklusive Reaktivierung bestehender Leads.

  • Daten und Tracking: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CRM (HubSpot) und unserem Marketing-Dashboard, hältst das Tracking sauber und machst sichtbar, welche Maßnahmen tatsächlich Investoren bringen.

  • Brand: Du ziehst unsere Brand konsequent durch alle Touchpoints, von Ads über Social Media bis zu Investorenmaterialien.

  • AI-First: Du arbeitest AI-first, bei Creatives, Schnitt, Artikeln, Reporting und Automatisierung. Was manuell nicht sein muss, wird es bei dir auch nicht. Das Budget für die passenden Tools stellen wir, welche das sind, entscheidest du.

  • Perspektive: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und bist von Tag eins für die Zahlen verantwortlich. Mit wachsendem Erfolg steuerst du dein eigenes Team an Freelancern, Agenturen und Werkstudenten.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance- oder Growth-Marketing in einem Startup oder Scale-up und einen Proven Track Record: Kampagnen, Kanäle oder Funnels, die du messbar aufgebaut oder skaliert hast

  • Du bist hands-on in Paid Social und Paid Search und hast Erfahrung mit Landingpage- und Funnel-Testing. SEO und E-Mail-Marketing kennst du gut genug, um Agenturen und Freelancer zu steuern

  • Du denkst in Funnel-Kennzahlen: CPL, CTR, Conversion Rate und Lead-Qualität sind für dich Werkzeuge, keine Buzzwords. Du setzt Tests sauber auf, wertest sie aus und ziehst Konsequenzen

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Hooks, Creatives und Storytelling und weißt, was auf Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn und Instagram funktioniert. Eigene Erfahrung mit Kamera und Schnitt ist ein Plus, keine Voraussetzung

  • Du arbeitest dich sehr schnell tief in erneuerbare Energien, Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und die steuerliche Logik unserer Investments ein. Nur wer das Produkt versteht, kann dafür Marketing machen, das Investoren überzeugt

  • Du arbeitest AI-first: AI-Tools sind für dich in Content-Produktion, Auswertung und Automatisierung fester Teil des Workflows

  • Du arbeitest mit hoher Autonomie, triffst Entscheidungen selbst und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse, auch wenn es unbequem wird

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und ein sicheres Gespür für Sprache und Tonalität

  • Du bist verfügbar für eine Vollzeitstelle und bereit, an 5 Tagen pro Woche in unserem Berliner Büro zu arbeiten

  • Bonus: Erfahrung im Marketing für Finanz- oder Investmentprodukte oder in erneuerbaren Energien, oder du stehst selbst gerne vor der Kamera

Benefits

  • Ownership und Impact: Du baust das Marketing von Sunpeak Capital von Anfang an mit auf, arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und hast prägenden Einfluss darauf, wie wir am Markt wahrgenommen werden

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Top Leistung wird bei uns auch adäquat bezahlt!

  • Kostenfreie Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft: Power dich nach der Arbeit aus beim Sport.

  • Modernes Office in Berlin Mitte: Kaffee in Barista-Qualität, Designer-Möbel und technisches Top-Setup (Apple Hardware + XXL Screens).

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events: Gemeinsame Team Abende und unser jährliches Offsite stärken das Miteinander und machen die Zeit bei uns noch besser.

  • Workation: Anfang 2027 reisen wir gemeinsam für 2 Wochen nach Kapstadt.

Über uns

Sunpeak Capital entstand aus der gemeinsamen Vision von Konstantin und Jan. Vor der Gründung waren sie die ersten beiden Mitarbeiter des Fintech-Scale-ups Cloover, welches PV-Anlagen finanziert. Für dieses bauten sie den deutschen Markt auf und skalierten und das Partnernetzwerk auf über 200 Installationsbetriebe. In dieser Zeit erkannten sie, welches Potenzial entsteht, wenn man Kapital gezielt in nachhaltige Energieprojekte lenkt.

Anfang 2025 gründeten sie dann Sunpeak Capital - vollständig gebootstrapped und bereits nach zwei Monaten profitabel. Ihr Antrieb: die Mechanismen des Kapitalmarkts nutzen, um den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien zu beschleunigen und Investoren echte Rendite mit echtem Impact zu ermöglichen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Growth Manager / Senior Growth Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Portfolio, Wachstums-Roadmap und Go-to-Market für Cloud-, Daten-, KI- und SaaS-Lösungen – du machst Marketing und Vertrieb im deutschsprachigen Mittelstand noch erfolgreicher.

Über Coduct Group

Die Coduct-Gruppe verbindet Technologieberatung, Umsetzung und eigene Produkte unter einem Dach. Seit 2017 begleiten wir Unternehmen bei der Modernisierung ihrer IT-Systeme, Plattformen und Cloud-Architekturen – von der Analyse über Entwicklung und Migration bis zum Betrieb.

  • Die Marke Coduct (Kamp-Lintfort, Berlin, Ho-Chi-Minh-City): IT-Beratung und Softwareentwicklung für Cloud, Daten, KI und Automatisierung; auch als Build-Operate-Transfer-Modell (BOT)

  • Die Marke ainavio: unsere SaaS-Plattform für Produktinformationsmanagement (PIM)

  • Die Marke Code Leap: unsere Software-Engineering-Marke

Als Microsoft CSP-Partner und dreifach zertifizierter Microsoft Solutions Partner (Data & AI, Digital & App Innovation, Infrastructure/Azure) kombinieren wir Lizenzierung, Beratung und Umsetzung aus einer Hand. Zu unseren Kunden gehören Energieversorger, ERP- und Softwareanbieter, Handel und E-Commerce sowie Industrieunternehmen – darunter JTL, Netze BW, Schleupen und Galeria.

Warum wir diese Rolle jetzt besetzen

Wir stehen an der Schwelle zur nächsten Wachstumsphase. Dafür haben wir die Unternehmensfunktion Growth geschaffen, geführt von unserem VP Growth. Growth plant das Wachstum der Gruppe und sorgt dafür, dass es gelingt: Wir entwickeln Portfolio und Wachstums-Roadmap und befähigen Marketing und Vertrieb, Wachstum zu realisieren.

Wichtig: Growth ist kein zweiter Vertrieb – aber Growth jagt. Nach dem Hunting-Prinzip spürst du Wachstumschancen aktiv auf und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zum Abschluss. Kundenbeziehungen liegen beim Vertrieb; du sorgst dafür, dass er die richtigen Angebote, Argumente und Werkzeuge hat – und dass aus ersten Aufträgen langfristige Kundenbeziehungen werden.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Wachstumsstrategie & Growth-Roadmap

  • Du entwickelst mit dem VP Growth eine mehrjährige Growth-Roadmap mit klaren Etappen, Prioritäten und Meilensteinen

  • Du jagst aktiv Wachstumschancen – neue Segmente, Partnerschaften (u. a. Microsoft), Großchancen bei Neu- und Bestandskunden – und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zum Abschluss

  • Du bewertest Zielsegmente und validierst neue Geschäftsfelder schnell und pragmatisch

  • Du übersetzt die Roadmap in konkrete Initiativen, Business Cases und gemeinsame Ziele mit Marketing, Vertrieb und Delivery

2. Portfolio-Entwicklung (Kern der Rolle)

  • Du gestaltest unsere Portfolio-Architektur mit einer ausgewogenen Balance aus Volumen- bzw. Standardangeboten (z. B. CSP, Managed Services, SaaS, Festpreis-Pakete) und Premium- bzw. Individualleistungen (z. B. Beratung, Custom Development, BOT, End-to-End-Transformation)

  • Du produktisierst wiederkehrende Projektmuster zu skalierbaren Angeboten – und schärfst gleichzeitig die Differenzierung unserer Premiumleistungen

  • Du verantwortest Positionierung (Problem – Lösung – Nutzen), Pricing-Logik und Lifecycle der Angebote, gemeinsam mit Delivery und Technologie

3. Land-and-Expand-Modell

  • Du entwickelst Einstiegsangebote, mit denen neue Kunden einfach starten können (Land), und klare Ausbaupfade hin zu Folgeprojekten, Managed Services, Lizenzen und SaaS (Expand)

  • Du baust Programme für die Entwicklung unserer Bestandskunden auf – z. B. vom reinen Lizenzbezug zu Cloud-, Daten- und KI-Services – und gibst dem Vertrieb dafür Anlässe, Zielkundenlisten und Werkzeuge an die Hand

4. Enablement von Marketing & Vertrieb

  • Du befähigst den Vertrieb mit Playbooks, Pitch- und Angebotsvorlagen, Argumentationshilfen, Pricing-Rechnern und Schulungen

  • Du entwickelst mit Marketing Zielgruppen, Ideal Customer Profiles, Messaging und Kampagnen und sorgst für eine konsistente Story: Was machen wir, für wen, und warum Coduct?

  • Du unterstützt bei strategisch wichtigen Angeboten mit Angebotsstruktur und Pricing – die Kundenverantwortung bleibt beim Vertrieb

5. Growth-Prozesse & Steuerung

  • Du gestaltest das Growth Operating Model: Prozesse und Übergaben von Marketing über Vertrieb bis Delivery, klare Rollen und CRM-Standards

  • Du baust ein KPI-System auf – von Pipeline und Conversion über Expansion-Umsatz und Net Revenue Retention bis zum Anteil standardisierter und wiederkehrender Umsätze und zum Margen-Mix

  • Du steuerst Initiativen datenbasiert und machst Learnings teamübergreifend nutzbar

Woran wir deinen Erfolg messen

  • Umsatzbeitrag neuer und überarbeiteter Angebote

  • Expansion bei Bestandskunden (z. B. Cross-Sell-Quote, Net Revenue Retention)

  • Ausgewogener Portfolio-Mix: Anteil standardisierter/wiederkehrender Umsätze bei gesunder Marge im Premiumgeschäft

  • Wirksamkeit des Enablements: Nutzung durch den Vertrieb, Conversion und Time-to-Sale neuer Angebote

  • Umsetzung der Growth-Roadmap nach Plan

Diese Ziele bilden – zusammen mit der Wirkung auf Umsatz und EBIT der Gruppe – die Grundlage deiner variablen Vergütung.

Was du mitbringst

Erfahrung & Know-how

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre im B2B-Umfeld in Portfolio- oder Produktmanagement, Growth, Strategie, Go-to-Market oder Business Development – idealerweise in IT-Services, Cloud, Software oder Beratung

  • Portfolio-Management: Du hast Angebote entwickelt, produktisiert, bepreist und erfolgreich in den Markt gebracht

  • Land and Expand: Du hast Einstiegsangebote und Ausbaupfade gestaltet und kennst die Hebel für Wachstum im Bestand

  • Balance von Volumen und Premium: Du verstehst, wie sich Standard- und Individualgeschäft in Preis, Marge, Delivery und Vertrieb unterscheiden – und wie beide sich verstärken

  • Strategische Kompetenz: Du entwickelst Roadmaps, setzt Prioritäten und übersetzt Strategie in messbare Ergebnisse

  • Vertriebserfahrung: Du kennst Vertrieb aus eigener Praxis (z. B. Vertrieb, Pre-Sales, Key Account) und weißt, was Vertriebsteams wirklich hilft

  • Mittelstand, DACH, SaaS und CSP: Du kennst Bedürfnisse und Entscheidungswege mittelständischer Unternehmen, den DACH-Markt sowie SaaS- und Microsoft-CSP-Geschäftsmodelle

  • Prozessmanagement & Vertriebscontrolling: Du gestaltest Prozesse über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg, arbeitest sicher mit CRM-Systemen und KPIs

  • Sprachen: Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und fließendes Englisch

Persönlichkeit & Arbeitsweise

  • Hunter-Mentalität: Du jagst neue Wachstumschancen – Segmente, Partnerschaften, Großchancen – und bringst sie mit Marketing und Vertrieb zum Abschluss

  • Ergebnisorientierung: Du willst dich an messbaren Zielen und an deiner Wirkung auf Umsatz und EBIT messen lassen – auch in der Vergütung

  • Macher:in: Du handelst proaktiv, mit Bias for Action, und lieferst Ergebnisse statt Konzepte für die Schublade

  • Einfluss ohne Weisungsbefugnis: Du überzeugst Vertrieb, Marketing, Delivery und Geschäftsführung – mit Klarheit, Daten und guten Argumenten

  • Teamplayer in verteilten Teams: Du machst andere erfolgreich, teilst Wissen offen und arbeitest gern remote, asynchron und mit unseren Kolleg:innen in Vietnam

  • Ambition zu wachsen: Du willst in den nächsten Jahren mehr strategische und Führungsverantwortung übernehmen

Wünschenswert

  • Erfahrung im Microsoft-Partner-Ökosystem (Co-Selling, Partnerprogramme, Marketplace)

  • Erfahrung mit Sales- oder Revenue-Operations und Enablement-Programmen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit KI-Tools in Analyse, Content und Enablement

Was wir dir bieten

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust die Growth-Funktion von Anfang an mit auf und arbeitest direkt mit VP Growth und Geschäftsführung zusammen

  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung: Fixgehalt plus variable Komponente – dein Erfolg bei Growth-KPIs, Umsatz und EBIT zahlt sich direkt aus

  • Entwicklungspfad: Die Rolle ist bewusst als Sprungbrett angelegt – hin zu einer führenden Growth-Rolle in der Gruppe

  • Zukunftsthemen: Cloud, Daten, KI und eigene SaaS-Produkte – mit eigenem Delivery-Center in Vietnam

  • Kultur: ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, ehrlich kommuniziert, pragmatisch entscheidet und kurze Wege hat

  • Flexibilität: flexible Arbeitszeiten, hybrides Arbeiten – Office Kamp-Lintfort oder Berlin (ca. 1 Tag/Woche), sonst mobil innerhalb Deutschlands; gelegentliche Reisen in der DACH-Region

So läuft der Auswahlprozess

  • Sichtung deiner Unterlagen – Rückmeldung innerhalb von 10 Werktagen

  • Erstgespräch (ca. 75 Minuten, per Video) mit VP Growth, Chief of Staff und einem Teammitglied aus Vertrieb oder Marketing

  • Fallstudie und Zweitgespräch (ca. 90 Min., per Video) mit der Geschäftsführung – du präsentierst deine Lösung einer praxisnahen Aufgabe (ca. 1 Woche Vorbereitung)

  • Angebot

Interesse?

Bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf und beantworte uns kurz eine Frage: Welches Angebot hast du zuletzt so entwickelt oder geschärft, dass es spürbar mehr Umsatz gebracht hat – und wie hast du den Vertrieb dabei mitgenommen? Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichen Starttermin nennst du uns gern direkt mit.

Bei uns findest du ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam seine Ziele verfolgt. Wir setzen auf ehrliche Kommunikation, pragmatische Lösungen und eine Atmosphäre, in der Arbeiten Freude macht. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft innovativer Projekte!

title: Growth Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The role

We’re hiring a Growth Marketing Manager to make sure every potential customer gets the right next step from us.

You’ll own email and nurture, and help build an account-based marketing motion for our target accounts. You’ll work with RevOps on how leads are scored and routed, and with our field and digital marketers so a buyer who meets us at a dinner, sees an ad, and opens an email hears one consistent story.

What you'll own

Account-based marketing

Sales knows which accounts it wants to win. You'll build the programme that makes sure those accounts hear from us in a way that fits them.

  • Agree a tiered model: which accounts get one-to-one attention, which get campaigns for small groups of similar accounts, and which get broader programmes

  • Map the buying group in each account across procurement, finance, legal, IT, and security

  • Build plays for each tier that combine paid, email, seller outreach, direct mail, events, and personalised landing pages

  • Share signals with sellers: which accounts are warming up, who's engaging, and what they're reading

  • Run plays that help open deals move when they stall, and codify them when they’re working

  • Run direct mail and gifting as part of account plays: invitations, follow-ups after meetings, and nudges for deals that have stalled

Nurture and email

Most people who find Omnea aren't ready for a meeting yet. You'll make sure they keep hearing from us in a way that fits their role, until they are.

  • Design nurture programmes by persona, stage, and region, built from parts you can reuse

  • Build and run programmes for new leads, leads sales has passed back, closed-lost deals, and event and webinar follow-up

  • Take over the programmes we've already started, like the sequence for people who download our reports

  • Run the newsletter and campaign sends

  • Keep the database healthy: segmentation, enrichment, consent across the UK, EU, and US, and deliverability

  • Report what each programme returns in meetings and pipeline, rather than opens

Scoring, routing, and handoff

You'll work with RevOps so the right people reach the right seller quickly, and everyone else goes into nurture.

  • Agree with sales and RevOps what counts as a qualified meeting, who follows up, and by when

  • Build fit and engagement scoring with a clear threshold for alerting sellers, while demo requests always go straight to sales

  • Help set routing rules by territory and account owner, so every demo request reaches the right rep

  • Review lead quality with the sales team every week, and recalibrate scoring every quarter against the deals we win

  • Report conversion and drop-off at each stage of the funnel

Across the growth plan

You'll work alongside our Digital Lead on everything else growth covers, from paid and LinkedIn to the website and reporting.

  • Run experiments, call the results, and stop the ones that aren't working

  • Join quarterly planning sessions with the marketing team to choose the bigger moments we put our weight behind, then own their delivery

  • Keep campaign tracking and UTMs consistent, so reporting in HubSpot and Dreamdata holds up

  • Pick up what the quarter needs most, whether that's a paid test, a landing page, or a LinkedIn campaign

What we're looking for

  • 2+ years in a B2B marketing role, in-house or agency. We care more about what you delivered than where you did it.

  • You're commercial. You think in meetings and pipeline, and you can tell the difference between a programme that's busy and one that's working.

  • You've worked on account-based or event-led programmes. You can walk us through one, from the accounts you chose to the meetings it produced.

  • You know HubSpot well. Workflows, lists, lifecycle stages, email, and scoring. You've built nurture that led to meetings.

  • You're comfortable with numbers. You can build a report from scratch, spot when something looks wrong, and explain a trend to someone who wasn't close to the work.

  • You follow through. ABM and nurture programmes live or die on the details, and you're the person who checks the addresses, the timings, and the follow-up.

Nice to have

  • B2B SaaS experience

  • Experience with tools like Clay, Dreamdata, Userled, or gifting platforms

What good looks like in six months

  • Every major event has an invite campaign, a follow-up plan, and a pipeline number we trust

  • Sales and marketing have agreed a tiered target account list, and plays are running for each tier

  • Our core nurture programmes are live, and we know how many meetings each one produces

  • Lead scoring is live with RevOps, demo requests reach the right rep quickly, and sales trusts what marketing sends

  • You're the person sellers ask when they want to know which of their accounts are warming up

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!
