title: Test Engineer HIL Autonomy Systems – Land Domain (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the role:
We are looking for an experienced Test Engineer – HIL who thrives in the broad spectrum between initial concept, quick prototyping and final validation for cutting-edge autonomy products in the Land Domain. You will drive building and refining our HIL and HW Test Bench infrastructure together with the HW team, and establish automated component- or subsystem-level tests on this infrastructure as an essential part of our overall test strategy.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design, build and configure HIL test benches, hardware test setups and breadboards based on individual project requirements.

  • Develop and maintain automated tests for components and subsystems.

  • Integrate relevant hardware, sensors, interfaces and software into the test environment.

  • Execute test campaigns and assess the resulting data.

  • Define clear pass, fail and invalid test criteria, including for early-stage systems where specifications may still be evolving.

  • Analyse test failures and distinguish between actual product issues and problems caused by the test setup.

  • Provide engineering teams with clear, actionable feedback based on your test results.

  • Collaborate closely with hardware, software, autonomy and systems engineering teams.

  • Continuously improve our test infrastructure, processes and overall verification and validation approach.


What you bring to the team:

  • Strong hands-on experience with HIL/HW testing, test benches and test automation, ideally in autonomy, robotics or similar complex systems.

  • Solid understanding of sensors, perception, path planning and motion control, combined with the ability to troubleshoot hardware and software integration issues.

  • A pragmatic and analytical approach to testing, including defining meaningful test criteria and pass/fail conditions, even when requirements are still evolving.

  • A hands-on and resourceful mindset, enabling you to create effective test environments and find practical solutions in fast-moving prototype projects.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to analyse failures together with engineering teams and translate test results into clear, actionable feedback.

  • A self-driven and adaptable working style with the motivation to take ownership and move challenging projects forward.

title: Research Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments?
Are you excited by the challenge of turning the classical robotic stacks into the foundational training data for physical AI?
Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution?

If your answers are yes, we should talk.


At Nomagic, we are executing a humble pivot for general-purpose physical AI. We believe that physical AI is fundamentally a knowledge transfer problem - we are leveraging the "internet data" of robotics - massive deployment logs from real systems operating in production environments - to bootstrap our efforts. We are looking for Research Engineers who will help us to build, train, and deploy foundational models that bring our fleet from a classical control stack to generalized AI mastery.


Offer essentials
  • Play with real robots, solving real problems, every day.
  • Relocation package.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • English-speaking environment.

    • Here is why we love this job ourselves, and hope you will enjoy it too:
  • We combine world-class research with top-notch engineering and apply it to solve real problems
  • The data already exists. We have robots in production at scale. We aren't waiting for datasets to be collected; the byproduct of our machines doing useful work is being created right now.
  • We measure what matters. We test our code in unit tests, simulations, and directly on real robots. Grounding our models in deployment allows us to truly measure performance.
  • High leverage, high impact. We’re still a highly focused team. If your training recipes improve our agents, you directly change the economics of the company.
  • World-class peers. Our team has built Google Warsaw, unicorn startups, led research in DeepMind, tested rocket engines, and worked at top companies like Nvidia and ByteDance. Now, we are shaping the reality of Physical AI together.
  • We are building the bridge. We aren't a new startup looking for an application; we are an established player bootstrapping physical AI. We believe that this will be the first true proof-of-concept for scaled physical AI.

    • What you will do
  • Your focus will be defined by the intersection of Robotics and ML and large-scale multimodal model training - expertise in both is optimal and alternatively eagerness to learn.
  • Expect challenges across two main pillars with the opportunity to specialise:
  • Core Research & Large-Scale Infrastructure
  • Own the Training Stack: Design, implement, and maintain the core infrastructure for large-scale VLA model training, including scheduling, distribution, job management, checkpointing, and rigorous logging.
  • Enable Rapid Iteration: Build the critical tools and abstractions necessary for launching, monitoring, debugging, and seamlessly reproducing complex, multi-variant experiments.
  • Train from Deployment Logs: Utilize our massive repository of offline, classical stack data to pre-train robust robot foundation models.
  • Drive the Software Feedback Loop: Translate core research needs into concrete infra capabilities, track experiments, analyze results, and close the loop directly with ML researchers to unblock model progress
  • Real-World Evaluation & Operations
  • Design Physical Benchmarks: Design new robotic tasks and build lightweight physical setups to systematically evaluate model capabilities far beyond the limits of simulation.
  • Execute Structured Evaluations: Ensure robots are properly configured, calibrated, and ready for rollouts. You will coordinate data collection efforts and run structured, on-robot evaluations to measure real-world success rates.
  • Close the Physical Feedback Loop: Analyze real-world evaluation results to guide the ML research direction. You will identify operational bottlenecks across software, hardware, and deployment systems to continuously improve our iteration speed.
  • Scale the Workflows: Beta test internal and third-party tools for teaching robots new skills, and write clear, structured documentation so the broader team can reproduce your workflows and scale your impact.

    • What skills we’d like you to have:

  • Experience: Deep experience and understanding at the intersection of machine learning, systems engineering, and robotics.

  • Proven Track Record: Experience training, fine-tuning, and deploying modern deep learning architectures (Transformers, VLMs or VLAs, Imitation Learning, RL) for robot control, ideally with policies validated on real hardware.

  • Engineering Excellence: Strong software engineering and infrastructure skills. You are highly proficient in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch/JAX) and can write clean, scalable code for training and evaluation.

  • Robotics Intuition: Comfort working hands-on with hardware. You understand the robotics full stack (perception, controls, state estimation) and how to debug failures when software meets the physical world.

  • Pragmatic Research Mindset: You possess the ability to move seamlessly between research and implementation. You prefer execution, iteration speed, and real-world robustness over theoretical purity.

    • What should you expect once you apply?

    • A phone screen with the hiring manager to discuss your background and our technical direction.
    • A half-day of on-sites (cultural fit & deep-dive technical interviews).
    • A final decision made within 2-3 days after the on-site interview.
    • Important: Expect detailed, honest feedback after completing the process, regardless of our decision.

title: Responsable Conduite du changement et Transformation – Client Delivery (Français/anglais)
descriptionHtml:
Responsable Conduite du changement et Transformation – Client Delivery (Français/Anglais)

Lieu : Paris, France (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau ; déplacements ponctuels à Bruxelles et à Londres)
Niveau : Programme Manager senior
Équipe : Client Delivery
Contrat : CDI
Rattaché(e) à : Operating Model Design Lead

Merci de noter : ce poste est basé en France, vous devez y résider ou envisager de vous y installer, et il nécessite un droit de travail existant dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions cette possibilité poste par poste, alors n’hésitez pas à consulter régulièrement notre site carrières pour découvrir de futures opportunités.

Le français et l’anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous remercions de soumettre votre CV en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité du secteur de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les entreprises de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie quotidienne.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des entreprises innovantes comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Vos missions

  • Piloter, en tant que référent(e) opérationnel(le), l’accompagnement du changement et de la transformation pour la préparation au go-live de la migration d’ENGIE France sur Kaluza, de la planification jusqu’à la bascule, l’hypercare et la transition vers le déploiement à plus grande échelle, afin que les équipes d’ENGIE soient prêtes et confiantes pour adopter la plateforme dès le premier jour.

  • Définir l’approche de conduite du changement du programme : analyse des parties prenantes, évaluation des impacts du changement, conception des formations et mobilisation pour la préparation métier, adaptées au contexte opérationnel d’ENGIE France et portées par leurs équipes.

  • Faire vivre la gouvernance de préparation métier de Kaluza : stage gates, preuves de préparation, suivi des risques et des dépendances, et reporting hebdomadaire.

  • Collaborer avec le ou la Learning and Adoption Specialist en France pour coordonner la formation, le Train the Trainer et les contenus de connaissance, afin que l’accompagnement soit en place à chaque incrément du programme, au fil de la construction et de la livraison des fonctionnalités en mode Agile.

  • Être l’interlocuteur(trice) quotidien(ne) d’ENGIE France sur la préparation métier, le changement et l’adoption, en apportant des conseils pratiques à leurs responsables de transformation.

  • Suivre l’adoption et la stabilité opérationnelle pendant l’hypercare, analyser les causes racines de tout écart par rapport aux critères d’acceptation, et convenir avec ENGIE des actions correctives.

  • Améliorer le playbook de préparation de Kaluza : faire évoluer ce qui a fonctionné sur ENGIE Belgique, tester des correctifs là où cela ne suffit pas en France, et partager vos enseignements avec vos collègues de Client Delivery pour façonner les fondations opérationnelles de la plateforme, ses améliorations et nos standards globaux.

Au quotidien, vous piloterez ou soutiendrez notamment les activités suivantes :

  • Impacts du changement et planification de la préparation : diagnostiquer l’ensemble des impacts sur les rôles, les processus, les systèmes et l’expérience client, puis les traduire en un plan de préparation priorisé, séquencé en fonction du rythme de livraison, de migration et de mise en production.

  • Parties prenantes, sponsors et réseaux du changement : cartographier les parties prenantes et leur influence au niveau de chaque chantier, aider les sponsors à rester visibles et engagés, et structurer les réseaux de champions, de super-utilisateurs et de managers qui porteront le changement au sein du business d’ENGIE.

  • Communication et résistances : soutenir la stratégie de communication et d’engagement d’ENGIE France, afin que leurs équipes et leurs clients entendent un discours cohérent et positif sur le programme. Vous aiderez les dirigeants et les champions à porter le changement, en interne comme auprès des clients, et vous anticiperez les zones où des résistances pourraient apparaître afin d’intervenir avant qu’elles ne s’installent.

  • Migration et préparation au go-live : constituer les preuves de préparation métier et opérationnelle qui permettent un transfert fluide vers l’exploitation, mesurées par rapport aux critères d’acceptation convenus, et soutenir le centre de commandement du go-live.

  • Hypercare et stabilisation : définir les critères d’entrée et de sortie de l’hypercare, suivre les signaux de stabilité et d’adoption, et assurer une passation propre aux équipes d’exploitation d’ENGIE.

  • Premières versions et solutions de contournement : anticiper les limitations connues des premières versions et les refléter dans les formations, les contenus de connaissance et les communications, pour que les utilisateurs ne soient jamais pris au dépourvu. Vous travaillerez avec le Release Management pour que chaque version de la plateforme arrive avec l’accompagnement nécessaire.

Votre profil

Idéalement, vous avez :

  • Plusieurs années d’expérience opérationnelle en conduite du changement sur de grandes transformations de plateformes ou de systèmes, avec une discipline de change management reconnue. Vous résolvez avec créativité une grande variété de problèmes et travaillez avec peu de supervision.

  • Une expérience dans des environnements opérationnels régulés et en contact avec les clients, incluant la migration de comptes clients en production, la bascule et le go-live, où vous avez contribué à définir l’approche plutôt que de simplement en suivre une.

  • De solides compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes, avec une vraie crédibilité auprès des responsables de programme et des sponsors de transformation côté client.

  • Une aisance avec les données : vous explorez vous-même les données d’adoption et de programme, vous en rendez compte clairement et vous challengez les décisions lorsque les éléments factuels sont fragiles.

  • Une sensibilité commerciale : vous comprenez comment Kaluza gagne de l’argent et savez arbitrer entre les besoins du client et les coûts, en travaillant aux côtés des partenaires intégrateurs et des ressources change du client, sans doublonner les efforts.

Ce qui fera la différence : une expérience dans la vente d’énergie aux particuliers ou dans les utilities, une expérience côté éditeur sur une implémentation SaaS, et/ou une connaissance des opérations et des technologies de centre de contact.

Nos valeurs

Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza :

  • Jouer pour gagner : La fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle.

  • Résoudre le vrai problème : Aller au-delà de la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets.

  • Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

  • Assumer les résultats : Une pleine responsabilité, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

  • Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.

Nos avantages

  • Finance & assurances : Bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle santé Alan, assurance Vie & Décès x3 (prévoyance) via Alan, et cotisations standard de Sécurité Sociale (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage)

  • Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport, indemnité de télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 €

  • Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés payés + jours fériés + jours de RTT, congé Moments Importants, congé de compassion, deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, flexibilité dans l’organisation du travail et possibilité de congé sabbatique

Venez comme vous êtes

Nous souhaitons rencontrer des personnes de tous horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents selon leur mérite et leur potentiel. Si le poste vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis de vous lire.

Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur notre page carrières et notre LinkedIn. Notre politique de protection des données des candidats est disponible ici.

Compensation: €56K – €75K

descriptionHtml:
Vous aimez manager des équipes de terrain, organiser les ressources et relever des défis opérationnels ? Rejoignez-nous !

Rattaché(e) au Responsable des Activités Maintenance et Travaux, vous assurez le management direct des Chefs de Chantier, Chefs d'Équipe et Techniciens.

Véritable relais entre les équipes terrain et l'encadrement opérationnel, vous jouez un rôle essentiel dans l'organisation de l'activité. Vous veillez à mobiliser les bonnes compétences, au bon endroit et au bon moment, afin de garantir la bonne réalisation des chantiers et la performance des équipes.

Vos missions

Manager et accompagner les équipes

  • Encadrer, animer et accompagner au quotidien les Chefs de Chantier, Chefs d'Équipe et Techniciens ;

  • Accompagner les collaborateurs dans leur développement professionnel et leur montée en compétences ;

  • Participer à l'identification des besoins de formation et à la construction des parcours professionnels ;

  • Organiser et piloter la planification hebdomadaire des équipes, en coordination avec les Conducteurs de Travaux ;

Au cœur de l'activité opérationnelle, vous êtes un acteur clé de la coordination entre les besoins des chantiers, les ressources humaines disponibles et les compétences à mobiliser.

Votre proximité avec les équipes vous permet d'anticiper les besoins, d'apporter des réponses concrètes aux problématiques du quotidien et de contribuer durablement à la performance collective.

Issu(e) d'une formation technique supérieure ou disposant d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente acquise sur le terrain, vous justifiez d'une expérience de 3 ans minimum dans le management d'équipes techniques terrains.

Vous avez idéalement évolué dans un environnement de travaux, d'installation, de maintenance ou de services techniques, et avez développé une solide expérience en organisation et planification des ressources humaines.

Manager de terrain, vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à fédérer et à accompagner les équipes, tout en sachant prendre du recul pour organiser et piloter l'activité.

Vous disposez notamment des qualités suivantes :

  • Rigueur et fiabilité dans le suivi administratif et opérationnel ;

  • Esprit d'analyse et capacité à proposer des solutions pragmatiques ;

  • Autonomie, réactivité et sens des responsabilités.

La maîtrise des outils de planification et de suivi d'activité est indispensable.

Votre sens du terrain, votre capacité à fédérer et votre goût pour les environnements opérationnels seront des atouts essentiels pour réussir dans cette fonction.

title: Restaurant Operations - Cologne/Düsseldorf
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland.

 

About the Role:

We’re looking for a true startup Operations person. Good onboarding is what makes our merchants set up for success. From the first meeting, the go-live to working and growing together - this person will own the onboarding process and make it all happen. This role is for someone who likes working with the product, becoming an expert in it and teaching others.

Your day-to-day will be a mix of hands-on ops, project management, customer communication and problem solving. We are reshaping the future of hospitality tech, and this role is at the forefront of it.

What You’ll Do:

Our Operations happen on a restaurant floor, in a lively neighbourhood, at a busy bar - we operate in the city:

  • Run restaurant onboarding: train, connect and implement together with the restaurant team

  • Problem-solve for our merchants on the ground while running live operations

  • Support restaurants after the go live and make sure that Tebi adds value to their business long-term

  • Find opportunities for improvement in our process, materials and systems

  • Continue investing in our relationship with our merchants to make sure they are happy with our product and growing as a business

  • Identify product and process gaps and bring it to internal central teams such as product, engineering and central operations

What You’ll Need:

  • You are a creative problem solver who enjoys interacting with hospitality businesses

  • You are empathetic towards our merchants and curious about their business

  • You can juggle multiple things at once and bring structure

  • Curious about the product, want to be an expert in Tebi system and can apply your knowledge

  • Good communication - you are great at proactive contact and managing expectations

  • Being comfortable with high-pace environments: both the hospitality flow and the startup day-to-day

  • Interest in data, process improvement and automation

  • Flexibility in working hours that fit our merchants’ needs and ensuring a healthy balance

  • At least 2-4 years of experience in hospitality, early startup operations, fast-paced account management or customer operations

  • You are comfortable working in both English and German

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Flexible Time-off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Hardware (Electronics) Engineer within our Electronic Warfare team, you will design and develop the RF hardware and electronic front-ends at the core of our electronic warfare and signal intelligence systems – from concept to field deployment. You will work hand-in-hand with system, software and mechanical teams to turn architecture needs into robust, high-performance hardware, and to ensure overall performance, robustness and reliability.

 

Responsibilities

  • RF Front-End Design: Design and develop radio and radar RF front-ends, from specification through to validation.

  • Hardware Architecture: Drive the hardware architecture of EW/SIGINT systems, ensuring performance, robustness and manufacturability.

  • High-Power & High-Voltage Electronics: Design high-power switching supplies (including narrow pulse generation) and high-voltage PCBs, supplies and shielding.

  • Integration & Validation: Lead board bring-up, RF integration, prototyping and validation against performance targets.

  • Technical Coordination: Collaborate across software, mechanical, GNC and ML teams on system integration and technical interfaces.

  • System Reviews & Documentation: Contribute to design and architecture reviews, maintaining consistency between requirements, design and testing.

Candidate Requirements

  • Strong background in RF hardware design is mandatory, including radio or radar front-end design.

  • No prior Electronic Warfare experience required.

  • Experience in RF integration is a plus.

  • Experience with high-power switching supplies (narrow pulse generation) is a definite plus.

  • Experience with high-voltage PCB / supply design and shielding.

  • MSc in Electrical / Electronics Engineering; PhD is a plus.

  • Broad engineering culture with understanding of mechanical, software and embedded systems.

  • Rigorous, structured and mission-driven mindset with strong analytical skills.

  • Excellent communication and documentation abilities.

 

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Sales Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Sales Consultant

THE CARWOW GROUP

Carwow Group is building the go-to destination for car-changing, reaching drivers everywhere through a portfolio of automotive brands: Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer.

Carwow started as a car reviews site and is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe, with over 10m customers helping them buy and sell cars. Our Sell My Car service lists cars for sale through a daily online auction, matching sellers with dealers who want to buy. In 2024 we acquired Autovia, doubling our audience. Our team of around 500 people across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal is revolutionising car-changing, and we are expanding across every brand and country we operate in.

WHY JOIN US?

Shortlisted in the prestigious Culture 100 list of the top Growth companies to work for by Hyer; we also recently raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify, Bessemer Venture Partners, to accelerate our growth plans! 

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility – building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

Our team of 500 employees across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in! 

THE ROLE

As a Sales Consultant in the Sales Team, you are the main person guiding our customers into the auction and getting their car sold.

Our daily online auction can list over 1,000 cars a day, and behind every one is a seller who wants the best price and a hassle-free sale. You will take them from first conversation to sale: getting their listing right, setting realistic price expectations, then negotiating the sale to land the best price. Owning the whole journey means stronger rapport, better phone calls and fewer cancellations, and you will see the result of your work in every sale.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Manage a daily pipeline of sellers, making calls to guide each one from first conversation to a completed listing and an accepted offer, and hit daily, weekly and monthly targets.

  • Review listings uploaded by sellers and work with them to fix any omissions or errors, so every car enters the auction accurately and complete.

  • Explain the Carwow auction process and give honest, market-based pricing advice, so sellers feel informed and confident.

  • Listen to sellers' concerns and overcome objections, using our sales frameworks.

  • Negotiate on the seller's behalf to get their offer accepted at the best price the market will pay.

  • Uphold our call quality standards in every interaction, so sellers have a positive experience with Carwow.

  • Meet daily KPIs for call volumes, for email and text contact.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including pre-qualification and post-sales fulfilment, sharing insight and feedback on what sellers need.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • We are looking for someone with a track record of hitting targets who is equally comfortable building rapport with a seller and negotiating confidently on their behalf.

  • Previous experience in a target-driven role, with goals based on revenue or volume of sales.

  • Experience managing a high-volume lead pipeline independently, with a consistent sales process and performance.

  • Proven ability to negotiate and handle objections.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to build rapport with sellers from diverse backgrounds.

  • Comfort working across phone, email, live chat and SMS.

  • A proactive, customer-focused approach, with a genuine desire to help sellers achieve their goals.

  • Strong attention to detail and organisation, for accurate listings, tidy pipeline records and efficient follow-up.

  • You are self-motivated, driven by both your own targets and the teams, and work just as well independently as you do as part of a team.

  • Flexibility to work weekends on a rota (see Working pattern and location).

  • Enthusiasm for the automotive industry and for keeping up with trends is a plus.

WORKING PATTERN AND LOCATION

This is a full-time role of 37.5 hours a week, worked over 5 days. Shifts rotate across Monday to Sunday and fall between 9am and 7pm.

  • Weekends: Weekend days are shared across the Sales Team on a rota that repeats every eight weekends and is published in advance. When you work a weekend day, you'll get a weekday off in the same week / time off in lieu, so you still work 5 days in total.

  • Public holidays: Carwow operates seven days a week, so you may be scheduled to work on public holidays

  • Location: hybrid, with a minimum of three days a week in the office at Bournemouth, Winnersh, London or Porto.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working 

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Vitality Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays 

    • 28 days annual leave

    • 1 day for your wedding

    • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year 

    • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year  

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

title: Sales Manager (m/w/d) | Quereinstieg oder Sales-Profi | 100 % Remote | Start 01.02.2027
descriptionHtml:
Du willst nicht nur einen Job, du willst etwas aufbauen?

Wir wachsen schnell und suchen zum 1. Februar 2027 Verstärkung im Sales. Menschen, die Lust haben, ein Unternehmen mit aufzubauen, und die sich an ihren Ergebnissen messen lassen wollen.

Zwei Wege führen zu uns:

  • Du bist Quereinsteiger:in? Du kommst aus Technik, Handwerk, Kundenservice oder einem anderen Job, in dem du Ziele hattest und sie erreicht hast? Vertriebserfahrung brauchst du nicht, das Handwerk bringen wir dir bei. Ehrgeiz und Tempo bringst du mit.

  • Du bist Sales-Profi? Du gehörst in deinem Team zu den Besten und willst endlich ohne Konzernbremse verdienen, was du bewegst? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Neukunden gewinnen: Du sprichst Entscheider per Telefon an und weckst echtes Interesse.

  • Abschlüsse machen: Du führst Verkaufsgespräche per Zoom und bringst sie zum Abschluss.

  • Sauber arbeiten in HubSpot: Du pflegst Kontakte, Deals und Aktivitäten, damit dein Erfolg messbar ist.

  • Deine Zahlen im Blick: Du arbeitest mit klaren KPIs (Calls, Termine, Abschlüsse) und willst sie jede Woche schlagen.

  • Mitgestalten: Du bringst Ideen ein, wie wir unseren Vertrieb schneller und besser machen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ehrgeiz: Du willst gewinnen, vor allem gegen deine eigenen Zahlen von gestern.

  • KPI-Denken: Zahlen motivieren dich. Du willst wissen, wo du stehst.

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe bei Software: Du findest dich schnell in Tools wie HubSpot ein und bedienst deinen Computer zügig und sicher.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und erklärst Dinge verständlich.

  • Eigene Handynummer: für die Akquise und den direkten Kontakt zu deinen Kunden.

  • Professionelle technische Ausstattung: ein leistungsfähiger Computer für flüssiges Arbeiten mit Software, eine Kamera mit guter Bildqualität für Video-Calls, ein gutes Headset bzw. Mikrofon und eine schnelle, stabile Internetverbindung.

  • Fließendes Deutsch und ein ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, an dem du konzentriert telefonieren kannst.

Dein Verdienst

  • 3.000 € brutto Fixgehalt pro Monat, eine sichere Basis ab dem ersten Tag.

  • 10 % Provision auf den Umsatz im ersten Vertragsjahr jedes Deals, den du selbst abschließt.

  • 5 % Provision auf die Verlängerung deiner eigenen Kunden im zweiten Jahr.

  • Zusätzliche Boni für das Erreichen definierter Umsatzschwellen.

Was das heute konkret bedeutet (Stand heute, OTE = Fixum + Provision):

  • Ab Monat 3: ca. 5.000 € pro Monat

  • Ab Monat 6: ca. 7.000 € pro Monat

  • Nach über einem Jahr: 100.000 €+ pro Jahr

Fast alle unserer Vertriebler, die länger als ein Jahr dabei sind, verdienen aktuell über 100.000 € im Jahr, mit steigender Tendenz. Das hat einen Grund: Bei uns bleiben die, die liefern. Wir sind ein Leistungsteam, und wer hier ankommt, verdient entsprechend. Und weil wir schnell wachsen, werden die Möglichkeiten jeden Monat größer.

Außerdem bieten wir dir

  • Echtes Onboarding und Coaching, wir machen dich fit im Vertrieb, auch ohne Vorerfahrung.

  • Klare Ziele und ehrliches Feedback, du weißt immer, wo du stehst.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum, flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege, deine Ideen werden umgesetzt.

  • Entwicklungsperspektive, wer mitwächst, kann Verantwortung übernehmen (z. B. als Teamlead).

  • 100 % Remote, arbeite von überall in Deutschland.

Klingt nach dir?

Bewirb dich in 2 Minuten – ohne Anschreiben, ein Lebenslauf reicht.

Wir schauen uns jede Bewerbung persönlich an. Passt es, melden wir uns per E-Mail mit einem kurzen Persönlichkeitstest (ca. 10 Minuten) – so lernen wir dich über den Lebenslauf hinaus kennen.

Dein Ansprechpartner: Ben Preißler, Head of Sales

title: Sales Manager, SMB
descriptionHtml:
Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, ElevenLabs, and Airtable.

Founded by Siadhal and Shahriar after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised $110m from top-tier investors including Google Ventures and Insight Partners.

It’s still day 0: Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We’re looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives.

 

How we work

Four principles guide us:

  • Velocity. Optimize for rate of learning. Take action, get feedback, get better.

  • Hospitality. Sweat the experience. Delight customers, candidates and colleagues, even when it’s inconvenient.

  • Transparency. Public unless private. Share context openly within the company so people and agents can take initiative.

  • End-to-end. Deliver outcomes, not tasks. Step beyond your job description and see the work through.

 

The role

Our EMEA sales team is growing quickly, and we’re hiring a Sales Manager to report to the Director of Sales, EMEA and help us build the leadership and operating foundations for the next stage of scale. You’ll take ownership of the SMB segment and lead its people, performance, and playbook. This is not a role for someone looking to inherit a finished system: you’ll partner closely with senior leadership to own building the coaching, reporting, onboarding, and operational structures the team needs to grow without lowering the bar.

Key ownership areas:

  • Own the performance and quota of the SMB segment.

  • Recruit, lead, coach, and develop a growing team of quota-carrying sellers, reinforcing a high bar for execution.

  • Adapt and scale our MEDDPICC and Command of the Message sales playbook for your segment, creating a repeatable approach that can scale.

  • Establish the operating cadence, reporting, and performance visibility needed to run the team effectively.

  • Partner with sales enablement to turn training and methodology into consistent execution across the team.

  • Help hire and onboard exceptional sales talent as the EMEA organization expands.

 

What you bring

  • Experience leading a high-performing B2B sales team; depth of experience matters less than evidence that you are an exceptional leader.

  • A builder’s mindset, with experience creating or improving sales playbooks, systems, and operating structures rather than only inheriting them.

  • Strong coaching and talent-development skills, with a track record of raising the performance bar for sellers.

  • Systems thinking: you can translate ambitious growth goals into clear processes, reporting, and team rhythms.

  • Excellent customer-facing judgment and the ability to support sellers in complex commercial conversations.

  • Experience in mid-market, SMB, or building a new regional sales motion; expertise in any one of these can be a strong fit.

  • High agency, high standards, and the comfort to operate in an environment where there is still a great deal to build.

 

What we offer

  • The best co-workers you’ll ever have, in an environment that fosters cohesion, collaboration, and performance.

  • Supreme rate-of-learning as we re-orient how the world works with AI.

  • High compensation, through cash and equity.

  • All the benefits you’d expect and more.

title: Salesforce Developer
descriptionHtml:
About Us:

Nivoda: Where Innovation and Gemstones Meet 💎

At Nivoda, we’re reimagining how the world buys and sells jewellery. Our global marketplace connects retailers and suppliers across diamonds, gemstones, and finished jewellery - already powering over $300M in annual transactions and scaling fast toward our billion-dollar vision.

We’re bringing tech, data, and automation to a $350B industry that’s barely scratched the surface of digital transformation. The result? Explosive growth and massive opportunity powered by a team that makes it happen.


Our Mission

The idea of Nivoda was inspired by the ongoing inefficiency of diamond trading. We set out to develop the solution to help businesses, regardless of their size or location, increase their sales and margins, whilst removing the operational burden of sourcing diamonds.

The Engineering & RevOps Team

Our Engineering and RevOps teams sit at the heart of everything Nivoda builds. We move fast, take ownership, and obsess over scalable systems that let our commercial teams fly. We’re a remote-first, globally distributed team that values directness, low ego, and big impact. If you want to build meaningful things without layers of bureaucracy, you’re in the right place.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Salesforce Developer to join our growing Salesforce team, working alongside our existing developer and RevOps. We’ve completed our migration from HubSpot to Salesforce, and the focus now is on making our new instance the single home for our commercial processes and tooling. You’ll consolidate and harden what we’ve built, retire legacy tools into Salesforce, and help shape what comes next: deeper Sales Cloud capability, exploring Service Cloud and Marketing Cloud, and putting Salesforce’s newer AI features, including Agentforce, to real use.


What would YOU be doing?

  • Consolidate processes and tooling into Salesforce, replacing point solutions and manual workarounds with flows, Apex and native features

  • Build and maintain Sales Cloud improvements: lead and opportunity automation, routing and round-robin, stage gates, Lightning pages and LWCs

  • Prototype and deliver Agentforce and AI use cases with RevOps, such as rep assistants, next-best-action and record summaries

  • Support the exploration and rollout of Service Cloud (e.g. Cases for onboarding and support processes) and Marketing Cloud

  • Build back-end Salesforce solutions — writing Apex code, managing workflows, process automation, and API integrations

  • Maintain integrations with our GTM stack (Snowflake, Gong, Customer.io, Shopify), working with our data engineering team to keep data clean after the migration

  • Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer and Supplier-facing teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions

  • Take part in sprint planning, effort estimation and prioritisation, and deliver on sprint commitments

  • Work a shared sprint backlog with our other Salesforce developer: peer-review code, share on-call bug fixing, and keep documentation current

  • Document everything you build — create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to ensure smooth handovers and maintainability

What do we need from YOU?

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification (essential)

  • Strong Apex coding skills — you write clean, efficient, well-documented code

  • Solid SQL skills and ability to build and map APIs and integrations

  • 2–5 years of Salesforce development experience, ideally in a scaling company

  • Confident with Flow, LWC, SOQL and the Salesforce deployment lifecycle (sandboxes, change sets or SFDX, version control)

  • Strong Sales Cloud experience; exposure to Service Cloud or Marketing Cloud a plus

  • Self-motivated with a strategic mindset — you identify problems before they become fires

  • Collaborative: comfortable sharing a codebase, reviewing others’ work and taking feedback

  • Strong documentation habits — you leave things better than you found them


Nice to have

  • Salesforce Platform Developer II, Service Cloud or Marketing Cloud certifications

  • Experience in marketplace, e-commerce, or SaaS businesses

  • Background in companies at Series A–D stage where you’ve built things from scratch

  • Experience with Snowflake or similar data warehousing tools

  • Experience stabilising or consolidating an org after a CRM migration

  • Hands-on experience with Agentforce, Einstein or Prompt Builder

Our culture and what we offer

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We are convinced that employees need to find alignment between their inner values and their company’s culture and mission to unlock their full potential. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning and growth where everyone can bring expertise, own projects and easily measure their impact.

Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company.
Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment.

Our benefits

🕰️ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture
💻 Remote work
🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning
🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance
🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

title: Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history, and the demand has created an infrastructure gap: we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry still relies on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect delivers a step change in system-level performance.

The Role

We are hiring a Security Engineer to own the security of the systems every OLIX employee depends on: identity, devices, email, collaboration tools and our cloud estate. Our IP is the company, and protecting it is a hands-on engineering job.

You will own detection and response, harden our tooling, run vulnerability management and build the technical controls behind our ISO 27001 certification in 2027. You will work alongside our AI Security Engineer and IT Systems Engineer, and you will use automation and AI to make a small team cover a fast-growing company. This is a high-ownership role with the freedom to define how security engineering works at OLIX.

Responsibilities

  • Own detection and response: triage every security alert, work incidents end to end with our managed detection and response partner, and fix the root cause.

  • Harden the core estate: configure and baseline security across identity, endpoints, Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, GitHub and AWS.

  • Run vulnerability management: set remediation service levels, close vulnerabilities in order of real risk, and report progress every week.

  • Build certification controls: operate and evidence the controls for ISO 27001, SOC 2 and NIST CSF.

  • Extend detection coverage: connect new log sources to our SIEM and write the detection rules for them.

  • Automate security work: build the scripts, agents and workflows that remove manual security tasks.

Skills and experience

  • 5 or more years in security engineering or security operations, owning controls end to end.

  • Hands-on experience running a SIEM and writing detection rules.

  • Hands-on experience administering EDR and responding to incidents on macOS and Windows.

  • Working knowledge of identity security, ideally Okta.

  • Experience securing SaaS platforms and AWS accounts.

  • Technical controls delivered for at least one certification audit (ISO 27001, SOC 2 or Cyber Essentials).

  • Scripting in Python or a similar language, and a habit of using AI to automate work.

Compensation and equity

title: Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

At GetGround, our mission is to make property investment safer, faster and more accessible for everyone.

We’ve built an all-in-one property investment platform that supports investors from opportunity analysis and company formation through to financing, accounting and portfolio management. By bringing software, data and specialist services into one experience, we make property investing simpler, clearer and more cost-effective.

More than 30,000 investors across 70 countries trust us with their identity documents, company records, bank details and the financial picture of their portfolios. Several of our products are regulated by the FCA, and we’re now serving institutional clients and expanding into new markets.

Our security needs to grow faster than we do. We’re looking for someone to own it.

The opportunity

You’ll be GetGround’s first dedicated security engineer. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You’ll decide how we prevent, detect and respond to threats across our cloud, devices, identity and SaaS estate, and then build it.

The scope goes beyond configuring tools. You’ll run our SIEM and own our alerts, keep us ahead of a threat landscape that AI is changing fast, and make sure leadership knows where we stand and what we need.

You’ll work closely with our site reliability engineer, product engineers, our Compliance team and our Data Protection Officer. Over time, you’ll be able to shape how security works across GetGround, including the standards, processes and future hires we need.

What you’ll do

  • Own our security posture. You’ll be the person accountable for security at GetGround. Assess where we are today and define a roadmap that balances security with what the business needs. Be pragmatic: understand our stage, what risk we can accept for now and what has to be fixed today. Keep leadership informed about our risks, what you need and how we’ll address them.

  • Stay ahead of threats. The threat landscape is moving faster than ever, and AI is driving much of that change. AI-generated phishing, deepfake social engineering, prompt injection and data leaking through AI tools are all part of it. Track what’s emerging, judge what matters to a regulated fintech and act before it reaches us.

  • Run our SIEM and own our alerts. Make sure logs from GCP, identity, endpoints, SaaS tools and our own platform reach the SIEM and stay there. Write detection rules, map coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, tune out the noise and make sure nothing important goes unnoticed.

  • Automate response. Build playbooks that contain common threats as soon as an alert fires. Lead incident response when things go wrong, and make sure we learn from it.

  • Protect the data we hold. Know where sensitive data lives, who can access it and when it moves. Secure every channel it passes through: devices through endpoint detection and response (EDR) and anti-malware monitoring and protection, email and cloud storage through data loss prevention, and our platform and tools through access controls. Make the secure path the easy path for everyone at GetGround.

  • Work across the business. Partner with our site reliability engineer and product engineers on secure infrastructure and design, and with Compliance on our obligations. Assess vendors and run training people actually remember.

  • Set our policies and back them with working controls. Build and keep updating our security policies, best practices and information security management system (ISMS). Implement and automate the technical controls behind our security certifications and frameworks, such as ISO 27001, so that passing an audit reflects how we really operate.

What you bring

  • Hands-on detection and response experience. You’ve run a SIEM, built detection rules and owned alerting in production. You know what a bad log looks like.

  • A habit of staying current. You follow how attackers are using AI and other new techniques. You turn what you learn into concrete defences, not headlines.

  • Cloud security depth. You understand cloud infrastructure, identity and networking well enough to harden them, ideally on GCP.

  • Endpoint and identity experience. You’ve run EDR, anti-malware and identity tooling across a company’s devices and SaaS estate.

  • An automation-first mindset. You’d rather automate a control or a response than do it by hand, and you use AI tools to multiply your output.

  • Judgement about risk. You can separate a real threat from a theoretical one, prioritise accordingly and explain the trade-off to people who aren’t specialists.

  • Ownership and clear communication. You take responsibility for outcomes, surface problems early and tell leadership plainly what you need. You can explain a security risk to an engineer, an auditor or the CEO.

Bonus

  • Experience in fintech, financial services or another FCA-regulated environment.

  • Experience implementing controls for security certifications such as ISO 27001.

  • Experience with SOAR tooling and infrastructure as code, such as Terraform.

  • Experience securing AI systems or LLM-based products.

  • Experience as the first or only security hire at a startup or scale-up.

  • Experience with UK GDPR or working alongside a Data Protection Officer.

  • Experience with identity and zero-trust controls, such as SSO, phishing-resistant MFA and conditional access.

  • Experience running penetration tests, red-team exercises or a bug bounty programme.

This role isn’t for you if

  • You want to stay in one specialism. In the same week you might write a detection rule, roll out a device policy and close a gap in our compliance controls.

  • You’re comfortable with alerts nobody reads. We want fewer, better alerts, and someone who cares whether they lead to action.

  • You see security as the department of no. We need someone who finds the secure way to ship, not someone who blocks the business by default.

  • You want a fully defined programme to execute. We need someone who can assess what exists, set the direction and take ownership of it.

  • You don’t connect with how we work. Our values—No BS, pursuit of excellence, feedback obsessed and healthy ego—mean communicating directly, holding a high bar, seeking feedback and being willing to change your mind.

Why join

  • Own security for a platform trusted with sensitive financial data by more than 30,000 investors.

  • Build our security function from the ground up as we expand internationally.

  • Work on challenging problems across cloud infrastructure, customer data, AI and regulated services.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

  • Hybrid London working, with three days per week in Waterloo.

  • Benefits include private health and dental cover, a learning budget, a home-office setup budget and 12 mental health days per year.

title: Security Engineer - Product
descriptionHtml:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Role Description

Wiz is looking for a Security Engineer for Product & Production Infrastructure who has experience performing security reviews, vulnerability management, and detection and response operations in cloud-native environments. You’ll get to collaborate with our software development and DevOps teams to secure Wiz’s products, CI/CD infrastructure, and production infrastructure. You’ll also have the opportunity to influence our product roadmap by utilizing Wiz-for-Wiz to assess, monitor, and harden our environments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead threat modeling and security reviews across Wiz's products and cloud infrastructure, identifying attack surfaces and developing scalable mitigation strategies.

  • Build automation, policy-as-code, and security tooling that enables development teams to "shift left" and integrate end-to-end security into their workflows.

  • Design and implement secure baselines for cloud resources and Kubernetes based infrastructure.

  • Drive vulnerability management and remediation efforts – prioritizing issues, implementing mitigations, and designing strategic preventative controls in software supply chains from development through production.

  • Extend our detection and response capabilities – building scalable solutions to identify malicious activity, triage alerts, and investigate and remediate incidents.

  • Build deep functional partnerships with Wiz's engineering and operations teams – helping them deliver secure-by-design solutions.

Minimum qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in security engineering or security operations work in cloud environments.

  • Experience with AWS cloud security (or equivalent experience in Azure and GCP with some level of AWS experience).

  • Experience with cloud native Kubernetes services (EKS/GKE/AKS) and container security principles.

  • Experience securing IAM and cloud identities at scale.

  • Experience leading technical security reviews of products and architectures, conducting threat modeling exercises, and translating findings into actionable security controls.

  • Practical understanding of web application security concepts (such as OWASP Top-10 and similar).

  • Hands-on experience with IaC and related tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Helm, Pulumi).

  • Experience with automation and tooling development in one or more of the following: Python, Go, Shell, HCL, Rego.

Preferred qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, and/or equivalent job experience in lieu of a degree.

  • Experience working with remote, globally distributed teams.

  • Experience working in organizations that develop software and/or operate managed infrastructure and technology services for their own customers.

  • Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, or CIEM solutions.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country where the position is based, without the need for visa sponsorship. This role does not offer visa sponsorship.

title: Select Major Account Executive, UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
The Select Major Accounts team is Samsara's primary engine for enterprise growth, responsible for landing high-value, net-new logos across the UK & Ireland's largest physical operations. In this role, you will lead multi-million-dollar, full-cycle sales processes from a cold start—executing a disciplined qualification playbook, building true C-suite champions, and closing strategic $1M+ ARR deals. This position is built for an elite, strategic Account Executive who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments—equally comfortable navigating IT and lines of business to digitize industries traditionally reliant on legacy systems.

Why Now? Samsara combines the agility of a high-growth startup, the market authority of a public company, and the momentum of a hyper-scale tech leader. Named a Best Place to Work for 3 consecutive years, we offer enterprise sellers a combination of unique differentiators:

  • Proven Leadership & Hyper-Growth: Founded by serial entrepreneurs with a history of building multi-billion-dollar companies, Samsara has scaled past $2.1B+ ARR with 30%+ YoY global growth.

  • Market-Dominating Platform: Backed by $2.8B+ in R&D investment, our Connected Operations Cloud makes us the Category Leader delivering class-leading AI, IoT, and telematics capabilities with a genuine AI moat.

  • Massive Untapped Market: Physical operations represent a $160B+ Global TAM, with EMEA remaining 99% greenfield opportunity.

This brings strong upside earning potential on a winning trajectory, rapid professional growth alongside elite sales talent, and a massive, unpenetrated territory waiting to be captured.

Whilst we do support remote working, flexibility is required to travel to visit customers onsite across the region as required.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Mobilize a large matrix virtual team of business stakeholders to include Operations, Finance, IT, dedicated Solution Engineer and Account Development Representative
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Min. 7+ years full-cycle Enterprise-level Account Executive closing expertise, winning complex SAAS deals
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $1M+ ARR deal execution
  • New Logo & Self-generated pipeline: Demonstrated ability to build and win deals through a repeatable outbound prospecting motion
  • Structured Qualification: Mastery of Playbook methodology-led selling (e.g. MEDDPICC / Command of the Message / Force Management) to quantify genuine business pain
  • Champion & Economic Buyer navigation: Proven ability to test and build true champions, access executive buying centres, and engineer compelling events
  • A Team player used to winning as a team, collaborative and within a coachable growth mindset

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Awards for elite achievement (particularly President's Club, Winner's circle, Top 10%)
  • Passionate about transformational technology in the world operations
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

title: SEM Technician (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Your Role

As an SEM Technician (f/m/d), you will support tools and process qualifications and help investigate issues arising across our semiconductor process flow. Working closely with our Failure Analysis Engineer, Process Integration team and other engineering functions, you will perform Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) analysis and complementary characterization using techniques such as Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDX) and Focused Ion Beam (FIB).

Ideally you come with a first-hand experience working with SEM. You will initially work alongside our SEM experts to deepen your knowledge learn the tool’s operating principles, procedures and inspection requirements for our specific use cases. Through hands-on training and continuous knowledge transfer, you will build your skills in sample handling, imaging, measurement and troubleshooting; before gradually becoming an independent SEM user and taking greater ownership of the tool and the processes.

As the function develops, there may also be opportunities to operate additional defect-inspection tools and support defect analysis and yield improvement within our 300 mm manufacturing facility.

What You’ll Do

  • Prepare, handle and inspect a wide range of semiconductor samples according to defined analysis requirements

  • Perform accurate and reliable SEM analysis to support tool qualification, process qualification and root-cause investigations

  • Use complementary characterization techniques, including EDX and FIB, where required

  • Work closely with Failure Analysis, Process Integration and engineering teams to understand inspection requirements and communicate results effectively across functions

  • Maintain accurate records of incoming sample lots, expected outcomes, reporting deadlines and priorities

  • Perform daily, weekly and monthly tool-health checks, calibration and routine performance monitoring

  • Troubleshoot tool and measurement issues and coordinate with equipment vendors to maintain tool availability

  • Maintain an accurate inventory of consumables and spare parts required for reliable SEM operation

  • Standardize measurement procedures and reporting methods to ensure consistent and repeatable results

  • Document operating procedures and best practices and, over time, support the training of additional SEM operators

  • Support the operation of additional defect-inspection tools and contribute to defect analysis and yield-improvement activities as the team grows

What You Bring

  • Technical training or a bachelor’s or master’s degree in physics, chemistry, engineering, materials science or a related field

  • Previous hands-on experience operating SEM systems

  • Experience with FIB and EDX is highly desirable

  • An understanding of sample preparation, imaging, measurement and basic failure-analysis methods

  • Previous experience working in a semiconductor cleanroom is an advantage

  • Willingness and ability to spend extended periods working in a cleanroom while wearing the required PPE

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to work carefully and consistently with sensitive samples and equipment

  • A structured approach to documentation, sample tracking and task prioritization

  • Confidence working in a dynamic environment with interconnected technical dependencies and changing priorities

  • Good communication skills in English, with a reliable, open and honest approach to working with stakeholders

  • Willingness to learn, take increasing ownership and support tasks beyond your immediate scope when needed

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

title: Senior AI Transformation Lead
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward transformation leads to be part of our early team at Resonance. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As a Senior AI Transformation Lead, you’ll run our most ambitious client engagements. You’ll own relationships with C-suite leaders, PE sponsors and management teams, and lead a team of transformation leads and AI engineers. You’ll map how a business runs its key processes, find where AI fundamentally changes the economics, and redesign them agentic-first rather than bolting AI onto today’s process. You’ll prototype the new workflows yourself with Claude Code or similar, build the business case, and lead the change through to the people who have to adopt it. Every engagement starts with a value case and ends with the metric that moved in the client’s P&L. As one of our first 100, you’ll also coach your team, turn each engagement into playbooks the next team starts from, and help shape how Resonance hires, operates and grows.

What we’re looking for: You’re a senior operator, typically with 5+ years of experience in equivalent roles, including running AI client engagements or transformation programmes end to end. You might be a senior consultant, engagement manager or associate partner at a top-tier strategy firm, a VP or Director on a PE value creation team, an AI director, or an operator who has led a transformation from inside a business. You’re a builder with a deep understanding of technology. You don’t need to write production code, but you use AI every day, prototype with new models and tools the day they land, and know where to challenge your engineering counterparts. Just as important, senior executives trust you with their most important outcomes, you frame hard trade-offs clearly, and you bring resistant organisations through change. We want both in one person. You have extreme agency, operate with urgency, and have consistently been among the very top performers of your peers. PE portfolio or value creation experience and operating experience in software or services are a plus. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Frontier AI work with real stakes, driving tangible outcomes for consequential companies. A team built to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe, and the autonomy to shape how the firm delivers and grows as an early leader. A chance to help close Europe’s AI gap, moving European businesses to the right side of the productivity chasm.

Logistics: London, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in the UK and Europe. English is our working language. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates, and start dates are flexible.

Apply

Send your CV and a short note on the transformation you're proudest of leading and the impact it delivered.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.
