About us

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

About the team

The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents.

Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services.

All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down.

The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. The team is small enough that engineers own problems end to end, from design through on-call.

About you

You're a senior engineer who wants to own features end to end, not just close tickets. You've built and run production Python services, ideally high-traffic or latency-sensitive ones, and you've been on-call for them. You think in trade-offs: latency versus cost, a quick fix versus a durable one, a new parameter versus a public API customers can't afford to see break. You can take a feature from a rough problem statement to a design, ship it, and then make sure it behaves in production. You're comfortable leading a project with one or two other engineers and helping teammates grow along the way. When a problem is only partly defined, you ask the right questions to pin it down. When you meet an unfamiliar protocol or system, you read the spec and work out how it fits. You change your mind when someone has a better argument, and you still care about your code long after it merges.

What you will do

  • Own the design and delivery of features and components in our services.

  • Design and evolve public API endpoints with backward compatibility in mind, and contribute to architecture discussions for our services.

  • Improve performance and reliability: find latency and failure hotspots, add the observability needed to understand them, and fix them.

  • Take an active part in design and code review, and mentor mid-level engineers.

  • Work with product, solutions/support, and other engineering teams to understand customer needs and turn them into solid technical solutions

  • Take part in on-call for the systems you own, and lead incident response and follow-through when things break.

What we are looking for

Technical

  • Solid experience building and operating backend services in production, ideally high-traffic or low-latency ones.

  • Extensive Python knowledge (our primary language).

  • Hands-on experience with observability (metrics, logs, traces) and debugging performance issues in live systems.

  • Experience designing and evolving public APIs that external customers depend on.

  • Experience designing & implementing scalable service-oriented architectures.

Beyond the code

  • Track record of delivering projects end to end, including leading small efforts with other engineers.

  • Collaborative mindset: open to feedback, and willing to change your position when someone has a better argument.

  • Clear written communication - design docs, RFCs, postmortems.

  • Good judgment about trade-offs and scope.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and loosely defined problems.

  • Ownership that extends past merge, to how the system behaves in production.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AWS

  • Background in search, ranking, information retrieval, or e-commerce product discovery.

  • Exposure to AI/LLM-facing infrastructure (MCP, agent tooling, or similar).

Benefits

🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year

🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees

🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

💵 Base salary: $80k–$120k USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results TBD

📈 Stock options - offered in addition to the base salary

🎉 Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every one of the qualifications listed. Our primary interest is in finding the best candidate for the job. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of our listed qualifications.

How we handle your data. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Shopping Agents
descriptionHtml:
Senior Backend Engineer, Shopping Agents

Sage AI Labs · Munich · Full-time · [Remote]

About us

Sage AI Labs is building the infrastructure that lets AI agents transact on the open web. It is one of the few genuinely unsolved problems left in commerce, and whoever solves it sets the defaults everyone else builds on top of.

The company was founded by Sebastian Thrun (founder of Google X and Waymo, Udacity) and is backed by leading venture and strategic investors.

About the role

We build agents that shop for you. They find products across the open web and complete the purchase end to end. Real carts, real payments, and real systems built to stop them.

You would own that. Architecture, code, deploys, monitoring, and on-call for systems that transact around the clock, working directly with our CTO.

What you'll own

Our checkout agents. Frontier-model computer-use agents driving live checkouts at scale, plus the machinery that keeps them standing when the ground moves. Every retailer breaks differently and they change without warning. Your job is to make failure rare and recovery automatic.

Ingestion at scale. Take product ingestion from hundreds of sources to thousands. The answer is not more hand-written code. It is infrastructure that generates, validates, and monitors itself.

Search and ranking. Embedding-based retrieval, LLM query understanding, reranking, and caching, across a catalog that never stops changing.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years building backend and infrastructure systems, with strong Python

  • You have owned production systems end to end: deploys, databases, observability, and the pager. You have been the person who got paged, and you fixed the class of problem rather than the incident

  • You like adversarial problems. Systems where something on the other side is actively working against you

  • You take correctness seriously because the stakes are real. These systems spend customers' money, so a silent failure is a wrong order, not a red build

  • You can move without a finished spec. We are small, and the roadmap changes when the market does

Nice to have

  • Built AI-first products or LLM-based agents in production, not just in a prototype

  • Working knowledge of classic ML and deep learning, enough to reason about retrieval and ranking rather than only calling an API

  • Background in e-commerce, payments, or fraud and risk infrastructure

Why this role

Very few engineers get to own a category-defining system while the category is still being defined. This is one of those seats, at the point where it still counts as early. A year from now this problem will have a standard answer and someone will have written it. We intend for that to be us.

title: Senior Business Analyst / System Engineer CCS – Europäische Standardisierung EU-Rail (50%)
descriptionHtml:
Im Rahmen des europäischen Projekts «Europäische Standardisierung CCS-Strecke» arbeiten gemeinsam mit führenden internationalen Bahnindustrieunternehmen wie Siemens, Hitachi, Alstom und CAF sowie europäischen Infrastrukturbetreibern wie DB, SNCF, RFI, ÖBB, Network Rail und ProRail an der Weiterentwicklung und Harmonisierung zukünftiger Bahnsysteme.

Das Projekt ist Teil des Europe’s Rail Joint Undertaking (ERJU) und umfasst den System Pillar sowie den Innovation Pillar. Ziel ist die Entwicklung europaweit einheitlicher Betriebsprozesse, Systemarchitekturen und technischer Spezifikationen für die zukünftigen ERTMS-Zielsysteme, insbesondere ETCS Level 2 und Automatic Train Operation (ATO GoA 1/2).

Die erarbeiteten Standards bilden die Grundlage für zukünftige europäische Betriebsvorschriften sowie für die Weiterentwicklung und Beschaffung von Sicherungsanlagen.

Zur Unterstützung der internationalen Projektarbeiten suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Senior Business Analyst / System Engineer im Bereich Control, Command and Signalling (CCS).

  • System Engineering: Erarbeitung und Weiterentwicklung von Systemdefinitionen, Systemarchitekturen und technischen Systemspezifikationen im sicherheitsrelevanten Bahnumfeld (CCS).

  • Spezifikationserstellung: Entwicklung und Abstimmung von System- und Schnittstellenspezifikationen unter Berücksichtigung der Gesamtarchitektur sowie zukünftiger Bahnprozesse.

  • Prozesskoordination: Verantwortung für die effiziente Umsetzung und kontinuierliche Optimierung der Arbeitsprozesse (Workstations) zur Erstellung der Systemspezifikationen.

  • Operative Projektunterstützung: Unterstützung bei der Organisation, Koordination und Umsetzung der internationalen Arbeitsorganisation.

  • Qualitätssicherung: Sicherstellung einer konsistenten, vollständigen und qualitativ hochwertigen Integration der Arbeitsergebnisse in die übergeordneten Systemspezifikationen.

  • Stakeholder-Management: Zusammenarbeit und Abstimmung mit internationalen Industriepartnern, europäischen Infrastrukturbetreibern sowie internen und externen Fachspezialisten.

  • Standardisierung: Mitwirkung bei der Entwicklung europäisch harmonisierter Betriebsprozesse und technischer Standards für zukünftige ERTMS-Systeme.

  • Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (ETH, Universität oder Fachhochschule) in Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Fachgebiet.

  • Umfassende Kenntnisse des Bahnsystems, insbesondere des Bahnbetriebs und der Zugsteuerung.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich internationale Standardisierung im Bahnumfeld.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Erstellung von System- und Schnittstellenspezifikationen im europäischen Umfeld.

  • Erfahrung mit Application Lifecycle Management Tools, insbesondere Polarion.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Inhalte verständlich und zielgruppengerecht zu vermitteln.

  • Sicheres Auftreten im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen nationalen und internationalen Stakeholdern.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen innerhalb Europas.

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The role

Checkout.com is scaling a multi-cloud environment at pace, and security architecture is central to how we do it safely.

As Senior Cloud Security Engineer, you'll work closely with Engineering, GRC, Technology Risk, and Security Operations to embed security into every design decision and to make sure we can see what's happening across the estate once it's live.

You'll help embed security within the design phase and ongoing operations of our multi-cloud posture, define guardrails and policy-as-code standards, and support the strengthening of our SIEM and detection capability. You'll take on the most complex and ambiguous cloud security challenges in the business, and hold engineers to best practices.

This isn't a tool-monitoring role. You're here to lead security-by-design, set best-practice standards, and raise the bar.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Develop and enforce reference security architectures, patterns, and blueprints for secure cloud adoption across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

  • Conduct security assessments for new cloud services, defining preventative and detective controls (via security guardrails) to maintain secure posture and detect drift.

  • Partner with Engineering teams to embed security guardrails early in design, ensuring compliance and resilience without adding friction.

  • Evaluate engineering and platform architecture proposals, identifying security gaps and seeing remediation through to completion.

  • Document and uphold secure-by-design principles and architecture governance, and enforce policy-as-code frameworks aligned with NIST, CIS, and PCI DSS.

  • Set the monitoring scope and priorities for CNAPP/CSPM tooling (e.g. Wiz or equivalent), defining which misconfigurations and vulnerabilities matter most against CIS, NIST, and PCI DSS benchmarks, and holding engineering teams accountable to remediation outcomes.

  • Work with Security Operations to shape cloud logging and detection requirements, ensuring our SIEM has the right visibility across the estate.

  • Collaborate with senior stakeholders to articulate security risks and mitigations in terms that support business decision-making.

Skills and Experience We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with strong technical expertise and a genuine passion for security. Here's what we need:

  • Risk-based decision-making and adherence to regulatory and internal security standards (PCI DSS, NIST, SOC 2, ISO 27001, CIS).

  • Broad knowledge across security domains and their capabilities within AWS, Azure, and GCP, with 6+ years' hands-on experience and SME depth in at least one platform.

  • Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), API security, and IaC security (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates).

  • Securing user and non-user access at scale, including Azure Policy and cloud-native IAM controls.

  • Demonstrated ability to provide clear, security-focused guidance, combined with excellent communication and senior-stakeholder engagement skills, and experience mentoring other engineers.

Nice to Have

  • CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent certifications.

  • AZ-500, AWS Certified Security, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or equivalent cloud security certification.

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.

  • Experience integrating ATT&CK Navigator into SOC workflows.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

title: Senior Computational Engineering Architect (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mission Brief 

Isar Aerospace is seeking a Senior Computational Engineering Architect to establish and drive the long-term vision, standards, methodologies, and digital infrastructure underpinning engineering analysis across current and future launch vehicle programs. You will be responsible for transforming simulation, modeling, optimization, and digital engineering capabilities into a scalable and strategic company asset, ensuring consistency, traceability, automation, and engineering excellence across all disciplines. 

Working closely with the Chief Engineer, Product Principal Engineers, Systems Engineering, Software Platform Team, Design Teams, and IT functions, you will define the future state of engineering analysis, simulation governance, AI-enabled engineering, and the digital thread across the organization. You will ensure that engineering decisions are supported by robust, repeatable, and validated analytical processes while enabling rapid design iteration, optimization, and technology development. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Own CAE standards and methodology. Define company-wide standards, best practices and verification methods, and keep simulation workflows consistent across CFD, FEA, thermal, acoustics and multiphysics.
  • Govern tools and licences. Be the technical authority for CAE software: version management, qualification, roadmaps, licensing, vendor relationships, capability planning and utilisation.
  • Bring in new methods. Evaluate, validate and deploy new simulation technologies, and set up advanced practices such as optimisation, uncertainty quantification and surrogate modelling.
  • Lead AI-driven engineering. Identify high-value use cases, set validation and governance practices, and build agent-based analysis and automated design space exploration, while keeping engineering rigour and traceability.
  • Automate at scale. Define automation frameworks, scripting standards and workflow orchestration across engineering teams.
  • Build the digital thread. Develop simulation-data architectures and model management, and integrate CAE with MBSE, PLM and engineering lifecycle processes.
  • Drive reuse and enable teams. Promote reuse of models, templates and libraries across programs, and support engineers with methodology development, training and coaching.
  • Connect the ecosystem. Work with IT, data engineering, software, systems engineering and discipline leads to make sure the computational engineering environment works as one.

Qualification Checklist 

  • A Master's or PhD in Aerospace, Mechanical or Computational Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Systems Engineering or a related field.
  • At least 8 years in aerospace, defence, nuclear, automotive, motorsport or another highly demanding engineering industry.
  • Deep experience in at least one analysis domain, such as CFD, FEA, thermal, structural dynamics, acoustics, combustion, fluid systems or multiphysics, and a solid understanding of simulation across the full product lifecycle.
  • A track record of developing and governing simulation methods, standards and processes, including verification, validation, model correlation and simulation credibility, and documenting them clearly.
  • Experience building automation frameworks or computational environments for scalable, repeatable workflows, including HPC, cloud or distributed computing.
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as ANSYS, Siemens Simcenter, STAR-CCM+, Abaqus, Nastran, MATLAB/Simulink, Python or OpenMDAO.
  • Familiarity with MBSE, requirements management and engineering data management.
  • Experience managing technical interfaces across disciplines, organisations and levels of seniority, with strong analytical, organisational and communication skills.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with launch vehicles, spacecraft, propulsion systems, or other large-scale aerospace systems. 
  • Experience with multidisciplinary design analysis and optimization (MDAO), design space exploration, or system-level optimization techniques. 

Benefits 

  • Employee Participation Program: Share in our success through our virtual company share program
  • 30 days of vacation: Enjoy the days off to relax and recharge
  • Company pension plan: Secure your future with our company pension plan, featuring a 20% employer contribution after the probation period
  • Subsidised lunch: Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day
  • Rental clothing with laundry service: Enjoy hassle-free workwear with our convenient rental clothing and laundry service  
  • Sport Clubs membership: Stay fit with our sponsored sports club memberships (EGYM Wellpass)
  • Individual learning allowance: Grow your skills with an individual learning budget granted after the probation period
  • Childcare allowance: Receive a childcare allowance for your non-school-age children
  • Flexible mobility budget: Travel your way with a choice between a fully financed Deutschlandticket, JobRad bicycle leasing, FINN JobAuto, or a fuel allowance
  • And Much More! Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team        

Who we are

We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

We are a fast-growing company aiming to provide sustainable and environmentally friendly launch solutions for small and medium-sized satellites and constellations into Low Earth Orbit. The company is privately funded by world-leading technology investors with strong commitment and support and our team is made of driven and talented people with a real passion for space innovation.

We're making rockets in a way that hasn't been done before disrupting a traditional industry. If you are up for the challenge, want to work on cutting-edge projects and be part of a team changing the world for better, come, join us and launch your career!

title: Senior Data Product Partner - (Spend & Control)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Opportunity:

We are building a new team of Data Product Partners to bridge the gap between business needs and complex data systems, ensuring our data assets are trustworthy, discoverable, impactful and truly solve user problems.

As a Senior Data Product Partner (DPP), you will be the driving force behind the impact of our data team with the Perk business. You will move fluently between business and data worlds, making critical decisions rooted in both user needs and technical reality. Your goal is to move beyond simply providing solutions to proving demonstrable business impact.

  • Role Title: Senior Data Product Partner

  • Reporting To: Manager, Data Product Partner

  • Core Mandate: Be the primary data consultant, fixer, strategist, and relationship manager for a specific business domain (e.g. Customer Care, Finance, Marketing, Revenue, Spend & Control, Travel)

  • We are open to either Regular or Senior profiles

What You’ll Do:

Relationship Management and Strategy

  • Develop Business Data Strategy: Collaborate with business leaders to define how data can drive their strategic goals, solve critical challenges, and uncover new opportunities

  • Identify and Qualify Value: Proactively identify high-impact use cases and data initiatives that will generate maximum measurable value (e.g., revenue increase, cost reduction, efficiency gain) for the partner business unit

  • Act as the primary translator across all disciplines, explaining the same concept differently to different data team roles and executives

  • Proactively manage expectations and define the appropriate scope and flexible roadmaps

  • Develop Product Sense for Data, anticipating common data quality issues, recognising when simpler solutions are better, and strategically saying "no" to requests that compromise our aligned vision

  • Publicise and amplify the work that has been done to drive adoption of and learning from our solutions

  • Coach teams to be able to self serve their own preliminary investigations

Demand Shaping and Portfolio Management

  • Focus on defining what to build and why (Data Product Partner) rather than how (AE/ DA/ DE/ DS/ DG). Ensuring that we built the right thing - vs the Data Team Lead owning did we build the thing right

  • While the Data teams own the timeline estimates, the DPP defines the urgency, the required business target date and the prioritisation, which then influences how the Craft team approaches the estimate

  • Shape and Prioritise Demand: Work with business stakeholders to clarify their data needs, translating vague requests into well-defined, measurable projects and technical data requirements that can be handed over to the Data Teams

  • Manage the Business Unit's Data Portfolio: Oversee the pipeline of data projects, data products and initiatives relevant to their business unit, ensuring alignment with capacity and strategic priorities. Work closely with Data teams to evaluate technical tradeoffs with potential business impact

  • Conduct Value Realisation Tracking: Continuously monitor and report on the actual business outcomes and ROI delivered by completed data projects and products

Ad-Hoc Analysis, Triage & Intake Management

  • The Data Product Partner is the first line of response for data questions from the business and plays a critical role in determining the right level of effort and ownership

  • Conduct initial ad-hoc analysis where appropriate, including lightweight SQL queries, exploratory analysis in Looker as well as quick validations, sanity checks, and hypothesis testing

  • Use this initial analysis to answer simple, time-sensitive business questions directly, clarify the underlying problem and assess feasibility, data quality, and potential impact

  • Triage and prioritise ad-hoc requests by determining whether the request can be resolved quickly vs. requires deeper analytical or engineering work. Escalate and hand over well-defined requests to Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science or Data Governance when needed. Provide clear context, urgency, and success criteria to downstream teams

  • Actively identify recurring ad-hoc requests that indicate a gap in existing dashboards or data products, a need for improved data quality, documentation, or enablement or an opportunity to convert reactive work into scalable data products

Consultation and Enablement

  • Provide Data Consulting: Offer expert advice to business stakeholders on data availability, appropriate methodologies, and the interpretation of data insights

  • Drive Data Literacy and Adoption: Champion the use of data tools and insights within the business unit, coaching teams on how to effectively integrate data into their daily decision-making processes

  • Proactively surface observations, trends, or risks as nuggets of insight

  • Bridge the Data-to-Action Gap: Ensure that insights are clearly communicated, translated and embedded into concrete business actions and process changes

  • Ensure that the pain points of Data Quality gaps are identified and prioritised within the Data Team

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Brand & Communications team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

Your Profile

  • Product UX depth. You've designed complex, data-dense software where clarity matters a great deal. Experience with mission-critical, industrial, aerospace, automotive or developer tools is a strong plus.

  • Founder mindset. You set your own priorities, move fast, ship rough work when that's what's needed, and polish what matters. You're happy without process and will build just enough of it.

  • Clear communicator. You present and defend your work to founders, engineers and customers.

  • Fluent in Figma and, most importantly, at the frontier of leveraging AI for design work.

  

Perks & Benefits

This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist.

About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Our core expertise lies in 3D vision and graphics technologies which we deploy in a dual-use context for inspection and defence. This role will focus mainly on the defence context where we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Our solutions are aimed to operate with low-cost and widely available sensors and compute. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

Your role

You will collaborate closely with our embedded software, systems, and our hardware and forward deployed engineers to design and bring up the PCBs that power the compute and sensor platforms onboard our UAVs — from schematic to flight-ready hardware. You'll set the technical direction for PCB design and hardware bring-up, working with freelance designers and contract manufacturers along the way.

  • Designing multi-layer, high-density PCBs from schematic capture through layout and release.

  • Routing high-speed digital buses (PCIe Gen3/Gen4, MIPI CSI/DSI, USB 3.x) with proper impedance control and length matching.

  • Designing DC power systems for onboard UAV compute and sensor platforms that hold up under LiPo battery voltage sag and EMI from motors and ESCs.

  • Bringing up new boards: debugging schematics and circuits, chasing down electrical issues on the bench, and flashing firmware to validate hardware.

  • Setting technical direction for PCB design and bring-up across the hardware team.

  • Owning hardware from prototype through to a field-ready product.

What we expect from you

  • Senior-level PCB design experience — we'll judge this by the strength and depth of your portfolio rather than a fixed year count.

  • Deep experience with multi-layer PCB design and stack-up planning.

  • Proven high-speed digital routing experience: PCIe (Gen3/Gen4), MIPI CSI/DSI, USB 3.x — impedance-controlled, length-matched traces on multi-layer boards.

  • Experience with DC power filtering and EMI mitigation for battery-powered systems with noisy motor/ESC loads.

  • Hands-on PCB bring-up experience: schematic and circuit debugging, bench-level fault-finding, and flashing firmware to validate hardware.

  • Proficiency in Altium and/or KiCad, plus a circuit simulation tool.

  • A portfolio of PCB projects you've designed and brought up yourself — we will ask to see it.

  • Experience designing PCBs for RF/communications or radar applications, ideally with CST Studio Suite or similar EM simulation tools — a big plus, not required.

  • Experience with SBC/embedded carrier boards (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson, Rockchip) and camera/sensor interfacing (MIPI CSI cabling, I²C buses) is a plus.

  • A willingness to pick up and learn new concepts quickly and to self-acquire missing background knowledge.

  • A high degree of autonomy, determination and grit in making cool tech work.

  • Full time availability (40 hours)

What we offer

  • Money of course.

  • 25 vacation days per year.

  • Reimbursed travel expenses and company laptop.

  • (Really) flexible working hours — this role is bench- and lab-based, so we do need you on-site, but start/end times are yours to shape.

  • Working in an international, world-class team of engineers and entrepreneurs solving real-life problems with amazing technology.

  • Large freedom in how you work and implement solutions, project ownership is incredibly important to us.

  • The opportunity to take technical risks, to implement stuff the 'right' way and to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops. We are innovating, learning is to be expected.

  • Responsibility over the things you build, you are the expert on what you design and bring up.

The application procedure

  • If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us a portfolio of PCB projects you've designed and brought up, along with a resume, website, or other source that gives us a clear impression of your background and skills.

  • We'll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we'll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a second focused interview could follow.

  • If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we'll discuss the specifics.

  • Welcome to the team!

descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead Financial Experience (FinXP), the team that builds how practices and patients deal with money at Nelly.

That covers how a patient says yes to a treatment they can’t pay for upfront, and how delivered care becomes an invoice, then a payment, then cash in the practice’s account. You’ll lead a team whose work shows up directly in what practices earn and in what Nelly earns.

The problem space: Practices rarely lose revenue because care isn’t needed. They lose it at two points. Before treatment, patients delay or decline because they can’t pay upfront. After treatment, revenue leaks on its way to cash: invoices go out late or wrong, payments get chased by hand, and billing runs through manual steps. The domain Financial OS closes both gaps. We offer financing at the moment the patient decides, through installment plans and factoring, and we turn every delivered treatment into a correct invoice and cash in the practice’s account. Because we sit where treatment is planned, we know what it’s worth and whether it is converted before we take on the risk, which no bank or payment provider can do. We earn a share of the revenue we help collect, so the practice’s growth is our growth.

The domain has two teams. Financial Platform builds the infrastructure that moves money and keeps compliant records of it. Financial Experience builds everything doctors, practice staff, patients and our own teams touch, across the Doctor Portal, Patient Portal and Backoffice.

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

title: Senior EW Direction Finding & Estimation Engineer (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

YOUR MISSION

You will turn our directional mesh network into a sensor. Using the same aperture that carries traffic, you will build direction finding, spectrum sensing, and GNSS-free position estimation, and prove their accuracy in the field against surveyed references. You own the error budget and the evidence, from IQ samples up to a validated position.

ABOUT THE TEAM

STARK's Electronic Warfare team is a systems-focussed engineering group delivering software-defined, mass-scalable RF solutions for autonomous systems. Combining deep domain expertise in hardware board design, thermal/ structural packaging, real-time C++ signal processing, and resilient directional mesh networking, we rapidly build field advanced EW capabilities designed to survive and operate in contested spectrum environments. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Build position estimation from the mesh itself under GNSS denial: TDOA/TOA ranging, multilateration, geometry and GDOP, the clock-synchronisation error budget, and fusion with platform navigation.
  • Develop the DF and baseline spectrum-sensing chain on the directional aperture that carries traffic, running concurrently with communications.
  • Own antenna calibration together with the antenna team, and keep it valid in the field.
  • Own the error budget, design validation campaigns against surveyed references, and produce the evidence packs for programme milestones.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • You have measured DF accuracy against real signals and done localisation with an explicit geometry and error budget. Practical experience is what counts here, not GNSS integration or theory alone.
  • You have run measurement campaigns validated against a surveyed reference.
  • You have calibrated an antenna array yourself.
  • You work comfortably from IQ data and channel-level observables upward.

NICE TO HAVE

  • A background in direction finding, radar, or SIGINT, whether from industry, a research institute, or space-based SIGINT.
  • Publications with a real measurement section.
  • Kalman filter or factor-graph estimation.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

title: Senior Garment Technologist
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Garment Technologist

We are seeking a Senior Garment Technologist to join the founding team of Quince’s new London Design Atelier. In this role, you will own the technical execution, fit, construction, and consistency of ready-to-wear products across Women’s and Men’s, partnering closely with Design, Pattern Cutting, Product Development, Sourcing, Quality, and external manufacturing partners.

This is a highly hands-on role at the intersection of creative design and product execution. You will translate design intent into technically sound, production-ready garments, leading fittings, developing fit blocks and technical standards, and solving construction and pattern challenges throughout the development process.

Success in this role means making fit, construction, and quality a competitive advantage for Quince — improving product consistency and customer satisfaction while reducing returns and enabling faster, more efficient product development as we scale.

Responsibilities

  • Own the technical development and fit process from initial prototype through production approval across Women’s and Men’s RTW.

  • Lead fit sessions and provide clear, actionable fit, construction, and pattern comments.
  • Assess garment proportions, balance, construction, finishing, and overall fit, recommending technical solutions where needed.
  • Develop, maintain, and evolve fit blocks, grading standards, and technical standards across key product categories.
  • Create and maintain accurate technical specifications, measurements, construction details, and fit documentation.
  • Review patterns and recommend pattern amendments to resolve fit, construction, and production issues.
  • Partner with Product Development, Sourcing, and Quality to ensure products meet Quince standards for fit, construction, quality, cost, and manufacturability.
  • Work directly with external vendors and factories to troubleshoot technical challenges and ensure accurate execution of product.
  • Identify technical risks early in development and drive solutions before production.
  • Use customer feedback, returns, product ratings, and other performance data to identify opportunities to improve fit and product execution.
  • Help establish scalable technical development processes, standards, documentation, and ways of working for the London Atelier.
  • Partner with global teams and vendors to ensure technical standards are consistently understood and executed.
  • Leverage digital and 3D development tools where appropriate to accelerate fittings, development, and decision-making.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 8+ years of experience in garment technology, technical design, product engineering, or a closely related technical apparel role.
  • Strong multi-product RTW experience, ideally across both Women’s and Men’s.
  • Deep technical knowledge of garment construction, pattern cutting and amendments, grading, fit, fabrics, and production requirements.
  • Strong experience with tailoring and structured product, with the ability to technically assess complex garments.
  • Demonstrated experience owning the fit and technical development process from prototype through production approval.
  • Highly skilled in conducting fittings and translating observations into precise, actionable technical and pattern corrections.
  • Strong understanding of technical specifications, measurements, tolerances, construction methods, and production standards.
  • Experience partnering directly with designers, pattern cutters, product developers, sourcing teams, factories, and vendors.
  • Strong product judgment with an exceptional eye for fit, proportion, construction, and detail.
  • Comfortable using customer and product performance data to inform technical decisions and prioritize improvements.
  • Highly hands-on, solutions-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple products and development timelines simultaneously.

Preferred:

  • Experience within a premium, luxury, or highly design-led fashion environment.
  • Deep expertise in tailoring, outerwear, and other technically complex RTW categories.
  • Experience developing and maintaining fit blocks and technical standards across multiple product categories.
  • Experience working with international vendors and manufacturing partners.
  • Experience with digital pattern review, 3D fitting, or virtual product development tools.
  • Experience helping establish or evolve a technical function, pattern room, atelier, or product creation organization.

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

descriptionHtml:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry.
Its offerings include a very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components.
Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Quandela is looking for a Senior IP & Patent Manager combining strong scientific understanding with substantial hands-on experience in patent drafting, prosecution and IP strategy implementation.

Your primary focus will be to work directly with our technical teams and personally draft patent applications and claims, while shaping and implementing an ambitious IP strategy to support Quandela’s growth as a leading photonic quantum computing company.

You will translate complex inventions into effective patent protection across areas such as photonics, semiconductor technologies, quantum hardware, system architectures and computer-implemented inventions. You will not be expected to be an expert in every field: we are looking for someone who can quickly understand unfamiliar technical subjects, ask the right questions and develop robust applications based on input from our researchers and engineers.

This is a senior, hands-on role combining substantial drafting work with strategic judgement and autonomous execution. You will develop IP strategy proposals with the C-level and take responsibility for translating agreed priorities into clear plans, measurable objectives and results. Overall strategic direction and major decisions will remain with the C-level.

You will also serve as a trusted IP counterpart for management, investors and partners, drawing on external patent attorneys and specialist legal counsel across jurisdictions, particularly as Quandela expands its presence in the United States.


** Your key responsibilities

Work directly with inventors and personally draft patent applications

  • Spend a substantial proportion of your time working with technical teams and personally drafting patent applications and claims.
  • Identify inventions through regular interaction with researchers and engineers, and assess their technical contribution and potential scope of protection.
  • Lead invention disclosure discussions, clarify complex scientific concepts and identify protection opportunities beyond the initial disclosure.
  • Draft clear specifications and robust claims, anticipating prosecution challenges and potential commercial applications.
  • Handle prosecution directly where appropriate, and coordinate with external patent attorneys according to jurisdiction, technical needs and workload.
  • Ensure that external support complements your own drafting work and meets the required technical and quality standards.

Shape IP strategy and independently drive its implementation

  • Assess the existing portfolio and recommend protection priorities aligned with Quandela’s scientific roadmap, product development and international ambitions.
  • Advise the C-level on the balance between patents, trade secrets and publications, and on filing priorities, geographical coverage and portfolio maintenance.
  • Translate agreed strategic priorities into an actionable IP roadmap, with clear objectives, timelines, budget requirements and measurable outcomes.
  • Take ownership of day-to-day implementation, escalating major strategic, financial or legal decisions to the appropriate C-level stakeholders.
  • Conduct targeted patent landscape and competitor analyses to inform portfolio development and business decisions.
  • Anticipate future protection needs, including those associated with expansion in the United States and other priority markets.

Coordinate international protection and specialist expertise

  • Coordinate international filings and prosecution across Europe, the United States and Asia, engaging local patent experts as needed.
  • Select and manage external advisers based on relevant expertise, quality, responsiveness and cost.
  • Draw on and develop a professional network of trusted patent and legal specialists across key jurisdictions.
  • Scope and coordinate freedom-to-operate assessments with external specialists, translating findings into practical recommendations.
  • Coordinate opposition proceedings and other contentious patent matters with specialist counsel when required.
  • Work with legal counsel on IP provisions in research collaborations, joint development agreements and licensing arrangements, including ownership and access rights.

Act as a trusted IP counterpart for management, investors and partners

  • Provide clear, well-supported advice on IP risks, protection opportunities and portfolio priorities.
  • Present Quandela’s IP approach and portfolio coherently and credibly in investor discussions and due diligence processes, in coordination with management.
  • Support partnerships and potential corporate transactions by coordinating IP analysis and specialist input.
  • Explain complex patent matters in terms that enable informed technical and business decisions.

Build practical processes that support delivery

  • Establish efficient processes for invention disclosures, publication reviews, confidentiality and portfolio monitoring.
  • Manage the IP budget, external counsel relationships and portfolio tools within agreed parameters.
  • Build IP awareness through practical guidance and regular interaction with technical teams.
  • Report on progress against agreed objectives, portfolio developments and decisions requiring management input.
  • Identify when additional external support or internal resources are needed to deliver the IP roadmap while maintaining a strong focus on drafting.

Requirements

  • A PhD, or equivalent experience in physics or a closely related discipline, such as quantum physics, photonics, optics, semiconductor physics or materials science.
  • Specialist training in European patent law, such as the CEIPI patent programme or an equivalent European patent training pathway.
  • European Patent Attorney qualification strongly preferred. Candidates at an advanced stage towards qualification will also be considered if they demonstrate substantial relevant experience and the seniority to take ownership of the role.
  • At least 8 years of professional experience in patent drafting and prosecution, in addition to doctoral research, with a demonstrable record of personally drafting technically complex applications and claims.
  • Experience gained in a patent attorney firm, an in-house IP team, or both, with meaningful responsibility for portfolio development and client or business advice.
  • Strong technical reasoning and the ability to understand unfamiliar subjects through focused discussions with domain experts. Experience in one or more relevant fields—such as photonics, semiconductors, quantum technologies, electronics or computer-implemented inventions—is expected; expertise across all these fields is not required.
  • Strong practical knowledge of EPO procedures and experience coordinating international patent protection, including working with US patent counsel.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop IP recommendations and independently implement agreed priorities, managing timelines, budgets and external advisers.
  • Firsthand experience advising on consequential IP decisions in situations relevant to a growing technology company, such as international expansion, partnerships, fundraising or competitive patent risks.
  • The credibility and communication skills to act as a trusted counterpart for technical leaders, senior management, investors and external advisers.
  • Sound judgement about when to act autonomously, when to seek specialist advice and when to escalate decisions.
  • Fluent English and French.

Additional experience we would value

  • Direct experience protecting quantum computing inventions or technologies at the interface between hardware and software.
  • Experience supporting research-intensive companies, start-ups or scale-ups through international growth.
  • An established network of patent attorneys and specialist advisers, particularly in Europe and the United States.
  • Experience presenting IP portfolios and strategies to investors or supporting fundraising due diligence.
  • Experience with freedom-to-operate studies, licensing or public-private research collaborations.
  • Experience in EPO opposition proceedings, familiarity with US patent practice, and knowledge of the Unitary Patent and Unified Patent Court.
  • French CPI or another national patent attorney qualification.
  • Research experience beyond the PhD, particularly in quantum technologies, photonics or semiconductor physics.

Benefits

Why join Quandela?

You will work directly with the scientists and engineers developing photonic quantum computing technologies and help shape how their inventions are protected and commercialised.

The role offers the opportunity to combine scientific depth, patent expertise and strategic responsibility, while building an IP function that supports Quandela’s international growth.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
  • Hiring Managers Interviews (45')
  • Use Case
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 to 3 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

title: Senior IT Administrator (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Jobbeschreibung

StackFuel ist seit Jahren einer der führenden Anbieter für Daten- und KI-Weiterbildung in Deutschland. Seit Anfang 2026 sind wir Teil von Multiverse, Europas einzigem EdTech-Unicorn und der größten AI-Upskilling-Plattform des Kontinents. Gemeinsam verfolgen wir ein klares Ziel: 100.000 Beschäftigte in Deutschland fit für KI zu machen und so die Daten- und KI-Kompetenzlücke im Land zu schließen.

Du steigst als zentrale IT-Ansprechperson für Deutschland bei uns ein, mit Sitz in Berlin und Verantwortung für die Standorte Berlin, München und Düsseldorf sowie für Kolleg:innen im Remote-Setup in der DACH-Region. Du berichtest an die globale IT-Leitung in Großbritannien, arbeitest eng mit dem UK-basierten Enterprise-Technology-Team zusammen und verantwortest den IT-Alltag in Deutschland mit hoher Eigenständigkeit. Dazu gehört die technische Integration von StackFuel in die IT-Landschaft von Multiverse.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bist die lokale IT-Ansprechperson in Deutschland und bietest schnellen, verlässlichen Support auf Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Du sorgst für ein stabiles, nutzerfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld im Büro (AV, WLAN, Meetingräume) in Berlin, München und Düsseldorf.

  • Du verantwortest den Joiner-Mover-Leaver-Prozess (JML) und den Hardware-Lifecycle von Anfang bis Ende: Beschaffung, Imaging, Rollout, Reparaturen und Asset-Management.

  • Du administrierst Endgeräte (macOS, Windows) und Identitäten systemübergreifend, u. a. in JumpCloud/Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace, Slack und weiteren SaaS-Tools.

  • Du unterstützt lokale IT- und Sicherheitsprüfungen nach ISO 27001 und Cyber Essentials Plus und stellst sicher, dass Prozesse DSGVO-konform sind.

  • Du identifizierst und implementierst Automatisierungen (z. B. mit n8n oder Skripten), die manuelle und fehleranfällige Prozesse ersetzen.

  • Du setzt IT- und Sicherheitskontrollen um und dokumentierst sie.

  • Du begleitest die technische Integration von StackFuel in die bestehende IT-Landschaft von Multiverse und übernimmst dabei auch anspruchsvollere, standortübergreifende Projekte mit strategischer Bedeutung für die weitere Verzahnung der beiden Geografien.

  • Du unterstützt IT-Service-Management-Prozesse und deren Dokumentation (z. B. nach ITIL-Prinzipien).

  • Du wirkst an internen IT-Projekten mit anderen Teams mit (z. B. Rollouts, Tool-Einführungen und Security-Initiativen).

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem globalen Enterprise-Technology-Team zusammen, hältst globale Standards ein und entwickelst sie mit weiter.

  • Du stimmst Dich mit HR (JML), Office Management, Fachabteilungen, den Verantwortlichen für Compliance, Datenschutz und Sicherheit sowie bei Bedarf mit externen Dienstleistern ab.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im IT-Support oder in der Systemadministration, idealerweise als alleinige oder leitende IT-Ansprechperson für ein Büro oder einer Business Unit.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Endpoint-Management (macOS und Windows), Identity and Access Management (IAM) und SaaS-Administration.

  • Grundkenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik (WLAN, LAN, Routing, Firewalls).

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit:

    • Google Workspace

    • Entra, optional Okta

    • Mac-Flottenmanagement (z. B. Iru, Jamf)

    • IT-Service-Management (z. B. ITIL) und IT-Asset-Management

    • ISO-27001-Umgebungen

Technische Kompetenz

  • Sicherer Umgang mit macOS und Windows sowie deren Administration in Unternehmensumgebungen.

  • Erfahrung in der Administration von IAM-Systemen und SaaS-Tools (z. B. Collaboration- und Produktivitätsplattformen).

  • Skripting-Kenntnisse (z. B. Bash, PowerShell, Python) und Erfahrung mit Automatisierungstools (z. B. n8n), um wiederkehrende Aufgaben zu automatisieren.

  • Verständnis für IT-Sicherheitsanforderungen, insbesondere im Kontext von ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials Plus und DSGVO.

Persönliche Stärken

  • Ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz sowie eine eigenständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Ownership-Mindset mit hohem Verantwortungsbewusstsein für Stabilität, Sicherheit und Nutzerzufriedenheit.

  • Klare, ruhige und serviceorientierte Kommunikation, auch unter Druck.

  • Die Fähigkeit, die Bedürfnisse unterschiedlicher Stakeholder zu verstehen und in praxistaugliche IT-Lösungen zu übersetzen.

Weitere Anforderungen

  • „Automation-first“-Denkweise: Du ersetzt manuelle Prozesse durch robuste, skalierbare Lösungen.

  • Praxisnahes Verständnis der DSGVO und ihrer Anwendung in IT-Prozessen.

  • Fließend Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung im EdTech-Umfeld oder in einem schnell wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen.

Das bieten wir Dir

 

Arbeitskultur

Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership

Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Hybrides Arbeiten

Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation

Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch

Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung

Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

title: Senior IT Support Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Senior IT Support Analyst

➡️ An experienced IT professional who thrives on taking ownership, solving problems independently and delivering exceptional employee support?

➡️ Confident administering Microsoft 365, managing workplace technology and troubleshooting complex IT issues without relying on constant supervision?

➡️ Enjoy being the go-to person for IT, combining strong technical expertise with excellent people skills and a proactive, solutions-focused mindset?

➡️ Excited by the opportunity to take ownership of IT support for our London office and help shape how a growing, AI-first business operates?

If this sounds like your next move, we'd love to hear from you!

Role Summary:

We're looking for an experienced, proactive and technically confident Senior IT Support Analyst to take ownership of day-to-day IT support and operations for our London office.

Supporting approximately 150 employees in London, alongside remote colleagues across the UK, Europe and parts of APAC, you'll be our primary onsite IT specialist, ensuring our people, systems and workplace technology run smoothly.

This is a high-autonomy, hands-on position suited to someone who has already developed strong technical foundations and is confident working independently. You'll be responsible for resolving technical issues, administering our Microsoft 365 environment, managing employee IT onboarding and offboarding, maintaining office infrastructure and supporting IT security and compliance.

We're looking for someone who can hit the ground running. Someone who doesn't need constant direction, takes ownership of challenges through to resolution and can confidently make decisions, manage priorities and identify opportunities to improve how we operate.

Just as importantly, we're looking for a genuine people person. Someone approachable, patient and professional, who understands that great IT support isn't simply about fixing technology; it's about ensuring colleagues feel supported and can do their best work.

As Patsnap continues its transformation into an AI-first organisation, you'll also play a role in supporting the secure adoption of enterprise AI tools, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Claude Enterprise.

This is a predominantly office-based role in our Farringdon office, with onsite attendance currently expected Monday to Thursday and occasional flexibility to work remotely depending on business needs.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing?
Check out this short overview:

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, pre-IPO company that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research & Development productivity. Our platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle, using domain-specific AI to accelerate the creation of market-ready products. With over 12,000 customers worldwide, including some of the biggest names in innovation, Patsnap is at the forefront of technological advancement. Our $300M Series E funding round brings our valuation to a $1 billion unicorn status, and we still have a remarkable amount of growth ahead.

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in London, Toronto, Singapore, Shanghai and remote teams based in US. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Act as the primary onsite IT contact for the London office, providing visible, hands-on first and second-line support for hardware, software, Microsoft 365 and connectivity issues, and remote support for colleagues across the UK, Europe and parts of APAC.

  • Deliver a seamless onboarding and offboarding experience by setting up user accounts, provisioning devices, managing application access, and ensuring secure deprovisioning.

  • Manage user provisioning and permissions across Microsoft 365, Salesforce and other business SaaS platforms, applying role-based access principles.

  • Configure and maintain Windows and macOS devices through Microsoft Intune, and manage IT assets and inventory for the region.

  • Own the office IT infrastructure, including video conferencing and meeting room technology, door access, printers and the communications room, and coordinate with our outsourced network provider on connectivity and access point issues.

  • Take on practical, hands-on tasks such as cabling, equipment setup and desk moves

  • Work closely with the UK Office Manager, providing practical support with day-to-day office needs and shared projects.

  • Support our security and compliance programs by assisting with access reviews, audit evidence, and IT controls for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 using Vanta.

  • Administer and support enterprise AI tools, including ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise, and Microsoft Copilot, promote secure adoption and best practices, and actively look for ways to apply AI to improve IT support and everyday workflows.

  • Prioritise competing requests based on business impact, proactively identify improvements, and take issues through to resolution.

  • Collaborate with colleagues across our global IT team on projects, escalations, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Technologies You'll Work With

  • Microsoft 365: Teams, Outlook, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Entra ID and Intune.

  • Enterprise AI: ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise and Microsoft Copilot.

  • Security & Compliance: Vanta, ISO 27001 and SOC 2.

  • Office Technology: Video conferencing, meeting room systems, networking and door access.

  • Business SaaS: Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Gong, ZoomInfo and Lusha.

And plenty more! We're continually evolving our technology, so there'll be opportunities to learn and work with new tools as we grow.


What We'd Love From You:

Above all, we're looking for someone who combines strong hands-on technical expertise, proven independence and a genuine passion for helping people. You'll be comfortable being the go-to IT specialist in an office, confident making decisions and resolving issues without constant supervision, while remaining approachable, collaborative and focused on delivering an exceptional employee experience.

  • Relevant IT Support Experience: A minimum of 3 years' professional experience in IT support, desktop support, IT operations or a similar hands-on technical role. Ideally, you've worked in a standalone, primary onsite IT support or similarly autonomous position, taking responsibility for a broad range of technical requirements.

  • Strong Microsoft 365 Administration: Demonstrable hands-on experience independently administering Microsoft 365, particularly Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online and SharePoint, including user management, identity and access controls, licensing and device administration.

  • Technical Independence & Troubleshooting: Proven ability to independently diagnose and resolve hardware, software, operating system and connectivity issues across Windows and macOS. Comfortable investigating unfamiliar problems and knowing when to escalate appropriately.

  • SaaS & Access Management: Experience administering cloud-based business applications, managing user provisioning, permissions and secure access, alongside employee onboarding and offboarding processes.

  • IT Security & Compliance: Practical experience supporting IT security controls, access reviews, device compliance or audit activities relating to frameworks such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2.

  • Ownership & Accountability: A self-sufficient, dependable professional who takes responsibility for IT issues, follows through to resolution and proactively identifies opportunities to improve systems and processes.

  • Prioritisation & Judgement: Confident managing competing priorities, responding calmly to unexpected challenges and making sound decisions based on business impact, without requiring day-to-day supervision.

  • Excellent People Skills: Approachable, patient and an excellent communicator, with a genuine passion for supporting colleagues and making technology accessible to employees of all technical abilities.

  • A Practical, Hands-On Mindset: Comfortable taking responsibility for onsite IT needs, from device configuration and meeting room technology to hardware troubleshooting, cabling and equipment setup.

  • Adaptability & Continuous Improvement: Curious, resourceful and comfortable working in a fast-moving technology environment, with an interest in AI, automation and emerging workplace technologies.

Even better if you have:

  • Previous experience as the primary IT contact for an office or supporting multiple locations with limited onsite technical assistance.

  • Experience working in a growing SaaS, technology or internationally distributed business.

  • Experience with Vanta or direct involvement in ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits.

  • Experience administering Salesforce, HubSpot or other enterprise SaaS platforms.

  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, MS-900 or Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administrator.

  • Experience supporting or mentoring less experienced IT colleagues.

  • Mandarin or Cantonese language skills, which would be helpful when collaborating with colleagues in our East region.

Benefits & Perks:

A genuinely strong culture we’re really proud of. High-performing but low ego, collaborative, social, and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares best practice, raises standards, and celebrates wins properly together. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

Additional benefits

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Two paid volunteering days

  • Private healthcare with AXA

  • Pension with Scottish Widows

  • Enhanced parental leave policies

  • Work from home stipend

  • Cycle to Work scheme

  • Life assurance
