title: Senior Java Engineer - Security - Elasticsearch
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Developer to join the Elasticsearch Security team. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture and design of Elasticsearch's main features. These features include authentication, authorization, and tenant isolation. You will work with engineering and product leaders at Elastic. Your goal is to participate in providing high-performance security at all levels. This includes ensuring that our distributed data store has top-quality security at scale.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Contributing to core security initiatives from architecture to production, focusing on the delivery of new critical features. Participating in the technical design, planning, and execution for major security components inside the Elasticsearch core engine.
  • Developing the foundational security models for features.
  • Optimizing security performance at scale in distributed systems environments.
  • Applying cryptographic solutions to address genuine customer use cases.
  • Ensuring robust data isolation within shared infrastructure supporting disparate customers.
  • Monitoring and applying the latest advancements and best practices in security. This includes authentication, identity management, cryptography, and data access management.
  • Collaborating with peers across the company to embed security into new customer features from the outset.
  • Drive vulnerability management efforts by collaborating closely with the InfoSec team to proactively identify, assess, and remediate security risks.
  • Leverage AI-driven tools to automate vulnerability triage, prioritization, and preliminary investigation, streamlining security workflows and reducing manual intervention

What You Bring 

  • You have deep knowledge of Java internals and JVM memory management. You understand how concurrency models work. You can write code that is high-performance, thread-safe, and lock-free. This experience includes working with large open-source and enterprise codebases.
  • You have experience building authorization systems that are scalable and performant under high concurrency and large permission sets, including designing access models, validating credentials/tokens at scale, and keeping authorization decisions consistent across a distributed system.
  • You have a solid comprehension of distributed systems security, including node-to-node mutual trust, zero-trust transport, partition tolerance and cluster state propagation.
  • You have a deep knowledge of edge identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML).
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still collaborating on the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, supporting decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of cipher suites, TLS handshakes, and PKI/certificate lifecycle management.
  • Cryptographic methods considering memory usage and delays.
  • Familiarity with the implications of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) and readiness to support the migration of services to quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms.
  • Hands-on experience mapping engine-level technical controls to FedRAMP (Moderate/High), FIPS 140, and SOC 2 requirements.
  • Experience working on the internals of a data store or search engine.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. title: Senior LCA Engineer
descriptionHtml:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers.

Emidat aims to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Your core mission is to turn LCA methodology into software that works at scale. You own the full chain from methodological question to working software solution and take ownership of the team's most complex methodological and technical challenges. You make sure each new product category, market and verification takes less time and effort, working with high autonomy and high accountability.

As an early senior member of a fast-growing climate-tech company, your career trajectory is entirely in your hands. This role offers unparalleled visibility and growth. You can deepen your expertise as a technical expert in the team, or leverage your domain knowledge to pivot into high-impact roles across Customer Success, Sales, or Product. Exceptional early joiners are primed for future Team Lead and leadership positions.

In the first 6 months, you will

  • Lead strategic projects: Take full ownership of complex, ambiguous projects such as new markets, program operators or complex product categories. Define requirements, navigate trade-offs, delegate across the team and drive delivery.

  • Shape the product core: Work closely with our software engineers to translate environmental science and ISO/EN standards into clean, scalable software requirements, and propose complete implementation strategies for whole concepts, not individual features.

  • Scale our LCA work: Reduce the time and effort for recurring work such as tool verifications, new product category implementations and matching, through automation, reusable standards and better processes. Turn verifier feedback into requirements that solve the issue for good.

  • Scale tool verifications: Work with program operators and verifiers to establish processes that make tool verifications faster, more predictable and repeatable across markets and product categories.

  • Set the standard: Define what clear requirements and architecturally sound solutions look like, and take ownership of refining our methodologies for PCFs, LCAs and EPDs.

  • Improve how we work: Identify problems others don't see, turn them into actionable proposals, and solve recurring problems at the root instead of case by case.

  • Grow the team: Mentor junior colleagues and give them regular, actionable feedback.

  • Shape the industry: Help establish Emidat as a thought leader in LCA, e.g. by representing us in ECO Platform working groups and in the committees that author PCRs.

What you will bring to this role

Minimum requirements

  • Extensive LCA expertise: You bring deep expertise and experience conducting Life Cycle Assessments, LCA calculation methodology, PCRs and ecoinvent/matching logic. You showcase ownership of complex, ambiguous methodological or technical challenges.

  • Mastery of standards and regulation: You have comprehensive knowledge of the key LCA / EPD standards and program operator requirements (i.e ISO 14040/14044 and EN 15804+A2). You interpret these standards rigorously, and evaluate sources critically.

  • From methodology to software: You have experience working with automated software solutions for LCA/EPD generation, with proven ability to translate regulatory and methodological logic into technical requirements. You bring a product mindset: you prioritise, scope and communicate requirements clearly.

  • Verification and customer experience: You have created multiple EPDs that were successfully verified and published with a European program operator (e.g. EPD Global, EPD International, IBU). You have worked directly with customers, ideally in a consulting environment, and can represent methodological positions confidently towards customers and verifiers.

  • Leadership and project management: You have a track record of leading large projects end-to-end: scoping, planning, delegating, coaching others and keeping quality high. You manage several projects at the same time and coordinate multiple internal and external stakeholders.

  • Language: Business fluent in English (C1+).

Nice to have’s

  • Education: Bachelors, Masters Degree or PhD in a relevant subject, i.e Sustainable Energy Systems, Architecture, Urban Planning, Engineering (Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical) etc.

  • Languages: Proficiency in German, or any other of the following European languages (French, Italian, Dutch, a Nordic language).

  • Verifier: Qualification as a verifier for EPDs acc. to EN 15804+A2

  • Engineering partnership: Experience completing partnering with software engineers to develop implementation strategies.

  • AI-enabled way of working: You are experienced in leveraging AI tools to accelerate your work, e.g. for research, requirements and documentation.

  • Tool Verifications: You have experience with EPD tool verifications.

  • Industry: Experience working on Construction products, or familiarity with the latest regulatory developments affecting the construction industry (e.g. EU Taxonomy, national and regional regulations) and can assess their impact on methodology and product.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Applied AI team at Nebius Token Factory, you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals, quantization and model compression, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, inference engines, serving architecture, and benchmarking to improve latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while preserving quality and reliability.

You will work with kernel and platform engineers to investigate serving problems, compare configurations, and resolve performance and quality regressions. You will evaluate model- and engine-level optimizations together with distributed inference designs, including request routing, scheduling, prefill/decode coordination, and multi-node GPU execution. Your improvements will be validated through reproducible benchmarks and safe production rollouts under real-world workloads.

Your responsibilities

  • Own optimization projects for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends.
  • Compare inference engines and recommend serving configurations suited to individual workloads.
  • Diagnose model-quality and performance regressions during production rollouts.
  • Improve LLM and VLM endpoint latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.
  • Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, and NVIDIA Dynamo.
  • Develop production model-compression workflows covering quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.
  • Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving. For prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD), evaluate KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and capacity balancing to determine which workloads benefit from the architecture.
  • Design and improve LLM request routers and scheduling policies that balance worker utilization, queueing, request characteristics, and KV-cache locality while meeting latency and reliability targets.
  • Scale dense and mixture-of-experts inference across multiple GPU nodes. Select and tune tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism—including wide expert parallelism (WideEP)—with attention to hardware topology, expert load balance, and communication overhead.
  • Build reproducible benchmark harnesses measuring TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token. Validate architecture choices under representative traffic and consistent GPU budgets.
  • Collaborate with GPU kernel and platform engineers to trace bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.
  • Produce design documents, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Must-haves

  • Strong engineering skills in Python and PyTorch.
  • Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference.
  • Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack, such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or an equivalent internal system.
  • A strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks involving KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.
  • Ability to quantify trade-offs among latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost.
  • Experience designing or optimizing distributed inference system architecture, with hands-on work in one or more areas such as request routing, distributed scheduling, PDD, multi-node inference, or expert parallelism.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, or SmoothQuant.
  • Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or related inference acceleration methods.

title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

What you’ll do

  • Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalization and consolidation opportunities.
  • Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

You are...

  • An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.
  • Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.
  • A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.
  • Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.
  • Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.

You have...

  • 5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.
  • Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.
  • Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.
  • Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.
  • Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.

Nice to have...

  • Familiarity with sustainability certification schemes and their cost implications.
  • Experience with commodity price risk or hedging frameworks.

title: Senior Product Manager (E-Commerce)
descriptionHtml:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business.   • Use AI in your daily work and find opportunities to apply it in the buyer experience.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, including work with enterprise customers.

  • A track record of leading a product area end to end, from discovery to delivery, in a scale-up and measurably improving its business results.

  • Sharp product sense and prioritization: you can dive deep into detail while keeping the bigger picture in view.

  • Strong ownership and flexibility: you thrive in a fast-changing environment, are comfortable with ambiguity, and take full responsibility for results.

What you get

descriptionHtml:

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity? 

Self-serve is where the majority of our customers start their journey, and the Growth team owns that journey end to end. This role owns the self-serve existing business: once a customer converts to paid, the account is yours - through every stage of its lifecycle, as it adopts more of the platform, grows its usage, and deepens its reliance on Fin.

Your mandate is to grow the value of the self-serve base: drive expansion, strengthen retention, and accelerate adoption of Fin and our newest products across thousands of paying customers. You'll own a book of business, a roadmap, and a cross-functional motion that spans product, lifecycle, data, and go-to-market. It's a rare Growth remit with a clear number to move and a lot of room to build the motions that move it.

What will I be doing? 

  • Own the self-serve existing business book. Own the remit end to end - from the moment a customer converts to the point they renew, expand, or leave - and be accountable for the net growth of that book.
  • Grow Fin adoption. Get more customers using our AI Agent across the existing base, and help the customers who already use it automate more of their support.

  • Connect self-serve and sales. Design smooth, well-defined handovers between self-serve and sales in both directions, so the right customers get the right motion.

There is no minimum years of experience, and no need to have held the PM title.   • Strong data fluency. You're comfortable working with funnels, cohorts, and customer signals to find opportunity, size it, and measure impact - and you make decisions from evidence, not instinct.
  • Compelling roadmaps. You build and communicate a roadmap that makes the what, when, and why obvious to everyone who needs to align behind it.
  • Excellent product judgment. You balance customer needs, business impact, and technical constraints, and you know what to ship now versus later.
  • Cross-functional leadership. You drive outcomes across product, design, engineering, data, lifecycle marketing, CS, and sales - influencing teams you don't own.
  • AI fluency. You understand how LLMs and AI agents work well enough to assess feasibility, make informed product decisions, and use AI to accelerate your own work.

Bring people with you

  • Communicate the what, the why and the how clearly, through crisp, data-led documents and conversations

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a product manager, with a track record of shipping products that moved meaningful business metrics, not just delivering features

  • Comfortable with both qualitative and quantitative evidence: you run user research and also query data, design experiments and interpret results yourself

  • A clear, confident communicator who can work with engineers and analysts day to day and with senior leaders across the business

Benefits

title: Senior Product Manager - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission.

As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role


At Yubo, Product Managers have real ownership. They work in strong partnership with Product Designers and Engineering, shaping strategy and decisions from problem definition all the way to delivery, with direct and visible impact on both the product and the business.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people.

We're moving away from small, isolated feature launches toward bigger, end-to-end experiences tested at scale. You'll combine user understanding, data and strong product convictions to frame problems, shape solutions with Design and Engineering, and decide what to scale, iterate, or stop.

You'll also work closely with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing and Trust & Safety on challenges ranging from recommendation and discovery to retention, safety, monetization and AI.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and who wants their decisions to have a visible impact on both user experience and business outcomes.

To make this dream duo work, we’re basing this role in Paris and looking for someone willing to come to the office once or twice a week.

Your responsibilities

  • Own a strategic product area from problem definition through delivery and post-launch iteration

  • Define product strategy and translate company objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes

  • Partner closely with Product Design and Engineering to shape end-to-end experiences rather than isolated features

  • Use data, research, user feedback, market insights, and product intuition to identify the problems worth solving

  • Turn opportunities into bold product bets, measure their impact, and decide whether to scale, iterate, or stop

  • Collaborate with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Legal to make informed product decisions

  • Balance user value, business impact, safety, and technical constraints when making trade-offs

  • Create alignment across stakeholders through clear problem framing, strong product conviction, and structured decision-making

Tools we use

  • Amplitude, SQL, Looker

  • Figma

  • Notion

  • Slack

  • Enterpret

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, Dust

Who you are

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally within consumer mobile products and a startup or scale-up environment

  • You are comfortable owning a product area from problem definition through launch and iteration

  • You combine strong product intuition with analytical rigor

  • You know how to use data, research, user feedback, and experimentation to guide decisions

  • You start with the user problem rather than jumping straight to a feature or solution

  • You have the conviction to form a strong product point of view, make bold calls, and defend them

  • You enjoy working closely with Design and Engineering and leading through influence rather than hierarchy

  • You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and changing direction when the evidence tells you to

  • You know how to balance user experience with growth, engagement, monetization, safety, and long-term product health

  • Experience with social, community, social discovery, gaming, recommendation, or consumer subscription products is a plus

Within a month, you will

  • Get familiar with Yubo's product, users, business model, and product principles

  • Build relationships with your Product Designer and key stakeholders across Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, and Trust & Safety

  • Understand current product priorities, ongoing experiments, major user journeys, and the metrics behind them

  • Start contributing to discovery and product discussions

Within 3 months, you will

  • Take ownership of a defined product area and its key user and business problems

  • Establish a trusted way of working with your Product Designer and Engineering counterparts

  • Lead your first discovery work and turn your findings into clear product opportunities

  • Launch and analyze your first experiments, using their results to inform your next decisions

Within 6 months, you will

  • Own the strategy and key initiatives for your product area end to end

  • Lead ambitious product bets that rethink meaningful parts of the user experience rather than isolated features

  • Drive measurable progress on outcomes such as retention, engagement, recommendation quality, monetization, or trust

  • Use data, user insight, and experimentation to decide what to scale, iterate, stop, or explore next

  • Raise the bar on product thinking, experimentation, and decision-making across Yubo

The recruitment process

  • Phone screen with Anita, Talent Acquisition

  • First interview with Sacha, our CEO

  • Product case study and debrief with Product Managers

  • Cultural fit assessments

  • And if everything went well, an offer!

What we offer

  • A highly competitive salary range as well as equity in the company

  • A hybrid work policy with up to two days of on-site presence per week at an amazing office and monthly team events to enjoy.

  • We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

Team Activities: participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities

Family-Friendly: we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies

Wellness Programs: benefit from comprehensive health insurance, wellness programs, sports classes, and mental well-being initiatives

title: Senior Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
About us

INCO is a leading social enterprise on a mission to shape a more inclusive and sustainable economy that creates opportunities for all. We have teams and programs in over 50 countries. Our work spans five complementary activities:

  1. INCO Academy: skilling programs for people facing barriers to employment, leading to careers in fast-growing industries such as technology, sustainability and healthcare (400,000+ job seekers trained to date).

  2. INCO Kids: education and awareness programs giving school-age learners future-proof knowledge in technology, sustainability, citizenship and more (350,000+ learners supported to date).

  3. INCO Entrepreneurs: incubation and acceleration for underrepresented founders and social entrepreneurs (2,000+ businesses supported every year).

  4. INCO Ventures: impact investing and funding for social and environmental impact startups (€500M+ assets under management).

  5. INCO Spaces: co-working and co-living spaces for social and environmental innovators (Paris, Berlin, Warsaw and more).

About the program:

AI and the Future of Work is a new three-year research and policy-engagement program (2026–2029), funded through a research grant partnership and led end to end by INCO. It tracks AI's real-world impact on jobs, tasks and productivity across all 27 EU member states, and gives policymakers the evidence, trend baselines and scenario-planning tools to capture AI's productivity upside while managing the workforce transition.

About the role:

We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the AI and the Future of Work program day to day and make sure it delivers on time, on budget and to the grant's commitments. You will closely lead and collaborate with a Research Lead and a Policy Lead.

You will turn a three-year grant into a working operation: a deliverables calendar across 27 countries, a consortium of up to 15 partners, a publication schedule and a reporting cycle the funder can trust. You need to be comfortable working alongside researchers and policy specialists, and fluent in the rhythm of grant-funded research programs.

Responsibilities:

Lead program delivery end to end

Planning and implementation

  • Build and own the three-year implementation plan: workstreams, milestones, dependencies and the deliverables calendar agreed with the funder.

  • Run the program's operating rhythm: weekly core-team check-ins, monthly consortium updates and quarterly steering reviews.

  • Coordinate the publication pipeline with the Research and Policy Leads: quarterly data refreshes, five semi-annual reports, policy briefs, the annual flagship and the 2029 EU27 report.

  • Keep thorough program documentation: plans, decision logs, risk register and handover notes.

  • Set up quality-assurance steps for outputs (review cycles, sign-off, editorial and brand checks) together with the Communications team.

  • Run the semi-annual tracking cycle and the reporting calendar for the five P0 markets and five sub-regional clusters, so national and EU27 outputs land together.

Monitoring and evaluation

  • Define and track program KPIs and grant deliverables; spot slippage early and agree corrective action with the leads.

  • Collect and compile performance data across workstreams and partners, and report it to your manager and the funder in a structured, actionable way.

  • Coordinate the program's evaluation framework so the team can show what the evidence changed in policy and practice.

Budget and resources

  • Own the program budget and cost sheet, including consortium partner budgets and the research consolidation budget held by the Research Lead.

  • Manage timelines and scope so the program delivers within the grant's budget and rules; prepare budget forecasts and reallocation requests.

  • Ensure grant compliance: eligible costs, audit trail, data protection (GDPR) and the funder's reporting requirements, working with Finance and Legal.

Manage the consortium and partners

  • Run the operational side of partner onboarding with the Research Lead: due diligence, contracts, scopes of work, payment schedules and data-sharing agreements.

  • Track the delivery of 8 to 15 national partners against their contracts, and manage underperformance or replacement when needed.

  • Organise consortium working groups, review cycles and annual convenings, and keep communication flowing across countries and time zones.

  • Run the secretariat for the sub-recipient advisory committee (INCO staff, funder representatives and independent experts): schedule meetings, prepare selection materials, record recommendations and keep the process transparent, with final selection resting with INCO.

  • Manage subrecipient compliance: flow-down of grant terms, financial and narrative reporting from partners, and checks before each payment.

Manage the funder and stakeholders

  • Act as the primary operational liaison with the grant funder, keeping expectations aligned and surfacing risks early.

  • Prepare and present progress, financial and impact reports to the funder and other key stakeholders.

  • Work with the Head of Partnerships on funder conversations, renewals and any extension of the partnership.

  • Support the Policy Lead and with the logistics of policymaker convenings, events and launches.

  • Coordinate, with the Policy Lead, the expanded public-engagement activity in Poland and the CEE region, and the logistics of rapid, fact-based responses when AI labour market stories break.

Coordinate the team

  • Set clear responsibilities, timelines and objectives across the core team, and track progress against them.

  • Act as the connecting point between the Research Lead, the Policy Lead, data engineers and INCO's support teams (Communications, Finance, Legal, HR).

  • Identify staffing needs as the program grows (for example research assistants, data roles or a program officer), write job descriptions, interview and onboard new team members, and manage any program staff assigned to you.

Support growth

  • Work with leadership to standardise how INCO runs grant-funded research programs, so lessons from this one carry over.

  • Identify follow-on funding and adjacent opportunities, for example linking findings to INCO Academy skilling programs.

  • Build relationships across the European research and policy ecosystem.


Essential

  • At least five years managing complex, multi-partner programs, ideally grant-funded research, policy or public-interest programs in Europe.

  • Proven track record managing funders or institutional partners, including donor reporting, budgets and grant compliance.

  • Experience coordinating consortia or networks of external partners, including contracts, scopes of work and partner payments.

  • At least four years leading teams and working cross-functionally, including with senior experts you do not line manage.

  • Strong budget and financial management skills, with ownership of program cost sheets and forecasts.

  • High digital collaboration literacy (Slack, Monday.com, Notion, G-Suite or similar) and comfort running remote work across many countries.

  • Professional English, written and spoken.

  • Strong attention to detail and organisational skills, with excellent communication, versatility and integrity.

Desirable

  • Experience with EU-funded or foundation-funded research programs (for example Horizon Europe, Erasmus+ or major philanthropic grants).

  • Familiarity with research operations: publication cycles, data protection (GDPR), research ethics and data-sharing agreements.

  • Interest in AI, the labour market, skills or the future of work; familiarity with EU institutions such as Cedefop, Eurostat, Eurofound or the JRC.

  • A second EU language, especially German, French, Spanish, Italian or Polish.

  • A recognised project management certification (for example PMP or PRINCE2).

  • Experience managing sub-grants or sub-recipients, including selection processes and flow-down compliance.

title: Senior Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Bouw jij vandaag al aan het talent dat Athora morgen nodig heeft? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Recruitment bij Athora gaat verder dan het invullen van vacatures en interim opdrachten. We willen vooruitkijken: welke kennis, expertise en talenten hebben we nu en in de toekomst nodig en hoe zorgen we dat we deze tijdig aan ons binden? Wij helpen managers hun future fit teams bouwen.

Als Senior Recruiter combineer je strategisch recruitmentadvies met sterke operationele executie. Je bent gesprekspartner voor management en HR Business Partners, kent de arbeidsmarkt en brengt een eigen visie mee. Tegelijkertijd sta je midden in de dagelijkse recruitmentdynamiek. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen managers, HR Business Partners en kandidaten en zorgt ervoor dat ieder recruitmentproces soepel, zorgvuldig en persoonlijk verloopt.

Je hebt een sleutelrol in het aantrekken van het talent dat Athora nodig heeft om haar ambities voor vandaag én morgen te realiseren. Je verdiept je in wat er binnen de organisatie speelt, begrijpt de uitdagingen van verschillende bedrijfsonderdelen en vertaalt deze ontwikkelingen naar recruitmentoplossingen.

Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Je bent regisseur van het recruitmentproces. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen kandidaten, hiring managers en HR Business Partners en zorgt voor een professioneel én persoonlijk proces, van intake en werving tot selectie, aanbieding en onboarding. Je houdt tempo, stuurt actief op voortgang en zorgt dat afspraken en contacten zorgvuldig worden vastgelegd.

  • Je ondersteunt bij externe inhuur. Je adviseert managers over passende inzet, onderhandelt over tarief, duur en andere voorwaarden en draagt zorg voor een zorgvuldig proces en goede vastlegging.

  • Je brengt Recruitment verder als strategische gesprekspartner. Je vertaalt ontwikkelingen in de organisatie en op de arbeidsmarkt naar een heldere recruitmentaanpak en adviseert managers en HR Business Partners proactief over de personeelsbehoefte van vandaag én morgen.

  • Je maakt data leidend in recruitmentadvies en besluitvorming. Je ontwikkelt samen met het team onze visie op AI binnen Recruitment. Je onderzoekt waar AI het recruitmentproces slimmer en effectiever kan maken en helpt bepalen waar technologie waarde toevoegt én waar persoonlijk contact het verschil moet blijven maken.

  • Je benut recruitment- en arbeidsmarktdata om trends, knelpunten en kansen zichtbaar te maken, vertaalt deze naar impactvolle inzichten en gebruikt de data om gericht te adviseren en bij te sturen op onder andere instroom, doorlooptijd, kwaliteit en inzet van recruitmentkanalen.

  • Je bouwt mee aan de verdere professionalisering van Recruitment. Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze recruitmentstrategie, employer branding en kandidaat propositie. Je vertaalt nieuwe ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in werkwijze, processen en dienstverlening.


Wat vragen we van jou?

Je bent een stevige en verbindende recruitmentprofessional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie en uitvoering. Je bent nieuwsgierig en resultaatgericht. Je bent een gelijkwaardige gesprekspartner voor (senior) management en HR, je durft vanuit je expertise te adviseren en te challengen. Je stelt de juiste vragen en neemt een vacatureaanvraag niet automatisch voor gegeven aan. Je wil eerst begrijpen: wat is hier werkelijk nodig? Je weet mensen mee te krijgen in je aanpak. Tegelijkertijd houd je oog voor wat er in de dagelijkse recruitmentpraktijk nodig is en zorg je ervoor dat afspraken en processen zorgvuldig worden opgevolgd.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je hbo+/wo werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 7 jaar relevante ervaring in corporate recruitment;

  • werk je graag met data en AI en vertaalt inzichten naar concrete adviezen en acties;

  • werk je gestructureerd en accuraat en weet je hoe belangrijk goede vastlegging is voor een professioneel recruitmentproces en goede samenwerking binnen het team;

  • kun je overzicht houden over meerdere processen tegelijkertijd zonder de persoonlijke aandacht voor kandidaten en managers te verliezen;

  • heb je ervaring binnen financial services of een andere kennisintensieve en gereguleerde omgeving een pré;

  • beheers je zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.

Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

Salaris per maand:
Op basis van cao schaal 15 HAY (incl. CAO verhoging per 1 Januari 2027) is de range € 4.435,55 tot € 5.913,69 op basis van 36 uur.

Enthousiast?

Reageer dan snel via de sollicitatie button!

title: Senior Revenue Ops
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

Learn more about the exciting challenges tackled by the team by reading this article about Carlos Targhetta's role at Alan 👀

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness, several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did.

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Madrid, Barcelona or Brussels.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Madrid, Barcelona or Brussels

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Senior Sales Engineer - Public Sector (UK)
descriptionHtml:
As an Enterprise Sales Engineer, you will provide technical expertise through sales presentations, product demonstrations, and supporting technical evaluations (POVs). Sales Engineers help qualify and close opportunities with customers and partners and have a voice with the product team to help prioritize features based on input from customers, competitors, and partners.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with the Sales team to articulate the overall Datadog value proposition, vision and strategy to customers
  • Own technical engagement with customers during the trial phase. Communicate Datadog’s value based on activities and work with customers on any identified issues or concerns to successful conclusion
  • Technically close complex opportunities through advanced competitive knowledge, technical skill, and credibility
  • Deliver product and technical briefings / presentations to potential clients
  • Maintain accurate notes and feedback in CRM regarding customer input both wins and losses
  • Proactively engage and communicate with customers and Datadog business/technical teams regarding product feedback and competitive landscape

Who You Are:

  • Passionate about educating customers on observability risks that are meaningful to their business, and able to build and execute an evaluation plan with a customer
  • Someone with strong written and oral communication skills. This role requires an ability to understand and articulate both the business benefits (value proposition) and technical advantages of our offering
  • Experienced in programming/scripting with any of the following: Java, Python, Ruby, Go, Node.JS, PHP, and .NET etc.
  • Someone with a minimum of 3+ years in a Sales Engineering or DevOps Engineering role
  • Able to sit up to 4 hours, traveling to and from client sites 
  • Able to travel via auto, train or air up to 45% of the time

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth: 

  • Best-in-breed onboarding
  • Generous global benefits
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

About Datadog: 

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

Equal Opportunity at Datadog:

Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference.

If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please complete this form. This form is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. 

Privacy and AI Guidelines:

Any information you submit to Datadog as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Datadog’s Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice. For information on our AI policy, please visit Interviewing at Datadog AI Guidelines.

title: Senior Scientist, Cheminformatics
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As a Scientist in Cheminformatics, you will own the chemical data and analyses behind our small-molecule models: what they learn from, how we test them, and how well they work on real hit-finding and hit-optimization programs. We're building our next small-molecule design model, and its results depend on getting the chemistry in the data right.

You will work closely with the Small Molecules team's ML research scientists and medicinal chemistry experts, and with our pharma and biotech partners on pilots and customer projects.

This role is ideal for a cheminformatician who builds their own tools, enjoys open-ended scientific questions, and wants their analyses to change both what we build and real discovery decisions.

What you'll do

  • Build and curate training and evaluation datasets from structures, protein–ligand complexes, binding and screening data, with careful standardization and leakage checks.

  • Design benchmarks for hit identification and hit optimization across a wide range of target classes, and help show where our models succeed and fail.

  • Analyze large chemical libraries and model-generated compounds: clustering, scaffold and diversity analysis, filtering and prioritization.

  • Support partner pilots and customer projects: prepare and analyze partner data, run our models on their programs and interpret the results with them.

  • Build reusable cheminformatics tooling in clean Python, and feed what you find back into model development.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • MSc, PhD or equivalent experience in cheminformatics, computational chemistry or a closely related field. We're hiring at Junior to Senior level.

  • Strong Python and RDKit (or similar): fingerprints, similarity search, clustering, scaffold analysis and chemical-space visualization.

  • Solid understanding of small-molecule chemistry (series, stereochemistry, protonation and tautomers) and of binding and screening data (KD, Ki, IC50, EC50), including assay context and when measurements are comparable.

  • Evidence of datasets, tools or analyses that others used to make decisions.

  • Clear communication with ML researchers, chemists and external partners.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience on real discovery programs: virtual screening, hit discovery, hit-to-lead or lead optimization.

  • Experience with molecular ML (affinity or property prediction, generative design), or with protein–ligand structural data.

  • Experience using Boltz models, or open-source scientific software contributions.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

What we offer

  • Shape the data and benchmarks behind small-molecule models used by leading discovery teams.

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

  • Benefits:

    • 25 days plus bank holidays a year

    • Annual team offsite trip

    • Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions

    • Pension program

    • Paid parental leave

    • Wellhub gym membership

    • Free lunch every day

    • Travel expenses

How we hire

  1. Initial screen with a member of the Talent team

  2. Technical interview

  3. Onsite in London with the team

  4. Offer + Onboarding

Our commitment

Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us and we'll make it work.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Data Platform)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join the team building and operating Nebius Data Platform — a distributed storage and a processing platform that acts as the company’s “source of truth” and the backbone of many internal (and some external) products.
Nebius Data Platform is a single multi-tenant ecosystem based on YTsaurus — instead of running separate HDFS/Kafka/HBase-style systems, we provide storage, compute, and analytics capabilities inside one platform.

We operate across data centers worldwide, running YTsaurus in dedicated Kubernetes clusters with Kubernetes operators and supporting services written primarily in Go. We maintain our own Nebius distribution, develop functionality across the core and platform services, and contribute upstream where it makes sense. This gives us the ability to take improvements from design through implementation to production.

At scale today, this includes ~500 servers, ~20k CPU cores and ~10 PB of compressed data in our largest production cluster, supporting workloads ranging from business-critical pipelines and financial transactions to large-scale ML/LLM training datasets and compute.
As an SRE, you’ll combine software engineering with production ownership: understand how the platform behaves, identify what limits its reliability and growth, and build lasting improvements alongside the developers and teams who use it.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own and improve the reliability, performance, and capacity of our YTsaurus clusters, with particular attention to data durability and predictable behavior under load.

  • Develop services, Kubernetes automation, and operational tooling in Go to simplify cluster provisioning, upgrades, and maintenance.

  • Improve monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic tools so we can detect problems early and understand their impact on users.

  • Investigate failures across Linux, networking, Kubernetes, and distributed storage and compute. Participate in on-call, lead incident investigations, and turn findings into lasting fixes.

  • Improve resource utilization and workload isolation as the platform grows and serves more teams.

  • Work with platform developers and users to make architectural decisions, deliver changes safely, and reduce repetitive operational work.

We expect you to have:

  • Experience operating distributed, stateful systems in production and taking responsibility for their reliability.

  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including the ability to investigate resource bottlenecks and failures beyond the application layer.

  • Practical Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads.

  • Strong programming skills and experience building maintainable software. We primarily use Go; experience in another language and a willingness to learn Go are welcome.

  • A systematic approach to troubleshooting, using evidence from logs, metrics, traces, and system behavior.

  • The ability to drive improvements from problem identification through delivery, communicate trade-offs clearly, and collaborate with developers and platform users.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with Big Data systems (YTsaurus/Hadoop/Spark/ClickHouse/Kafka-like ecosystems).

  • Experience developing Kubernetes operators or controllers.

  • Experience with performance analysis, capacity planning, or resource management in multi-tenant systems.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Senior Software Engineer (Autonomy)

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

The Senior Software Engineer (Autonomy) will design, build, and operate software capabilities that improve the mission effectiveness and safety of uncrewed surface vehicles across the UFORCE C2/C4ISR stack.

This role spans Perception Autonomy, Autonomy Behaviours—including collision avoidance (COLAV), target-based manoeuvring and engagement—and Swarm Intelligence. You will take cross-system initiatives from design and implementation through scenario-based verification, field trials, deployment, and iteration.

The role requires strong software engineering and mathematical foundations, with an emphasis on autonomy that remains safe, observable, and useful in real operating conditions—including degraded sensors, different sea states, and GNSS- or RF-challenged environments.

Nice to have

title: Senior Software Engineer, Customs
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Why Customs Matters More Than Ever

International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis—sparked by Trump-era tariffs—has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.

That’s where we come in. The Customs Technology team at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.

The opportunity: 

Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.

Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. Being a tech company, we can move much faster than our competitors, and give our customers the service they expect in this day and age. We can deploy things like LLM agents at scale, in an industry that is ripe to be disrupted by this technology.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Inference Performance
descriptionHtml:
About Tensordyne

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

The role

You'll build the software stack that takes a model from code down to the hardware: the abstractions, kernels, libraries, and tools that engineers and agents use to reach peak performance. Help optimize the latest AI models on our silicon.

Our hardware is designed to be straightforward to program, so the goal is not to hide it. The goal is to expose the right level of control at each layer, from our compiler-driven Python SDK to our low-level Rust programming stack, and to make every performance gap measurable and every fix permanent.

We're looking for a builder who understands hardware deeply and develops with agents by default. You'll own substantial parts of one of these layers and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your focus is performance: where cycles, bandwidth, and communication go, and how to win them back. Number formats and model accuracy are owned by our conversion and emulation team; you'll partner with them where precision and speed meet.

What you'll do

  • Build the stack. Design APIs, kernel abstractions, and libraries in our Python SDK or Rust stack so model engineers and agents can reach high performance at the layer that fits their problem.
  • Make models fast. Take priority workloads, from LLMs to multimodal models, to peak performance on real silicon. Profile, find the bottleneck across kernels, compiler, runtime, and parallelism, and fix it at the right layer.
  • Close the gap between model and measurement. Compare measured performance against analytical models and simulation. Explain every material gap, and turn the explanation into a fix or a better model.
  • Build the agentic performance loop. Give agents the profilers, traces, counters, and benchmark harnesses to form a hypothesis, change code, and measure the result in minutes. Make the results trustworthy enough to act on.
  • Set the bar for performance. Define how we measure, track regressions, and report results.
  • Build for the next chip. Design abstractions that carry forward to future hardware generations. Work with hardware architects to test how architectural choices affect real workloads.

What we need from you

  • You understand hardware performance. You've optimized AI workloads on GPUs or custom accelerators and can reason about compute utilization, memory hierarchy, latency hiding, synchronization, and multi-chip scaling.
  • You build excellent software. You've owned substantial systems from design through production. You're strong in Python and/or at least one systems language such as Rust, C++, or C, and rigorous about interfaces, abstractions, and testing. We care about engineering quality more than a specific language.
  • You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model's implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention variants, KV caches, MoE, and parallelism, and how they map to compute, memory, and communication.
  • You build with agents. Agentic development is how you work, not an experiment. You'd rather build the loop that finds the optimization than find it by hand, and you know when the loop still needs a human.
  • You build things others succeed with. You've designed APIs, libraries, or performance tooling that other engineers adopted.
  • You drive problems to resolution. You form clear hypotheses, measure, and follow the evidence across software and hardware boundaries. You take ownership of the result.

If you hit a few of those boxes, we'd like to speak to you.

We'd be thrilled if you had

  • Experience with embedded, bare-metal, or low-level runtime programming.
  • Experience with MLIR, other compiler frameworks, or kernel DSLs such as Triton, Pallas, NKI, or CuTe.
  • Contributions to LLM serving stacks such as vLLM or SGLang, or a track record of taking end-to-end inference workloads to competitive performance on a hardware target.

Why join us

Your code will decide how fast models run on our hardware, and how easy it is for the next engineer, or the next agent, to make them faster. You'll own a layer of a new programming model, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon and carried into the next generation.

Tensordyne Values

  • Think big. Pursue ambitious technical and business goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality matters in everything we build and deliver.
  • Own it and get it done. Take responsibility and drive results.
  • Operate with integrity. Be direct, transparent, and respectful.
  • Win as a team. Make the people around you more effective.
  • Value different perspectives. The strongest teams challenge assumptions and bring diverse experience to difficult problems.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions.
