title: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning
descriptionHtml:
Senior Software Engineer | Autoplanner | Hybrid Working | London

Introduction: 

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology. 

About the Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Autoplanner team, you will own the software engineering that brings our data science and machine learning products into live production. Autoplanner builds AI-powered systems that unify planning across global warehouses and last-mile assets, delivering globally optimized plans that maximize profit and minimize lateness. You will act as the engineering partner to our data scientists, ensuring our systems remain robust, highly scalable, and efficient as we roll out to more international retail partners. Our services are mostly Python, but we use Java where a service integrates closely with the Ocado Smart Platform, to take advantage of its shared tooling.

In this role, you will write typed, well-tested Python and oversee cloud-based data applications from end to end. You will contribute to core architectural decisions, improve CI/CD pipelines, and raise engineering standards across the team through pairing, code reviews, and shared tooling. Additionally, you will harness AI coding tools in production while maintaining a strong emphasis on engineering discipline, system performance, and high-quality software craft.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain data- and ML-driven, cloud-based applications.
  • Build and maintain robust APIs and data contracts for data science teams and broader Ocado systems.
  • Manage cloud deployments and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines across diverse AWS environments.
  • Package, version, serve, and monitor machine learning models in live production environments.
  • Drive architecture decisions across repository, application, and system levels, documenting them as Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
  • Partner directly with data scientists to transition advanced algorithms and models into scalable production systems.
  • Collaborate with software engineers across Ocado Technology to integrate applications within the Ocado Smart Platform (OSP).
  • Elevate engineering practices across the team through pairing, code reviews, shared tooling, and responsible AI agent integration.
  • Share in on-call and production support responsibilities for critical live operational services.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Proven experience as a Senior Software Engineer owning end-to-end production Python services.
  • Extensive background building data-intensive cloud applications, preferably asynchronous, event-driven, or queue-based architectures.
  • Strong practical knowledge of AWS and/or GCP identity, networking, and messaging services.
  • Solid software design capabilities, including defining system boundaries and crafting high-level architectures.
  • Rigorous testing and delivery discipline, encompassing integration testing and modern CI/CD practices.
  • Hands-on MLOps experience, specifically in packaging, serving, and monitoring ML models in production.
  • Demonstrated track record of collaborating effectively with data scientists and cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Practical experience using AI coding agents on production codebases, with a sharp judgment on validating and verifying AI-generated output.

Benefits:

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:

  • Time to recharge: 25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.
  • Health & wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.
  • Family-first policies: 22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave.
  • Financial support: Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.
  • Commuter perks: Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.
  • Exclusive discounts: 15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).

Be bold, be unique, be brilliant, be you. We are looking for individuality and we value diversity. We are an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to treating all applicants and employees fairly and equally. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment process and supportive work environment. title: Senior AI-Native Software Engineer – TypeScript (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die Solarize Energy Solutions GmbH mit Büros in Berlin und Stuttgart revolutioniert die Energiewirtschaft mit innovativer Meter-to-Cash-Software. Wir ermöglichen es Energieunternehmen, innovative Produkte anzubieten, von denen sowohl die Kunden als auch die Energiewende profitieren.

Ursprünglich für Mieterstrom in Gewerbeimmobilien entwickelt, unterstützt Solarize heute über 200 Unternehmen als Abrechnungslösung für PPAs, Mieterstrom, Wärme bis hin zu komplexen zeitreihenbasierten Energieprodukten im Geschäftskundenbereich.

Das Solarize-Team besteht aus erfahrenen Gründern, Pionieren der Energiewende, Softwareexperten und hungrigen Macher:innen, die in einer offenen Kultur und im ständigen Austausch miteinander an den wichtigen Fragen der Energiewende arbeiten.

Wir sind ausdauernd, wissbegierig, veränderungswillig und unbequem. So verändern wir den Energiesektor hin zu einer kundenorientierten und innovativen Branche und leisten dadurch unseren Beitrag für die zentralen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit.

Für unser Engineering-Team (9 Engineers in zwei Full-Stack-Teams) suchen wir eine:n Senior AI-Native Software Engineer (m/w/d) in Voll- oder Teilzeit, der:die KI ganz selbstverständlich in den eigenen Entwicklungsalltag integriert, technische Verantwortung übernimmt, unsere Architektur aktiv mitgestaltet und durch Mentoring das gesamte Team weiterbringt.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission bei uns

Als Senior AI-Native Software Engineer (m/w/d) entwickelst du das technische Rückgrat für eine dezentrale Energiezukunft – und nutzt dafür KI als festen Teil deines Werkzeugkastens, nicht als Experiment.

So arbeiten wir mit KI: KI ist bei uns fester Teil des Entwicklungsprozesses – von der Planung bis zum Review. Wir automatisieren Schritt für Schritt mehr und iterieren gemeinsam als Team an unseren Workflows.

  • Gestalte die KI-Zukunft im Meter-to-Cash-Prozess: Du entwickelst KI-gestützte Features, die Abrechnung, Datenprüfung und Kundenprozesse unserer Kund:innen spürbar vereinfachen und messbaren Impact schaffen.

  • Übernimm volle Ownership – we build it, we run it: Du verantwortest deine Lösungen von der Architektur über das Release bis zum Betrieb inkl. Monitoring und Incidents – statt bloß Tickets abzuarbeiten.

  • Baue skalierbare Systeme: Du designst und betreibst performante Services für die Verarbeitung von mehreren Millionen Messwerten sowie die Skalierung unserer Abrechnungslogik.

  • Bring das Team weiter: Du gibst dein Wissen durch Mentoring, Reviews und Pairing weiter und hebst die technische Qualität im gesamten Team.

  • Agile Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Du bist die technische Schnittstelle zu Produktmanagement und Stakeholdern, übersetzt Anforderungen in sauberen Code und sorgst für Klarheit und Fokus in der Entwicklung.

Qualifikation

Wir glauben fest daran, dass die richtige Einstellung und Motivation oft wichtiger sind als ein lückenloser Lebenslauf. Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem.

Das bringst du mit (Must-haves):

  • AI-native Arbeitsweise: Du nutzt KI-Tools täglich und gezielt in deinem Entwicklungsalltag. Du verbesserst deine Workflows kontinuierlich, prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch und verantwortest Qualität, Sicherheit und Wartbarkeit des Codes – auch wenn ein Agent ihn geschrieben hat.

  • Erfahrung und Gestaltungswillen: Du hast bereits Software in Produktion verantwortet – von der Architektur bis zum Betrieb – und andere Engineers dabei mitgenommen. Ob du dafür drei oder zehn Jahre gebraucht hast, ist uns egal.

  • Tech Stack & APIs: Du bewegst dich sicher im TypeScript- und Node.js-Ökosystem, baust und testest APIs professionell und hast fundierte Kenntnisse in relationalen Datenbanken, insbesondere PostgreSQL. Im Frontend arbeitest du mit React – Full-Stack ist bei uns Alltag.

  • Cloud- & Infrastruktur-Know-how: Du hast Erfahrung im Deployment und Betrieb von Cloud-Infrastrukturen (z. B. Google Cloud) und bist sicher im Umgang mit Git, npm und Docker.

  • Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse: Unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Deutsch, im Engineering arbeiten wir auf Englisch. Du sprichst Deutsch mindestens auf B1-Niveau und Englisch fließend.

Pluspunkte sammelst du mit (Nice-to-haves):

  • KI-Features gebaut: Du hast bereits KI-Features oder Automatisierungen in Produktion gebracht.

  • Akademisches Fundament: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem wissenschaftlichen oder technischen Bereich (MINT).

  • Technisches Verständnis für Integrationen: Du hast bereits Erfahrung mit System-Integrationen gesammelt, idealerweise im Umfeld von ERP-Systemen (z. B. DATEV oder SAP).

  • Branchenwissen: Ein grundlegendes Verständnis für die Energie- oder Immobilienwirtschaft hilft dir, die Logik hinter unseren Daten noch schneller zu durchdringen.

Benefits

Wir wollen nicht nur, dass du bei uns arbeitest – wir wollen, dass du mit uns wächst. Dein Wachstum & deine Karriere:

  • Steile Lernkurve: In direkter Zusammenarbeit mit einem erfahrenen Team kannst du dich schnell und nachhaltig weiterentwickeln.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Bringe deine eigenen Ideen ein und baue mit uns die Strukturen für unseren zukünftigen Erfolg auf.

  • Weiterbildungsbudget: Wir investieren in dich mit einem jährlichen Budget für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung.

Deine Benefits & dein Wohlbefinden:

  • Flexibilität: Hybrid in Berlin – 2 Tage pro Woche im Büro, der Rest remote. Vollzeit oder Teilzeit – wie es zu deinem Leben passt.

  • Vereinbarkeit: Private Verpflichtungen brauchen bei uns keine Rechtfertigung – ob Kita-Schließtag, Arzttermin oder Ehrenamt.

  • Top-Benefits: Profitiere von attraktiven Zuschüssen zum Urban Sports Club, Job Bike und dem Deutschlandticket.

Unsere Kultur & unser Team:

  • Leidenschaft & Teamgeist: Wir sind ein passioniertes Team, das für seine Mission brennt und Erfolge gemeinsam feiert.

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents: Wir stärken unseren Zusammenhalt bei unseren Events in Berlin, Stuttgart und an anderen Orten.

Dein Weg zu uns:

  1. Erstgespräch: Motivation, Culture Fit und wie du heute mit KI arbeitest

  2. Technische Runde mit unserem Engineering-Team

  3. Angebot – Ziel: Entscheidung innerhalb von 4 Wochen

Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres Teams bei Solarize!

title: Senior Software Engineer, OS Integration
descriptionHtml:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support. 

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will be focused on Firefox on Windows, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments and especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do: 

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring: 

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows with C++ (will consider experience with C++ on macOS or Linux).
  • Strong knowledge of C, C++, and assembly language such as x64, x86, or arm64.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Enterprise DLP development or deployment
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Storage
descriptionHtml:
What You'll Do

As a Senior Software Engineer - Storage, you will design, build, and operate the storage services and data capabilities that run demanding cloud and AI workloads at scale on Radiant's platform.

You'll work across object, block, and file storage, data lifecycle, performance, resilience, APIs, and platform integrations. You'll partner closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, networking, and security teams, and with customers running the most demanding storage workloads.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll own significant parts of the storage platform from design through production, working alongside our Principal Engineers on its architecture.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and own components of Radiant's storage services, and contribute to the architecture and technical designs for the platform.

  • Build storage systems across object, block, and file, including control plane and data plane services and their integration with existing Radiant services.

  • Turn product and customer requirements into well-designed APIs and implementations, working with the Storage Product Manager and Principal Engineers.

  • Deliver against the performance, durability, availability, and consistency targets of the storage platform.

  • Profile, benchmark, and tune throughput, latency, and IOPS for AI training, inference, and other data-intensive workloads.

  • Build integrations between storage and compute, Kubernetes (CSI), networking, IAM, observability, and developer tooling.

  • Build for failure through replication, snapshots, data protection, failure recovery, and safe upgrades at scale.

  • Take part in on-call and operational work with SRE, including capacity planning, observability, incident response, and post-incident improvements.

  • Contribute to engineering standards through design and code review, and support less experienced engineers.

 

Your Profile

  • Solid experience building and operating distributed storage systems or storage-heavy cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience owning significant components end to end, from design through production and operation.

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in one or more systems languages such as Go or similar.

  • Strong technical knowledge across several of:

  • Storage: object, block, and file storage, snapshots, replication, erasure coding, caching, tiering, data lifecycle

  • Protocols & interfaces: S3, NFS, SMB, CSI, NVMe/NVMe-oF, RDMA, POSIX semantics, storage APIs

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, containers, high-performance networking, GPU clusters, cloud platforms

  • Reliability: durability, availability, consistency models, consensus, failure recovery, data integrity

  • Observability & security: metrics, logging, tracing, IAM, encryption at rest and in transit, auditability

  • Experience with technologies such as WEKA, VAST, DDN, Lustre, Ceph, MinIO, Pure Storage, or similar.

  • Familiarity with AI and HPC storage patterns, such as large-scale training data pipelines, checkpointing, and high-throughput parallel file systems.

  • Able to reason about trade-offs between performance, durability, availability, cost, and operational complexity.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including design documents and explaining trade-offs to your team and stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working with customers on technical problems.

 

What You Bring

  • Storage domain expertise: Understand how storage architecture affects application and workload performance, down to the hardware.

  • Engineering excellence: Write well-tested, maintainable code and give thoughtful code reviews.

  • Sound judgement: Make careful design decisions on systems where data loss is not an option.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Principal Engineers, product, SRE, and other teams, and help the engineers around you grow.

  • Systems thinking: Understand how storage interacts with compute, networking, and the rest of the cloud platform.

  • Ownership: Drive storage capabilities from design through production, operation, and continuous improvement.

 

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

 

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two Senior Engineers) → Final.


Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Test Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Wanna join the adventure?

At Loft Orbital, we have just successfully launched multiple satellites that we fly and operate ourselves. With these satellites in orbit and a wave of exciting missions launching soon, we are scaling up quickly as a global company.

We are looking for a Test Infrastructure Engineer to join the team building and maintaining Loft’s test infrastructure internationally across our Golden, CO and Toulouse, France sites.
About this role:
As a Test Infrastructure Engineer, you will primarily help design, develop, and deploy our test infrastructure and the tools for automating both our hardware and software testing, which will help us scale as a company.Sitting between the spacecraft and all the other teams, you will have a big impact in ensuring that every element of our satellite works without any bugs.We are looking for engineers with a product mindset, who have a good understanding of embedded systems, networking, data exchange protocols, and experience with setting up software infrastructures. Additionally, we are looking for someone who is:
  • Able to work independently with some guidance. People owning their work is important to us!
  • Able to wear multiple hats as needs arise. We are a small company disrupting an entire industry!
  • Not afraid to get out of their comfort zone to explore and learn. Technologies are evolving at rapid rates, and we must stay relevant!
    • Key responsibilities include:
    • Design, build, deploy, and maintain high-fidelity Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testbeds that emulate spacecraft systems, sensors, and communication links.
    • Design, build, deploy, and maintain Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) that interfaces with space vehicles under Assembly, Integration & Tests, allowing Validation and Verification of spacecrafts and their software before their launch campaigns.
    • Develop tools and frameworks that allow teams to simulate faults, edge cases, and mission scenarios that are difficult or costly to reproduce with physical hardware alone.
    • Work closely with systems, software, hardware, and operations teams to understand evolving test requirements and integrate feedback into the platforms.
    • Maintain and extend test infrastructure to support continuous integration (CI) pipelines, ensuring every code change is validated with realistic system-level tests.
    • Troubleshoot complex system issues spanning software, embedded hardware, networking, and system configuration.
      • Our culture at Loft Orbital promotes collaboration and ownership among our developers, fostering efforts hand in hand with other teams, internally and externally.

Must Haves:
  • 2+ years working with Linux systems, including configuration, debugging, and system-level troubleshooting.
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (OSI layers, packet analysis, data exchange protocols like TCP/IP and UDP).
  • Hands-on experience with embedded systems or low-level hardware (Raspberry Pi, Arduino, microcontrollers, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python (3.9+) for building test automation frameworks, device drivers, or test orchestration tools.
  • Experience containerizing applications with Docker.
  • Familiarity with at least one modern CI tool (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Buildkite, CircleCI) and integrating test pipelines.

Nice to Haves:
  • Experience designing or automating complex HIL/SIL testbed, signal conditioning, fault injection, or hardware emulation.
  • Experience with “Infrastructure-as-Code” systems, specifically NixOS.
  • Familiarity with networking simulation tools (e.g., network emulators, virtual switches) for testing data flows under realistic mission constraints.
  • Interest or experience with hardware test automation frameworks (e.g., custom Python-based test rigs).
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or a similar field.

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    • *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.
    Who We Are
    Loft: Space Made Simple.
    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.
    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.
    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

If you're driven by innovation, thrilled by the possibilities of what specialized compute can enable, and eager to be part of a team that's shaping the future, then CoreWeave is the place for you. Join us and let's embark on this adventure together!

  • Collaborate closely with customers to understand their unique business needs and create, prototype, and deploy tailored solutions that align with their requirements.

title: Senior Staff Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Video is 90% of the world's data. Most of it is invisible to machines.
TwelveLabs builds the intelligence layer to change that. Our multimodal AI models understand video the way humans do — across sight, sound, and motion — and power production-scale AI workloads across media, entertainment, sports, security, and government.


We have raised more than $210 million from NEA, Radical Ventures, Amazon, NVIDIA, Snowflake, Databricks, Index Ventures, NAVER Ventures, Korea Investment Partners, Quadrille Capital, Red Bull Ventures, and AI pioneers including Fei-Fei Li, Silvio Savarese, and Alexandr Wang.


We are a global company, headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Seoul, New York, and London, and employees around the world. We believe the differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences make our products stronger. Building technology that understands the world in all its complexity requires people who see it from every angle. We are looking for individuals who are driven by hard problems and want their work to matter. Come build it with us!

About the Role

TwelveLabs is at the forefront of video AI technology, transforming how businesses understand and utilize their video data by leveraging our multimodal video foundation model. Our go-to-market team is dedicated to driving the adoption of these powerful models by helping customers power use cases.

As an Account Executive - EMEA, you will have a pivotal role in our go-to-market strategy and revenue growth across EMEA. This role covers all industries that need video understanding, including Media & Entertainment, Defence, Public Sector, Automotive, Financial Services & Insurance (FSI) and others. The UK and EU have emerged as critical growth regions for TwelveLabs, with strong engagement from leading organizations including Sky, BBC, ITV, RedBull, Canal+, and Bertelsmann, and we are now building new commercial markets in the Middle East, Germany and France. This is a unique opportunity to shape not only the sales culture of our EMEA operations but also the way that foundation models get adopted by EMEA's leading organizations and the Media Asset Management (MAM) platforms that serve them.

You will work with leading organizations across a broad range of industries - from broadcasters, studios, sports leagues and streaming platforms, to defence and public sector agencies, automotive manufacturers, and financial services and insurance firms - to help drive innovation wherever video is critical to the business. You will own the end to end sales process, from building the first relationships with potential customers to deeply understanding their business needs and helping them succeed with TwelveLabs. Alongside direct sales, you

will lead partner business development with MAM vendors, embedding TwelveLabs into the media workflows customers already rely on.

We recommend this role to candidates who are excited about the opportunity to create a market category and thrive in an ambiguous environment. Ideally, you will have experience having built and executed go-to-market strategies as part of the early team in a software startup.

In this role you will

  • Manage the entire sales cycle to win new business and drive revenue. You will initiate the first relationships with customers, deeply understand their business needs, educate them on video foundation models, negotiate contracts, and help them succeed with TwelveLabs.

  • Own and develop key accounts in EMEA. Manage 2-3 of the largest priority accounts in the region while building pipeline across approximately 100 additional named accounts across Media & Entertainment, Defence, Public Sector, Automotive, FSI and other industries.

  • Drive EMEA partner business development. Build, sign and grow partnerships with Media Asset Management (MAM) vendors, integrating TwelveLabs into their platforms and co-selling into their customer base.

  • Build new commercial markets. Lead TwelveLabs' entry into new geographies, including the Middle East, Germany and France - identifying anchor customers and local partners, and establishing a repeatable go-to-market motion.

  • Navigate diverse EMEA markets. Adapt your sales approach to regional procurement protocols, compliance requirements, and buying behaviors unique to different European and Middle Eastern markets.

  • Develop and validate hypotheses on the right strategy. Work with the EMEA leadership team to bring cutting-edge multimodal video models to market across the UK, broader European region and the Middle East.

  • Build strategic partnerships. Collaborate closely with AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, and NVIDIA to leverage their relationships and accelerate deal velocity in your accounts.

  • Collaborate closely with our product team. Share customer and partner feedback and insights to inform our product roadmap and deliver enhanced experiences for EMEA customers.

  • Set and achieve ambitious sales targets. Provide regular progress reports to regional and company leadership on pipeline development, partner performance, deal progression, and market opportunities.

  • Represent TwelveLabs at industry events. Maintain strong presence at key EMEA industry trade shows and conferences to build brand awareness and generate pipeline.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 5+ years of enterprise software sales experience across one or more of Media & Entertainment, Defence, Public Sector, Automotive or FSI, with experience selling in the UK and/or broader EMEA markets.

title: Signal Processing Engineer (RF Processing & Analytics)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Signal Processing Engineer within RF Processing & Analytics, you own the algorithms that turn raw electromagnetic intercepts into an actionable picture of the RF environment — detecting, characterizing, and identifying the emitters around our platforms in contested environments. You work across the signals captured by our Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare modules, building the classification and analytics layer that turns isolated detections into a real-time electronic order of battle for operators and downstream autonomy.

Responsibilities

  • Signal Detection & Characterization: Build algorithms to detect, deinterleave, and extract parameters (PRI, pulse width, frequency, modulation) from intercepted RF emissions.

  • Emitter Classification & Identification: Develop classification pipelines — combining feature-based methods and machine learning — to identify emitter types and match them against threat libraries.

  • Electronic Order of Battle: Design the analytics that turn individual detections into a coherent, real-time picture of emitters, tracks, and threat posture.

  • AI-Assisted Analytics: Apply machine learning to modulation recognition, anomaly detection, and emitter fingerprinting where it improves classification confidence in dense, contested spectrum.

  • Cross-Module Data Fusion: Work with signals captured by Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare to build a unified processing pipeline rather than siloed, single-sensor analysis.

  • Real-Time Pipeline Engineering: Take algorithms from offline prototyping (MATLAB/Python) to real-time or near-real-time implementation, alongside software and embedded/FPGA engineers.

  • Field Validation: Validate detection and classification performance against simulated and real-world RF datasets, in lab and field-test conditions.

Candidate Requirements

  • Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.

  • 3-6 years of experience in RF/radar signal processing, ideally with exposure to ELINT, ESM, or SIGINT applications.

  • Strong fundamentals in DSP: spectral analysis, filtering, multi-rate processing, statistical/adaptive signal processing.

  • Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for algorithm prototyping; working knowledge of C/C++ for production-oriented implementation.

  • Comfortable applying machine learning to signal classification problems.

  • Clear communicator, able to work across RF hardware, software, and data science disciplines.

  • Fluency in English required; French is a plus.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Software Engineer - Simulation Platform

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent

YOUR IMPACT

  • Shape the future of Proxima’s simulation platform: we design and develop the platform; stellarator researchers and engineers use it to mature the design of Alpha and Stellaris; you will imagine and build with us novel solutions for simulation tools that spark joy and reduce time-to-insight

  • Accelerate Stellarator R&D, at the company at its forefront: we work side by side with researchers and engineers to ensure what we build immediately boosts the speed Proxima Fusion’s Stellarator design program

WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will join the Simulation Platform Team, a software platform team that balances development of core products with direct support to researchers, adapting to the Stellarator design program’s strategy and priorities. In your first six months you will e.g. add features to our in-house simulation pipeline automation system and ensure that AI agents can work with it efficiently.

  • On the platform engineering side you will design, develop and maintain next-generation software solutions for stellarator simulation and design, targeted to human and agentic use; for example:

    • Python libraries enabling automation of large-scale simulation workflows

    • cloud-based data storage that keeps everyone in sync

    • web applications that foster cross-domain collaboration and knowledge discovery

    • integration of AI tools where they actually provide leverage

  • You will also work together with our researchers to apply our tools to specific use cases, working as an internally-deployed Research Software Engineer: you will guide users to make the most of the available simulation tooling and proactively co-develop applications that unblock their R&D program, while gathering precious feedback and ideas for the next platform improvements

  • We are looking for a software practitioner with a user-first mindset, interested in tackling a diverse mix of challenges: from the optimization of scientific computing workflows to building cloud- and web-based systems for data management, sharing and exploration

  • Proficient in Python

  • You enjoy staying up to date with current software development best practices and tools, e.g. agentic development or modern data pipelines and scheduling solutions

  • You enjoy diving into new problems with a continuous learning attitude, absorbing relevant domain knowledge in a dynamic start-up environment; no fusion background needed, familiarity with scientific software use cases is a plus

  • Familiarity with one or more of the following is desirable but not required: full-stack web development (React, TypeScript, FastAPI), Pydantic, JAX, cloud services and cloud-based applications; data management systems

title: Spécialiste Support Comptable (Télétravail complet possible depuis Caen)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique comptable, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et tu cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul(e) et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

🤝 Process de recrutement

● Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec un(e) Associate Team Lead (1h)

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

title: Staff Applied Scientist, Optimisation
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Millions of parcels, thousands of couriers, and routing, pricing and scheduling decisions needed in real time and under uncertainty. Relay's last mile is a growing optimisation problem that never sits still.

Relay's in-house solver has carried the business through more than 100x growth, built by a team of Operational Research Scientists who designed the decision architecture the network runs on. You'll join them and take it further.

Optimisation Highlights

  • An in-house solver, built and owned by our own Operational Research team, running live at scale.

  • Routing, pricing and scheduling decisions made in real time and under uncertainty.

  • ML and recommender intelligence integrated into the decision models.

  • A flexible network: pitstops can change, warehouse automation can be reconfigured, and new processes roll out overnight.

The Opportunity

As a Staff Applied Scientist at Relay, you'll:

  • Lead optimisation for Relay's last mile, making the best routing, pricing and scheduling decisions for couriers and the wider network.

  • Model and optimise the decisions that define our last-mile delivery network and marketplace.

  • Develop our solvers and algorithms so they perform live, and at scale.

  • Partner with other Scientists to unite ML and recommender systems with Operational Research.

  • Raise the standard for Operational Research at Relay, and grow the team, the research culture and our voice in the tech community.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Bring deep expertise in operational research, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

  • Come from operational research or industrial engineering, or from an advanced quantitative discipline, including trading, that has branched into optimisation.

  • Have built optimisation systems or ML models that run in production, and owned the outcome.

  • Are energised by large, messy problems, and know how to bring structure to them.

  • Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You'll Do:

CoreWeave’s Physical AI Engineering team builds and scales the core platform powering advanced engineering simulation and AI workflows. Our ambition is to become the super-intelligent AI test lab for the engineering industry, delivering the performant, reliable, and scalable foundation trusted by the world’s largest engineering companies.

About the role: 

The Staff Frontend Engineer will own and evolve the Physical AI platform’s product surface: the data-heavy, workflow-centric web experience where engineers design experiments, compare runs, interact with agents, and convert complex test data into decisions. Operating at Staff-level scope (with openness to exceptional Senior Frontend Engineers ready to step into staff-level impact), you will own the frontend end-to-end-including component architecture, design system evolution, performance optimization, and production operations. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Design, Product, and Backend Engineering to design intuitive UIs for complex workflows, shape Python-backed API contracts, and integrate agentic capabilities safely. Additionally, you will drive frontend developer experience improvements, maintain high testing standards, and mentor engineers across the wider organisation.

Who You Are:

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of building, maintaining, and architecting complex, data-heavy web applications at Senior or Staff scope.
  • Advanced proficiency in React, TypeScript, and web fundamentals, with deep experience structuring large-scale frontends across modules, state management, routing, and data-fetching patterns.
  • Proven background building visualization-centric UIs, dashboards, charts, time-series metrics, or experiment explorers for complex datasets.
  • Hands-on experience integrating frontends with REST or GraphQL APIs, with a strong understanding of service-oriented architecture, data modeling, and Python web frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Flask, Django).
  • Practical experience with database data flows (e.g., PostgreSQL), cloud/container infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes), and frontend observability tools (Sentry, Datadog, OpenTelemetry).
  • Strong habits around testing frameworks (unit, integration, end-to-end), CI/CD pipelines, and frontend build tooling (Storybook, design systems, local dev ergonomics).
  • Excellent communication, cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring skills in high-ambiguity environments.

Preferred:

  • Experience building B2B SaaS UIs for technical audiences (e.g., ML engineers, data scientists, physical test engineers) or exposure to ML/AI workflows, experiment tracking, and agentic interfaces.
  • Hands-on experience with GraphQL, typed API clients in React, or SSR/SSG performance-focused frameworks.

Wondering if you're a good fit? 

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams-even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.

  • You love to craft intuitive, detail-oriented web experiences that make complex, data-heavy engineering workflows feel seamless and fast.
  • You're curious about pushing the boundaries of Physical AI, agentic interfaces, and real-time experiment tracking platforms.
  • You're an expert in architecting scalable React/TypeScript systems, driving frontend performance, and mentoring teams on engineering craft.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an OwnerEmpower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client
  • ExperiencesAchieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organisation's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

  • Family-level Medical Insurance
  • Family-level Dental Insurance 
  • Generous Pension Contribution 
  • Life Assurance at 4x Salary 
  • Critical Illness Cover 
  • Employee Assistance Programme 
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Work culture focused on innovative disruption

Benefits may vary by location. 

Equal Opportunity 

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Recruitment Agencies

CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.

Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to technology and/or source code subject to U.S. export control laws. Any such access will be provided only in compliance with applicable U.S. export control requirements. As part of the recruitment process, CoreWeave may request limited information reasonably necessary to assess applicable export-control requirements. 

Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications

title: Staff Performance Engineer, JavaScript Engine (SpiderMonkey)
descriptionHtml:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

The JavaScript team at Mozilla works to make Firefox's industry-leading JavaScript engine SpiderMonkey even more performant. We push the boundaries of what the web is capable of, shaping the future of the JavaScript language through standardization at TC39, while keeping in mind the fundamental principle of “don’t break the web.”

As a Staff Software Engineer on the SpiderMonkey team, you'll be a domain expert who drives the engine's runtime performance forward, from the interpreter and JITs to the garbage collector, while also helping maintain and advance the health of a large, mature C++ codebase. You'll typically lead performance projects within the team, planning the work and mitigating the risk yourself, and you'll mentor other engineers as you take on increasingly ambiguous, high-impact problems.

What you’ll do: 

  • Lead runtime performance initiatives: Own projects to improve SpiderMonkey's runtime performance, from profiling and identifying bottlenecks to designing and landing optimizations across the interpreter, JITs, and garbage collector.
  • Provide technical leadership to the team: Mitigate risk for the performance projects you own, planning work that may start out ambiguous and require significant up-front design and prototyping.
  • Maintain and advance the codebase: Help preserve the correctness and stability of a large, mature C++ codebase while improving its architecture and maintainability as the JavaScript language and the engine continue to evolve.
  • Track and shape the JavaScript standard: Work with the JavaScript team to keep up with the evolving TC39 standard, and help evaluate proposals where performance or implementation tradeoffs are involved.
  • Strengthen engine security: Collaborate with the Fuzzing team to identify and close security issues in the JavaScript engine.
  • Mentor and elevate the team: Mentor other engineers by stewarding some of your existing responsibilities to more junior team members as you take on new, larger initiatives, and help the team build stronger performance-analysis and benchmarking practices.
  • Communicate clearly: Turn team strategy and goals into concrete action for the projects you lead, and communicate progress, tradeoffs, and technical decisions clearly to your team and to partner teams.
  • Use AI tools day to day: Incorporate AI-assisted tools into your workflow for debugging, prototyping, code analysis, and development.

What you’ll bring: 

  • 5+ years developing C++ applications
  • Demonstrated expertise in systems programming, including direct experience with one or more of: compilers, garbage collectors, interpreters, and virtual machines
  • Strong background in performance analysis, profiling, and benchmarking on large and complex software
  • Experience with general systems architecture (x86, x64, ARM, ARM64, etc.)
  • A track record of technical leadership: planning ambiguous projects, sequencing project work, and mitigating risk with minimal help
  • Experience mentoring other engineers and helping raise a team's technical standards
  • Creative problem solver with strong debugging skills and a detailed approach to code review
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable turning team strategy into action and communicating tradeoffs to peers
  • Comfortable incorporating AI assisted tools into your day-to-day engineering workflow

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days when everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws.  Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

title: Staff Product Engineer ( SaaS / Remote )
descriptionHtml:
Ready to own it, build it, and grow it?

The Mission:

Publitas lets people, and increasingly agents, create, host and distribute digital flyers and catalogues for retail brands. Our customers include ALDI, IKEA, Carrefour, Metro and Decathlon. Right now we’re building a fully automatic, agentic workflow that generates a whole catalogue from a brand guide and a list of products.

As a Staff Product Engineer, you’ll build this product hands-on, taking open-ended problems to working software in whatever part of the stack the problem needs. You’ll join a team of senior engineers who are put on our hardest problems, some of which cut across teams. Our customer base is large (not Google scale, but big), so what you ship gets used, and it comes with real technical challenges. Our core stack is Ruby on Rails on the backend and JavaScript with React on the frontend, with services around it in JavaScript, TypeScript and Python. This is a staff-level role, and you’ll have a lot of influence in a mid-sized company with very little red tape.

This role is for you if

  • You've built several complete products and you'd enjoy showing them to us.

  • You like open-ended problems, and you'd rather work out what to build than be handed a spec.

  • You enjoy problems that are hard to think through, and you can point to one you cracked.

  • You get excited about the end result, not just the code.

  • AI has changed what you dare to build: you ship faster, and you take on projects you’d never have started alone.

  • You want real influence in a mid-sized company with a large customer base and very little red tape.

It's probably not for you if

  • You prefer to stay in one layer of the stack.

  • You want a detailed spec or a clear list of tasks before you start.

  • You're still trying AI out rather than building with it every day.

Where and when you work

The role is fully remote, and most of the stakeholders and peers work Central European hours. Nobody sets your schedule, but we'd like around six hours of overlap with the team on a normal day. In practice that works best if you live within about two hours of CET.

Show us what you've built

When you apply, point us to things you've made. Complete, working applications say the most, but libraries and tools are welcome too. We'd love to hear how you built them.

What We Offer You to Win

  • Transparent Compensation: A competitive salary (geo-bracketed to your location in the EU) with a clear, performance-based path for career progression.

  • True Remote Autonomy: No clock-watching or useless alignment meetings. You manage your territory as if it were your own business.

  • Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person.

  • Modern Sales Stack & Gear: A premium MacBook, remote work accessories, and a co-working budget if you want to work outside your home.

At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output.

Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are “AI-curious”; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.
