title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Deployment
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Every change to Anthropic's software has to reach production somehow: new code, runtime configuration, feature flags, infrastructure changes. Our team builds the systems those changes travel through. Our mission is to give every team at Anthropic a fast, safe, and predictable path from change to production.

You'll join the team within Anthropic's Infrastructure organization that owns pipelines, staged rollouts, health-gated promotion, and rollback, along with runtime configuration, feature flags, and the systems that deliver code and artifacts to machines across a very large fleet. You'll own a meaningful part of this end to end, from design through operating it in production.

If you want your work to shape how fast and how safely Anthropic ships, this could be a great fit.

Key responsibilities

  • Set technical direction for major parts of the deployment platform and own them end to end: design, implementation, operations, and on-call
  • Build rollout safety into the platform, including progressive delivery, health-gated promotion, automatic pause and rollback, and deploy controls that teams manage themselves
  • Design APIs and abstractions that work equally well for engineers and for AI agents
  • Extend the platform to new workload types and runtimes, from Kubernetes to serverless and edge platforms
  • Build and operate runtime configuration and feature flag systems with validation, gradual rollout, and fast rollback
  • Build infrastructure-as-code workflows that many teams rely on for safe, routine changes
  • Scale artifact distribution so code and configuration reach machines quickly and efficiently
  • Partner with Security so that the path to production is secure by default, with verifiable builds, least-privilege access, and auditable changes
  • Work directly with teams across Anthropic to understand their deployment needs and bring their workloads onto the platform
  • Take part in on-call and incident response, and turn what you learn into guardrails so the same problem can't recur

Minimum qualifications

  • Proficiency in at least one backend or systems programming language, such as Rust, Go, C++, or Java
  • Experience leading the design, building, and operation of distributed systems or infrastructure in production, including technical direction across teams
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and containerized workloads, such as Kubernetes on AWS or GCP
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building deployment, release, or change management systems at large scale
  • Experience with production on-call and incident response
  • Experience with Rust in production
  • Experience with progressive delivery and GitOps tooling, such as Argo CD or Argo Rollouts
  • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, including controllers and operators
  • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code systems at scale, including state management and locking
  • Experience building feature flag, experimentation, or dynamic configuration systems
  • Experience with artifact or package distribution, such as OCI registries, Nix, or content-addressed storage
  • Experience with software supply chain security, such as signed build provenance
  • Experience building high-throughput workflow engines or control planes backed by relational databases
  • Experience building internal developer platforms and driving adoption across many teams
  • Experience using AI agents in your own engineering work, or building systems that agents operate

Representative projects

  • Build operator controls for progressive rollouts, including pause and resume that preserve rollout state
  • Design a deployment engine built on fine-grained targets and their dependencies, so each change rolls out exactly where it needs to
  • Build cluster-health-aware rollouts that steer around unhealthy clusters
  • Add a new workload type to the platform, including its rollout, verification, and rollback behavior
  • Design a deployment control plane that handles sharp bursts of agent-driven traffic
  • Design a distribution system that delivers configuration and artifacts to every machine in the fleet as demand grows

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:£325,000—£390,000 GBP

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. title: Stage: Bedrijfsprocessen & Veiligheid
descriptionHtml:
Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdracht

Tijdens deze hbo-stage ga je aan de slag met Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO). LOTO is een veiligheidsmethode waarbij machines en energiebronnen tijdens onderhoud of werkzaamheden veilig worden uitgeschakeld en vergrendeld. Zo wordt voorkomen dat een machine onverwacht wordt ingeschakeld terwijl eraan wordt gewerkt. Jij helpt Nedlin om deze werkwijze verder te ontwikkelen, te standaardiseren en praktisch toepasbaar te maken.

  • Je onderzoekt de huidige LOTO-werkwijze en brengt risico’s, energiebronnen en isolatiepunten in kaart.

  • Je ontwikkelt een uniforme LOTO-procedure en machine-specifieke LOTO-kaarten.

  • Je brengt de benodigde materialen en hulpmiddelen in kaart.

  • Je ontwikkelt instructie- en toolboxmateriaal voor medewerkers.

  • Je stelt een praktisch implementatieadvies op om LOTO binnen Nedlin verder te borgen.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Stagevergoeding:

    • € 300,- bruto per maand voor mbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

    • € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

  • Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa;

  • Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht;

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen;

  • Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes;

  • Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match.

Veiligheid tijdens je stage

Veiligheid staat ook tijdens de uitvoering van de stageopdracht voorop. Je voert daarom geen risicovolle onderhoudswerkzaamheden zelfstandig uit. Eventuele technische aanpassingen worden uitsluitend uitgevoerd door bevoegde medewerkers of externe partijen. Machinekaarten worden vóór ingebruikname gevalideerd door de Technische Dienst.


Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Integrale Veiligheidskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Engineering of Facility Management.

  • Je hebt interesse in techniek en veiligheid en combineert graag theorie met praktijk.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en proactief en communiceert gemakkelijk met collega’s.

  • Je bent 32 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar voor een meewerk- en/of afstudeerstage.

  • Je kunt zelfstandig naar onze locatie in Elsloo of Hoensbroek reizen.

Pak het moment

Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen werken aan een interessante opdracht, maar vooral ook leren, ervaring opdoen en jezelf ontwikkelen? Bij Nedlin krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis vanuit je opleiding toe te passen in de praktijk, mee te kijken binnen onze organisatie en samen te werken met ervaren collega’s. Maak van jouw stage een waardevolle stap richting je toekomst. Solliciteer eenvoudig via de solliciteerknop. Heb je eerst nog vragen over de stage of de opdracht? title: Strategic Account Director
descriptionHtml:
About Valiantys

Valiantys transforms how organizations work by delivering expert solutions that increase enterprise and team agility. Valiantys unlocks the full value of Atlassian’s System of Work, helping customers revolutionize product development, streamline enterprise service management (ESM), and accelerate cloud transformation. Federal and highly regulated organizations trust Valiantys to help them maximize the potential of Atlassian solutions and reach their goals. More information about Valiantys is available at www.valiantys.com.

Job summary

Valiantys is looking for a Strategic Account Director to accelerate growth across our most important enterprise clients and prospects.

This role is a senior, services-led growth position for a commercially ambitious leader who can create opportunity at executive level, shape complex transformation agendas and convert them into significant consulting, professional services and long-term managed services relationships.

You will operate at the intersection of client strategy, technology transformation and commercial growth, building trusted relationships with senior executives, identifying where Valiantys can create meaningful business impact and mobilizing the right expertise from across our organization to make it happen.

Your mandate is clear: open doors, create demand, expand strategic relationships and build substantial, sustainable services revenue.

Your impact

Strategic Accounts

For senior sales professionals who are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders, navigating complex organizations and expanding strategic customer relationships over time.

You will build trusted executive relationships, identify transformation priorities, create long-term account strategies and grow the value Valiantys delivers across a customer organization.

What you will do

Strategic account leadership

  • You will think like the CEO of your accounts.

    That means understanding each client’s strategy, organization, technology landscape, investment priorities, stakeholders and competitive dynamics and translating that intelligence into a deliberate growth strategy.

    You will build and execute account plans that answer three fundamental questions:

    • Where can Valiantys create the greatest value?

    • Who do we need to influence to make that happen?

    • How do we turn that value into sustainable commercial growth?

    You will develop relationships across multiple levels of the client organization, create executive sponsorship, uncover new buying centers and build a strong pipeline of opportunities capable of materially growing each account.

MSF International

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested.

I. CONTEXT

MSF consists of 6 Operational Centres (OCs) and 3 European Supply Centres (ESCs). In the supply domain there is a joint Supply Tansformational Topics Roadmap composed by several inter-OC and inter-ESC projects, and their number is growing due to the need to increase cooperation between MSF entities while improving the quality of MSF's supply chain. The capacity to measure performance and analyse data across different entities is therefore essential and is contributing to MSF ambitions on interoperability and climate.

The role of the International Office is to foster cooperation and coordination between MSF entities. The Supply Data Analyst will therefore act as a facilitator between the OCs and ESCs: bringing their representatives together, helping them build shared approaches on supply data and performance, and turning these agreements into concrete deliverables.

The Global Supply Data & Analytics (GSDA) team (previously SCPM) has been actively working to build the analytical and data foundations needed to support a global approach to supply chain performance management, and to contribute to the governance of supply data across entities. The team is led by the Supply Chain Analytics Manager and includes one Data Analysts and one data governance specialist; the Supply Data Analyst will join it as an additional analyst.

Reporting hierarchically and functionally to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager, the Supply Data Analyst will: collaborate closely with the supply chain professionals responsible for BI and performance management within the 6 OCs and 3 ESCs; work in close link with the ShARP (Shared Analytics and Reporting Project) team in SITS (Shared IT Services); on the existing UniField intersection reports; work alongside the GSDA team and the IO Supply team on projects related to supply chain data analytics; and interact with stakeholders across MSF, including finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics and operations teams.

II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The Supply Data Analyst supports supply chain performance analysis and decision making across MSF by delivering reliable data, KPIs, reports and actionable recommendations. The position also fosters cooperation between the OCs and ESCs around shared supply data, turning agreements into concrete deliverables.

Within GSDA, the Supply Data Analyst will support the growing need for data management, reporting and analytics from the supply chain teams, including the monitoring of KPIs and the analysis of data coming from MSF information systems (such as UniField, Isystock or Akiba).

III. ACCOUNTABILITIES

The Supply Data Analyst is accountable for the following expected results and the activities deployed to achieve them.

1. UniField intersection reports are reliable, relevant and meet the needs of the OCs

a. Take over the existing UniField intersection reports in close link with the ShARP team and improve them (reliability, relevance, usability) based on users' feedback and identified gaps

b. Collect the reporting needs of each OC and consolidate them into a clear, prioritised set of requirements

c. Design and deliver new intersection reports in coordination with the ShARP team, with validation from the OC representatives

2. Supply data is available and of reliable quality for analysis

a. Extract, clean and consolidate supply data from UniField and other information systems

b. Check data consistency and quality, and report anomalies to the relevant teams

c. Document data sources, definitions and calculation methods

3. KPIs and reporting solutions support decision making

a. Calculate and update a set of KPIs on a regular basis, in coordination with the teams concerned

b. Build and maintain ad hoc data reporting solutions (Power BI) providing visuals that accurately summarise supply chain activities while providing actionable insights

c. Support the teams in the definition of additional KPIs as needs arise

4. Stakeholders receive relevant data analysis and actionable recommendations

a. Support stakeholders on supply data analysis

b. Respond to ad hoc data and analysis requests using supply data from different stakeholders (supply, finance, medical…)

c. Present analysis results and recommendations in a clear way to non-technical audiences

5. Cooperation between the OCs and ESCs on supply data produces concrete deliverables

a. Convene and facilitate working groups and meetings with representatives of each OC and ESC, from preparation (agenda, pre-alignment of positions) to follow-up (minutes, actions, deadlines)

b. Lead discussions between entities with different needs and practices, and build compromises and consensus on shared definitions, KPIs and ways of working

c. Turn agreements into concrete deliverables (e.g., shared KPI definitions, dashboards, documentation) and follow their delivery

6. Data-related tools and processes improve continuously and stakeholders are kept informed

a. Contribute to the improvement of data-related tools and processes within the team

b. Proactively identify data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and propose solutions autonomously

c. Manage stakeholders and expectations: identify their needs, keep them informed, and escalate blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed

IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY

Challenges and decisions that the job faces to achieve the accountabilities:

  • Autonomy to think and act: works with limited supervision; takes initiative, prioritises and drives work to completion, proactively identifies data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and escalates blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed.

  • Complexity of the environment: works across 6 OCs and 3 ESCs with different needs, practices and information systems (UniField, Isystock, Akiba); builds compromises on shared definitions and KPIs, handles multiple priorities at once, and interacts with technical and non-technical stakeholders (finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics, operations) in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment.

SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE

The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others.


Education

  • Bachelor's level or above in data analytics, statistics, business management, supply chain or a related field, or a combination of relevant education and professional experience (essential)

Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience as Data Analyst (essential)

  • Direct work experience involving significant data management (essential)

  • Experience in facilitating meetings or working groups involving multiple stakeholders and in delivering concrete outputs from them (essential)

  • Supply chain, logistics and Finance experience in NGO's operational settings (desirable)

  • Previous work experience with UniField, MSF's main ERP software (desirable)

Skills

  • Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills: ability to bring together representatives of different entities, lead effective meetings, negotiate compromises and deliver concrete outcomes

  • Strong analytical skills

  • Good organisational skills, ability to handle multiple priorities at one time

  • Autonomous and proactive: ability to take initiative, prioritise and drive work to completion with limited supervision

  • Good level skills in Excel, Power BI and database management

  • Ability to work in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment

  • Drive for change, improvement and innovation

Languages

  • Fluent spoken and written English (essential)

  • Good command of French (strongly desirable)

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Technical Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

 

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

 

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

 

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

 

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

     

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain— experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

     

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This role is based in UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

  

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

As we scale into 2027 and beyond, we're adding a Technical Recruiter in London to extend our reach into the world's most competitive hiring market.

In this role, you'll own full-cycle recruiting in Engineering, with a particular focus on building Attio's presence and network amongst Senior, Staff, Principal and Lead level Engineers. You'll play a role in connecting top talent to London based hybrid roles as well as remote opportunities in the UK, Germany, Poland, Portugal. You'll work closely with our VP Engineering and Engineering Hiring Managers as well as the Talent team, partnering on structured, calibrated hiring processes that consistently raise the bar.

  • Resilient. Our bar is high. We only hire around 0.2% of the candidates that we source or review.

title: Trade-in Buybulk Intern
descriptionHtml:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

The Trade-In service enables customers to sell their old devices (smartphones, tablets, gaming consoles, Back Market’s network professional refurbishers. This is great for the consumer who can reclaim cash for their old device and prevent the accumulation of e-waste in our landfills. Trade-In is also a key pillar for Back Market as it facilitates the sourcing of tech devices to be refurbished and sold on our website.

BuyBulk is Back Market's centralized Trade-in service where a single professional processing partner receives, tests and grades all incoming devices on behalf of the refurbishers. Instead of each refurbisher individually sourcing and processing trade-in devices, BuyBulk handles the entire operational process and ships the tested devices in bulk. This service removes the sourcing burden and lets professionals focus on what they do best: refurbishing and selling.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

Play a key role in ensuring Buybulk performance reaches targets on a daily / weekly / monthly basis by:

  • Tracking and monitoring KPIs to help the team understand performance drivers and take relevant actions: you will support the team in regular reporting, one-off analyses on specific topics and continuous improvement of reporting and tools

  • Being in charge of key operational processes and checks to ensure a steady performance and customer satisfaction

Support the team on major projects - examples of projects and topics you could work on:

  • Improving efficiency through automation (simplify / automate processes, reportings, analyses, alerting …)

  • Build new or improve existing processes, tools and reports on ad-hoc projects (quality control, customer care, pricing, …)

  • Participate in structuring large projects by identifying opportunities (benchmark, research, …), setting up action plans, identifying stakeholders (within teams such business development, marketing or product), defining timelines and success factors and regularly following up on progress

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You are looking for a 6-month internship

  • English and French fluency (fully professional capability).

title: Vice President Finance (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As Vice President Finance (all genders), you will lead and further professionalise our global Finance function, ensuring the company has the financial transparency, processes, and steering mechanisms required to scale successfully.

This role combines strategic financial leadership with hands-on ownership of all core finance activities, including financial planning, controlling, accounting, treasury, payroll, tax, reporting, and finance operations. You will lead a growing team and continue the transformation of Finance from a scale-up function into a mature, globally operating business partner.

Beyond running the existing function, you will proactively identify future challenges and opportunities, helping leadership make well-informed decisions through robust planning, forecasting, business insights, and financial modeling. You will act as a trusted partner to the C-Level and leadership, and our corporate shareholder, ensuring Finance is not only a reporting function but a strategic driver of long-term success.

This is a full-time hybrid role, with 1-2 days per week working from our Berlin office.

Your Mission

  • Lead, develop, and inspire the Finance team across all functional areas.

  • Own the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes from a financial perspective.

  • Continuously improve forecast quality and business visibility.
  • Support leadership with scenario planning and strategic decision-making.

Controlling & Business Partnering

  • Further develop financial controlling processes and management reporting.
  • Partner with department leaders to improve financial planning, cost transparency, and performance management.
  • Challenge assumptions, identify risks early, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Establish a culture of financial accountability throughout the organisation.
  • Drive improvements in cost tracking, resource planning, and investment prioritisation.

Financial Reporting & Accounting

  • Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting across all entities and markets.

  • Ensure compliance with statutory, tax, and internal reporting requirements.
  • Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing processes.
  • Coordinate external audits and relevant financial reviews.

Corporate & Shareholder Finance

  • Serve as the primary financial interface to our corporate shareholder and relevant stakeholders.

  • Ensure transparency and professionalism in all financial communications.

Global Finance Operations

  • Own Finance processes across all markets.

  • Support international expansion through scalable financial structures and processes.
  • Promote best-practice sharing and operational alignment across markets.

Finance Systems, Data & Automation

  • Drive the professionalisation and automation of Finance processes.
  • Improve the quality, availability, and utilisation of financial data.
  • Define requirements for Finance tooling, reporting, and workflow improvements.
  • Collaborate with Strategic Operations, Data, Product, and Engineering teams on automation initiatives.
  • Leverage technology and AI-enabled solutions to increase efficiency and decision quality.

Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Continuously evaluate and improve Finance processes, controls, and governance structures with a strong focus on simplicity and ease of use.
  • Reduce manual effort through standardisation and automation.
  • Implement scalable operating models that support company growth.
  • Ensure Finance remains fit for purpose as organisational complexity increases.

Requirements

What You Need to Succeed

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience in at least 2-3 of the following areas: Finance, Controlling, FP&A, Accounting, or related fields.
  • Proven leadership experience in a successful start-up, scale-up, or top-tier environment.
  • Strong background in financial planning, forecasting, and business partnering.
  • Experience in building and professionalising finance functions and processes.
  • Exposure to corporate structures and shareholder reporting environments.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services, technology, or other regulated industries is beneficial.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Outstanding financial planning and modelling skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-making at leadership level.
  • High degree of ownership and proactiveness.
  • Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
  • Strong understanding of finance systems, reporting structures, and process design.

title: Warehouse Supervisor
descriptionHtml:
Warehouse Supervisor

Location: Brighton - St Josephs Business Park (BN3)

Working pattern: Onsite | Full-time | Shift-based (37.5 hours per week)

Pay: £14.30per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Supervisor to join our Brighton team. In this role, you’ll be the beating heart of our daily site operations, maximizing customer satisfaction by ensuring our loyal customers receive their household essentials as quickly as possible.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the HOP Operations team. This team is responsible for the end-to-end management of our rapid grocery delivery sites, ensuring inventory accuracy and lightning-fast dispatch.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Dispatch Excellence: Oversee that all orders are picked to meet time targets and lead the dispatch area to ensure seamless packing for our customers.

  • Manage Inventory Rigour: Unload deliveries according to procedure, ensuring total accuracy of product locations, date rotations, and claims logging.

  • Maintain Operational Standards: Ensure the warehouse remains clean, tidy, and safe at all times, dealing with hazards urgently and conducting regular H&S checks.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Partner with the Warehouse Assistant Manager and Manager to ensure the site runs smoothly and employees follow company procedures.

  • Ownership of Stock Integrity: Ensure stock counts are 100% accurate across all designated counting areas.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Operational Experience: Proven ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments (FMCG, Retail, Warehouse, or Last-mile delivery is a major plus).

  • Performance Driven: A track record of hitting goal targets, such as pick times or dispatch KPIs.

  • Natural Leadership: A "lead by example" mentality with a genuine passion for motivating and coaching junior team members.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to finding new ways to improve site operations and resolve challenges as they arise.

  • Adaptability: The ability to work autonomously while contributing to a high-energy, positive team environment.

Our Interview Process

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

descriptionHtml:
Présentation de Télécom SudParis :

Télécom SudParis est une grande école publique d'ingénieurs reconnue au meilleur niveau des sciences et technologies du numérique. La qualité de ses formations est basée sur l’excellence scientifique de son corps professoral et une pédagogie mettant l’accent sur les projets d’équipes, l’innovation de rupture et l’entreprenariat. Télécom SudParis compte 1 000 étudiantes et étudiants dont 700 élèves ingénieurs et environ de 150 doctorantes et doctorants. Télécom SudParis fait partie de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’école d’ingénieurs en France, et partage son campus avec Institut Mines-Télécom Business School. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom

Missions

Rattaché·e à la Direction communication, le/la Webmaster et chargé·e de marketing digital pilote et met en œuvre la stratégie numérique de l'école pour accroître sa visibilité, développer son attractivité et générer des leads.

Ses missions principales s'articulent autour de 5 axes :

• Administrer et faire évoluer les sites internet

• Piloter les campagnes d'acquisition payantes (SEA) et le plan média

• Optimiser le référencement naturel et la visibilité de l’école dans les moteurs de réponse et les IA génératives (SEO / GEO / AEO) et gérer la présence sur les annuaires de référence (type Onisep)

• Mesurer l'impact des actions et analyser les performances via des tableaux de bord dédiés

• Assurer une veille active et une collaboration transversale avec les services internes et prestataires

 Pilotage des campagnes SEA et plan média :

  • Participer à la conception, lancer et optimiser les campagnes d'acquisition payantes (Google Ads, Social Ads, display)

  • Suivre le budget associé, coordonner le plan média et le suivi avec les agences partenaires et le pôle contenu

  • Organiser, promouvoir et participer aux événements et conférences digitaux de l’école

  • Structurer les contenus pour qu’ils soient repris comme réponses (questions-réponses, FAQ, données structurées shema.org) sur les pages formations, admissions et recherche

  • Suivre la manière dont l’école est citée et décrite par les principaux assistants IA, et corriger les informations erronées ou datées à la sources (site, annuaires, fiches institutionnelles)

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables

title: Werkstudent:in Administration Erneuerbare Energien (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Hi!

Wie schön, dass du hier gelandet bist und überlegst, als Werkstudent:in Teil unseres tollen Teams in Hamburg zu werden.

Somit haben wir nicht nur das Glück, in einem wirklich großartigen Team, sondern auch noch an einem sinnhaften und wichtigen Thema dieser Zeit zu arbeiten: Erneuerbare Energien und Klimaschutz.

Willst du mitmachen?

Was solltest du mitbringen:

  • Du bist noch mindestens für ein Jahr als Student:in eingeschrieben, Fachrichtung egal – Vielfältigkeit macht unser Team aus!
  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig, strukturiert und gewissenhaft.
  • Du bist äußerst zuverlässig und hast keine Angst, auch mal ans Telefon zu gehen.
  • Du bist digital-affin, kennst dich mit Office 365 aus und hast Spaß daran, neue Programme kennenzulernen.
  • Du bringst neben sehr guten Deutschkenntnissen auch noch ein gutes Zahlenverständnis mit.
  • Teamfähigkeit und Aufgeschlossenheit runden dein Profil ab.


Was bieten wir dir?

  • Eine sinnstiftende Arbeit in einem zukunftsrelevanten Thema mit der Möglichkeit, verschiedene Bereiche bei uns kennenzulernen.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten zwischen 15-20 Stunden, gerne an 2-3 Tagen pro Woche.

Hast du dich beworben, gibt es eine kurze Eingangsbestätigung. Sollten wir alle weiterhin das Gefühl haben, dass es sehr gut passt, folgt ein Vertragsangebot.

In der Regel sind wir sehr fix, dauert es doch mal länger, liegt es an anderen Terminen oder Urlaubszeiten. Wir melden uns aber auf jeden Fall und du kannst es natürlich auch tun.

Jetzt freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Deine Andrea Hupe

title: Werkstudent:in (m/w/d) Support Financial Consulting
descriptionHtml:

Gleichzeitig lernen wir Sie kennen: Ihre Leistung, Ihre Haltung und Ihre Entwicklung. Aufgaben

  • Sie unterstützen einen erfahrenen Partner oder Equity Partner im täglichen Arbeitsalltag und übernehmen Aufgaben rund um die Vor- und Nachbereitung von Kundenterminen.

  • Sie sammeln praktische Vertriebserfahrung und erhalten Einblicke darin, wie professionelle Kundenkontakte aufgebaut, gepflegt und weiterentwickelt werden.
  • Sie unterstützen bei organisatorischen und administrativen Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und tragen dazu bei, dass Prozesse und Kundenkontakte zuverlässig vorbereitet und dokumentiert werden.
  • Sie übernehmen zunehmend Verantwortung für eigene Aufgaben, setzen vereinbarte Ziele konsequent um und bringen eigene Ideen ein.

Die fachliche Beratung unserer Kunden erfolgt durch unsere zugelassenen Consultants. Ihr Schwerpunkt als Werkstudent liegt auf der Unterstützung im Arbeitsalltag, der konzeptionellen Mitarbeit, der vertrieblichen Praxis und dem gezielten Aufbau Ihrer Kompetenzen.

Qualifikation

Sie befinden sich 6 bis 12 Monate vor dem Abschluss Ihres Studiums und möchten die verbleibende Studienzeit gezielt nutzen, um praktische Erfahrungen zu sammeln, sich in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld zu beweisen und frühzeitig eine Perspektive im Financial Consulting aufzubauen.

Idealerweise studieren Sie Wirtschafts- oder Sportwissenschaften oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang mit wirtschaftlichem Bezug. Erste Erfahrungen im Consulting, Vertrieb, Finanzumfeld oder im direkten Kundenkontakt bilden eine gute Grundlage.

Noch wichtiger als Ihr Studiengang ist Ihre Haltung:

  • Sie begeistern sich für Vertrieb und gehen offen, sicher und mit echtem Interesse auf Menschen zu.
  • Anspruchsvolle Ziele, messbare Ergebnisse und wirtschaftlicher Erfolg motivieren Sie.
  • Sie erkennen Chancen, handeln eigeninitiativ, nehmen Feedback auf und bringen Aufgaben zuverlässig zum Abschluss.
  • Sie kommunizieren verbindlich, hören aufmerksam zu und treten empathisch auf.
  • Sie streben eine langfristige Perspektive im Financial Consulting an und können sich eine selbstständige berufliche Tätigkeit vorstellen.
  • Sie verfügen über Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau und kommunizieren auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächssituationen sicher und professionell.

Benefits

Wir geben Ihnen die Möglichkeit, Financial Consulting bereits während Ihres Studiums intensiv zu erleben und über einen längeren Zeitraum praktische Erfahrungen in einem professionellen Beratungsumfeld zu sammeln.

  • Fundierte fachliche Ausbildung: Sie lernen die zentralen Bereiche der ganzheitlichen Finanzplanung kennen. Dabei entwickeln Sie ein Verständnis dafür, wie finanzielle Entscheidungen im Gesamtkontext betrachtet und sinnvoll miteinander verbunden werden.
  • Einblicke in professionelle Finanzberatung: Sie lernen die besonderen finanziellen Fragestellungen vermögender Privatkunden kennen und erleben unmittelbar, wie bei PFP Beratung auf hohem fachlichem und persönlichem Niveau umgesetzt wird.
  • Persönliches Mentoring & Teamunterstützung: Ein erfahrener Partner oder Equity Partner begleitet Sie persönlich, gibt Ihnen regelmäßiges Feedback und unterstützt Sie bei Ihrer Entwicklung. Gleichzeitig profitieren Sie vom Wissen und der Erfahrung des gesamten Teams und können sich auch im Arbeitsalltag auf die Unterstützung Ihrer Kollegen verlassen.
  • Lernen durch direkte Anwendung: Sie arbeiten im täglichen Austausch mit erfahrenen Consultants, unterstützen bei realen Aufgaben und wenden neue Inhalte unmittelbar an. So sammeln Sie kontinuierlich praktische Erfahrung und entwickeln ein Verständnis dafür, wie fachliches Wissen in der Beratung eingesetzt wird.
  • Regelmäßige Schulungen & Workshops: Ergänzend zur täglichen Zusammenarbeit nehmen Sie an Schulungen und Workshops teil, die Ihre fachlichen, vertrieblichen und persönlichen Fähigkeiten gezielt erweitern.
  • Anspruchsvolles Leistungsumfeld: Sie arbeiten mit erfolgreichen Persönlichkeiten und erleben ein Umfeld, in dem Engagement, Eigeninitiative und Verbindlichkeit zählen. Klare Erwartungen und direktes Feedback geben Ihnen die Möglichkeit, an Ihren Aufgaben zu wachsen und zu zeigen, was Sie leisten können.
  • Langfristige Perspektive: Bei gegenseitiger Passung bietet sich Ihnen nach Ihrem Studium die Möglichkeit, als selbstständiger Junior Consultant bei PFP einzusteigen und Ihren weiteren Weg bei uns aufzubauen.

Kurz gesagt: Wenn Sie ehrgeizig, kommunikationsstark und bereit sind, sich mit vollem Einsatz einzubringen, finden Sie bei PFP ein Umfeld, das Sie fordert, fördert und Ihnen echte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bietet.

  • Technischer Ansprechpartner für interne IT-Themen und Unterstützung unserer Mitarbeiter bei Anwendungsfragen

  • Koordination und Zusammenarbeit mit unserem externen IT-Dienstleister

  • Analyse, Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung technischer Probleme

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Microsoft-365-Umgebung, insbesondere Teams, SharePoint und OneDrive

  • Einführung neuer Anwendungen sowie Dokumentation unserer IT-Systeme und Prozesse

  • Analyse und Optimierung manueller sowie wiederkehrender Geschäftsprozesse

  • Entwicklung und Betreuung automatisierter Workflows mit Power Automate

  • Erstellung kleiner interner Anwendungen mit Power Apps

  • Anbindung von Fachanwendungen über Schnittstellen wie REST-APIs, HTTP, JSON und Connectoren

  • Datenverarbeitung und -aufbereitung mit Excel und Power Query

Unsere Wünsche an dich.

Wir erwarten nicht, dass du bereits jedes Programm beherrschst oder mit sämtlichen Technologien gearbeitet hast. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis mitbringst, dich gerne in neue Themen einarbeitest und Freude daran hast, eigenständig Lösungen zu entwickeln. Schließlich verändert sich die IT-Welt ständig und wir möchten uns gemeinsam mit dir weiterentwickeln.

Von den folgenden Punkten solltest du dich ebenfalls angesprochen fühlen:

  • Du hast ein Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung im IT-Bereich abgeschlossen

  • Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis für IT-Systeme, digitale Prozesse und technische Zusammenhänge

  • Microsoft 365 ist dir vertraut und idealerweise hast du dich bereits mit Power Automate, Power Apps oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen beschäftigt

  • Begriffe wie APIs, JSON oder Power Query sind dir bekannt und du hast Interesse daran, dein Wissen in diesen Bereichen zu vertiefen

  • Du arbeitest lösungsorientiert, strukturiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung

  • Teamzusammenhalt ist dir wichtig und du hast Freude daran, andere Mitarbeiter bei technischen Fragen zu unterstützen

Das passende Umfeld für deine Karriere.

Ein Arbeitsverhältnis ist ein Geben und Nehmen. Deshalb kannst du dich bei uns auf weit mehr als ein sicheres und unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis freuen:

  • Gelebte Flexibilität mit Home-Office und flexiblen Arbeitszeiten

  • Business-Englisch und einmal pro Woche ein Fitnessangebot

  • Höhenverstellbare Tische und klimatisierte Räumlichkeiten

  • Beste technische Hard- und Software-Ausstattung (Notebook, Geschäftshandy etc.)

  • Support durch einen kompetenten externen IT-Systempartner

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents und vieles mehr

title: WIZE Managing Director UK
descriptionHtml:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

About WIZE

WIZE is the leading all-in-one Portfolio Management System for Swiss boutique wealth managers, External Asset Managers, and family offices. Founded in Geneva in 2010, WIZE has earned a trusted position in a relationship-driven market through deep product capability and a differentiated back-office outsourcing service that competitors have not replicated. The company operates on a highly recurring subscription model, holds a strong position within its vertical, and is in excellent operating shape. WIZE is now entering its first chapter of international ownership under Banyan Software, combining more than fifteen years of product depth and client trust with the operational and AI expertise of a global software group.

The Opportunity

You will join WIZE directly as Managing Director,  United Kingdom, reporting to the CEO of WIZE, with responsibility for establishing and growing the UK business. This is a value-creation mandate, not a turnaround. . You will take the business into a new market, with the United Kingdom as the primary prize. The product has to remain the primary competitive advantage, the recurring revenue base has to be protected, and the opportunity to create structural distance through AI is real.

You will own the UK client and partner relationships, build the commercial motion from the ground up, and partner with the CEO and product and technology leader to ensure the platform addresses the needs of the UK market.

You will have substantial authority over the execution of the agreed UK strategy. Key commercial development decisions, including market positioning, target segments, pricing, partnerships, resource allocation, and major commercial commitments, will be decided jointly with the CEO.

You will do this with the long-term backing of a permanent-capital owner, free from the pressure to flip the business.

What You Will Own

Commercial & Revenue Growth

  • Build the foundation of the UK subsidiary and work closely with the CEO to define WIZE's expansion into the UK market.
  • Own the execution of WIZE's UK strategy, market positioning, and competitive response in the wealth management software market.
  • Drive UK revenue and ARR growth with direct accountability across new customer acquisition, expansion, pricing execution, and the development of recurring revenue.
  • Build and execute the UK go-to-market motion from the ground up: local presence, bank and partner relationships, and a repeatable pipeline where little exists today.
  • Serve as the primary executive relationship owner for key UK clients, bank partners, and influencers, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction, retention, and contract renewal.
  • Develop and deepen strategic partnerships across private banks, discretionary fund managers, and the wider UK wealth management ecosystem.
  • Anticipate client needs and proactively identify opportunities to expand the company's footprint within existing UK 
  • Identify AI-driven opportunities to reposition the product and create durable competitive distance within the WealthTech vertical, working with the CEO and product and technology leader to assess and prioritise them.

Product & Technology

  • Represent the needs of the UK market in product roadmap discussions, ensuring that market feedback reflects the needs of boutique wealth managers and the competitive dynamics of the Portfolio Management Systems market.
  • Contribute to a credible AI roadmap. AI must be embedded as a genuine operational and product advantage, not a roadmap line item.
  • Champion AI-first product thinking, identifying where automation, predictive insights, and intelligent workflows create durable differentiation for UK clients.
  • Partner closely with the CEO and CPTO so that the roadmap, packaging, and pricing tiers align tightly with UK commercial needs.
  • Gather structured feedback from UK prospects, clients, and partners and translate it into clear commercial and product recommendations.

Team & Operations

  • Define and implement the UK commercial development strategy jointly with the CEO.
  • Oversee the UK financial performance, budgeting, and resource allocation to ensure sustainable profitability. Prepare and manage the UK commercial budget and resource plan, subject to approval by the CEO and Chief Revenue Officer, to ensure sustainable growth.
  • Manage risk across operations, contracts, and market dynamics; respond decisively to changes in the competitive or regulatory landscape 
  • Build and lead a high-performing UK sales team, elevating talent density and making hard calls on underperformance with speed and directness, while protecting the trust-based culture that makes WIZE what it is.
  • Establish decision rights, execution cadences, and accountability frameworks that enable the business to sustain higher growth.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively with the CEO on business performance, strategic priorities, pipeline development, and market conditions.
  • Coordinate closely with WIZE's Geneva-based product, technology, implementation, client service, compliance, and operational teams.

What We Are Looking For

The Managing Director we are looking for is a commercially-led WealthTech operator with deep roots in the UK wealth management software market who leads with an AI-first mindset and is energised by the opportunity to create real, lasting business value.

You have personally owned a revenue number, built a commercial motion where none existed, and opened a new geography from scratch.

You have held senior commercial responsibility at a software company serving wealth managers, private banks, or asset managers, with a track record of treating product as a primary strategic lever, closing complex, relationship-driven deals at a senior level, and leading your organisation through at least one meaningful inflexion point.

You proactively reposition ahead of market pressure, make difficult commercial and talent decisions for the long-term health of the business, and understand how to grow recurring revenue and protect the retention that sustains durability.

This is a value-creating enterprise SaaS leader who sees AI not as a feature but as a structural advantage embedded in how they sell, operate, and create enduring competitive distance for the businesses they lead.

Qualifications for Success

  • Owned the P&L or revenue number of a B2B SaaS, FinTech, or vertical software business, with direct accountability for revenue growth, retention, and margin expansion.
  • 7–10+ years of senior commercial leadership at a software or technology company, including direct responsibility for selling to, managing, or delivering to wealth managers, private banks, or asset managers.
  • Direct experience in wealth management software or Portfolio Management Systems, or adjacent FinTech / WealthTech. Experience at a direct competitor carries immediate credibility with prospects and partners.
  • Deep knowledge of the UK wealth management ecosystem (private banks, discretionary fund managers, IFAs, and External Asset Managers) and existing relationships with key buyers and influencers. Ideally, UK-based or strongly tied to the UK.
  • Has built a go-to-market motion in a new geography: hiring local talent, establishing partnerships, and opening a market.
  • Has led an organisation through a meaningful inflexion point, such as a competitive situation, building a business from scratch, pricing repositioning, or commercial professionalisation.
  • Demonstrated AI conviction: shipped product capability, embedded operational tooling, or led sustained AI experimentation with clear conviction about where it creates durable value.
  • Comfortable building and leading a local commercial operation within a company of roughly 30 to 80 people in an investor-backed setting.
  • Able to operate entrepreneurially while working within a jointly agreed strategy and governance framework.
  • Fluent English is essential. French is a significant advantage given the Geneva headquarters and Swiss relationships.
  • Based in the UK, ideally within reach of London, and able to commit to regular on-site presence in Geneva.

*Please complete your application and submit your CV in English
